english: After many decades of success as a privateer racing team, in 2008 Oreca became the latest manufacturer of Le Mans prototypes and in 2011 they debuted their LMP2 challenger, simply named the '03'. Since then they have built 17 seperate chassis, which have between them claimed 17 wins and counting, as well as a European title. The 03 is most commonly seen powered by a Nissan V8 engine, which has proven to be both extremely reliable and powerful.

english: After many years of designing supercars for others, in 1999 Horacio Pagani unveiled his own car design, the Pagani Zonda. It quickly evolved through production, gaining a monstrous 7.3-litre V12 engine that pushed it to a top speed of over 200mph. In 2005, a comprehensive update came with the Zonda F which packed more power and improved aerodynamics. Horacio Pagani still wasn't finished, though, and in 2009 the Zonda Cinque was unveiled. Named after the limited production run of only five chassis, the Cinque boosted power even further and added race car levels of downforce to the already potent handling. Finally, five more chassis were constructed as extravagant open-top Roadsters, with a multi-million dollar price tag to match.

english: Successor to the legendary RS 182 and RS 197, in 2012 Renaultsport launched the fourth-generation Clio RS. Featuring a high-tech turbocharged engine and paddle-shifted transmission, the Clio's performance continued to increase, and as with the previous generations, for 2014 Renaultsport prepared a special racing version of the car for their one-make Clio Cup series. A perfect starting point for aspiring touring car and sportscar racers, many national and international stars began in Clio Cup, and with over a dozen series worldwide, it is accessible for racers young and old.

english: In 2005, Renaultsport began their new one-make series for more experienced racers, using the outrageous Megane V6 Trophy which was upgraded, in 2009, to the newer Megane model. While bearing a resemblance to the road car, the V6 Trophy has a mid-engined layout with a racing sequential transmission, and as the name suggests, is powered by a version of the V6 engine from the larger Vel Satis and Laguna. As well as the Eurocup Megane Trophy series, the car is also eligible for certain touring car and endurance events worldwide, scoring multiple class wins in the Dubai 24 Hours alone.

english: In 1976, Renault bought out French sportscar company Alpine and introduced their novel turbocharger technology to Alpine's Le Mans prototype programme. The result was the A442, with the Renault engine sitting in the middle of a spaceframe chassis with a low-drag fibreglass body. For the A442B revision, a distinctive acrylic bubble was added over the cockpit to streamline it further, and in 1978 the car claimed a win at the prestigious 24 Hours of Le Mans. With the effectiveness of turbocharged engines proven, Renault moved into Grand Prix racing in 1979, and went on to revolutionise the sport.

english: Replacing Group A in the early 90s, the Super Touring ruleset allowed manufacturers to race their popular four-door family saloons with extreme modifications and high levels of technology. One of the most iconic Supertourers was Renault's Laguna, a stalwart of the British series from 1994-1999 with both the factory-entered cars and privateers. Claiming two titles, the Laguna's screaming 2-litre engine and deftly refined aerodynamics helped it make its mark as a classic touring car.

english: The latest in a long line of triumphant purpose-built racing machines, the RWD P30's screaming small-capacity flat-6 features both a turbo charger and a cutting-edge pneumatic hybrid system. Eschewing weighty batteries and electric motors, RWD Motorsport's innovative hybrid technology is both lighter and more efficient than the traditional approach to high performance hybrids. From the mind of designer and Project CARS community member Ryan Day, the P30 is purpose-built for racing in the highest tier of international sportscar racing.

Before we begin, please tell us about your racing history.
chinese: 欢迎来到『Project CARS 2』——终极车手之旅。在比赛中心你可以选择自己的赛车之路。创立一个新的车手并逐步登上荣耀的殿堂，独自享受你的快速比赛周末，和世界各地的玩家连线对战，或是透过活动和测时赛挑战社群。在开始之前，请告诉我们你的赛车经历。

english: Select from the Race Spectrum below a style that best describes your experience and skill level. Note that you can change and go deeper into any of these options at a later time by accessing Options & Help.
chinese: 从下列比赛范围中选择最符合你的经验和技术水准的一项。你随时可以在「选项和帮助」中修改或进一步设定这些选项。

english: Thank you. Project CARS 2 has now been tailored just for you. Now choose where you want to begin. You can access common areas of the game via the Quick Access menu.
chinese: 谢谢。『Project CARS』已经设成为你量身打造，现在选择你要从哪里开始。你可以从「快速进入菜单」选择常用的游戏模式。

english: This is your chance to follow in the footsteps of your favourite racing heroes. Create a driver, choose your starting point and then aim for glory; climb the motorsport ranks quickly to claim the ultimate prize, dominate one particular motorsport defiantly against all challengers, or become a multi-discipline master and prove you can compete in all forms of racing. Complete all three of these Historic Goals and you'll be on your way to entering the Hall Of Fame alongside your heroes.
chinese: 现在你可以开始追随你赛车偶像的足迹了。创立一个车手，选择你的起点，以荣耀为目标：迅速提升等级以获得终极大奖，称霸一个特定车赛与众多挑战者抗衡，或者完成所有形式的比赛成为一个多项全能。完成这三个历史目标，你将进入荣誉殿堂与你的偶像齐肩。

english: Now choose from one of the many starting points for your career. You can start in any of the available Motorsports, and by successfully competing in that Motorsport, receive contract offers to participate in other Motorsports.
chinese: 为你的职业生涯选择一个起点。你可以从任何一个可选车赛开始，透过在比赛中获胜来获得参加其他车赛的邀约。

english: Congratulations! A team is interested in hiring you as a driver. Take a look at and sign the contract so we can begin.
chinese: 恭喜！有个车队想聘请你担任车手。看过合约并签名，就可以开始了。

english: This is your Career Dashboard. Here you can read News articles from Sim Racer reporting on the various motorsports seasons that are currently running, and see what your fans are talking about. It looks like you have a message waiting already in your Inbox.
chinese: 这是你的生涯统计表。在这里你可以阅读模拟车手杂志报导的各种车赛新闻，并且可以看到你的粉丝都在讨论什么。你的收件匣似乎已经有一封邮件了。

english: This is where contract offers, invitations, and messages from your team will appear. It looks like you have a welcome message from your team!
chinese: 这里会显示契约邀约，邀请函和车队讯息，看来你有一个来自车队的欢迎讯息！

english: This tab shows results from every motorsport in the Career Calendar. Here you can track your race results and standings in your current series, view results from previous events you raced in, and see results for all the other motorsport races that are happening in the world.
chinese: 这个标签显示了生涯日历中每场车赛的结果。你可以在这里看到目前参加车赛的比赛结果和排名，查看以往参加过的比赛结果，以及世界上所有正在进行的比赛结果。

english: The Career Calendar shows the championships, series, and events for all Motorsports being held throughout the year. Right now, you'll only be eligible for the Motorsport your team is currently participating in. If you want to enter other Motorsports, you'll need to impress the teams that race there and sign a new contract with them. The start of your season is today so let's get some more information on your first event.
chinese: 生涯日历显示全年的锦标赛、系列赛和所有赛车活动。现在你仅有目前车队所在比赛的参赛资格。如果你想参加更多车赛，你得让那些比赛里的车队注意到你，并与他们签订新的契约。今天是你赛季的开始，来看看关于你第一场比赛的更多资讯。

english: In Quick Race Weekend you can create your own single event with your own car and track selections, opponents, and conditions. Select any pre-race sessions you would also like to include and then start your weekend.
chinese: 在快速比赛周末，你可以建立自己的活动，用自己所选的车、赛道、对手和天气情况进行比赛。还能根据你自己的喜好为比赛周末追加赛前赛程。

english: Welcome to your Garage. Here you can view all the cars available and get more information on their heritage and performance, or go under the hood and create tuning setups for them either here or out on the track.
chinese: 欢迎来到你的车库，在这里你可以查看所有可用车辆和他们历史和性能，也可以在这里为车辆进行调校设定（赛道上同样可进行设定）

english: Here you can create your own Online Race Weekend. Select your favourite car and track combination, along with the conditions, sessions, and rules you would like to enforce then open it up for others from around the world to start joining.
chinese: 在此你可以建立自己的线上比赛周末，选择你喜欢的赛车和赛道组合，并指定你想要的环境、赛程和规则，并且开放游戏让世界各地的人加入比赛。

english: In Time-Trial you can download Ghosts from other members of the Project CARS 2 community and take them on head-to-head to see who's fastest. Alternatively, select one of your own Ghosts to use it as a guide to help you improve your Personal Best.
chinese: 测时赛中，你可以从『Project CARS 2』社群下载其他成员的幽灵，和他们一对一较量。或者选择一个自己的幽灵来帮助引导你提高个人最佳成绩。

english: Come back here often to see what community events are currently being run. Enter and make it into the top contenders for bragging rights and potential prizes :-)
chinese: 这里会显示正在举办的社群赛事，随时回来看看吧。

english: The Driver Network allows you to track your accomplishments and progress, compare your stats with friends, view your highlights, and share content with friends. Your Profile shows a breakdown of what you like playing, your Affinity with particular cars, motorsports, and tracks, your Online Performance record, and Online Reputation. Compare this with friends to see the unique driver journeys you've both taken.
chinese: 车手网路让你能追踪你自己的赛事成就和进度，并能与好友比较数据，回顾你的精彩瞬间并分享给好友。你的个人资料将显示你在游戏偏好的车辆、赛事和赛道，还有你在线上比赛中的表现和声望。将这些数据与你的好友比较，来查看你们与众不同的职业生涯。

english: Succeed in your chosen motorsport and you'll earn Accolades. Accolades attract the attention of scouts for other teams that may want to hire you and specific companies and organisations who may want to invite you to take part in special events. Check back here to see which Accolades you've earned and monitor your progress towards achieving any Historic Goals.
chinese: 成功赢得一项运动将获得荣誉。荣誉能吸引其他车队对你发出契约邀约，也能让公司或组织招待你参加特别的活动。查看你获得的荣誉并关注你的历史目标进展。

english: The Highlights tab lists all your favourite moments and replays that you've saved.
chinese: 重点标签列出了你最喜爱的瞬间和你所保存的重播。

english: Tuning setups can be saved to either individual locations, or to groups of locations that share common characteristics.
chinese: 调校设定可以保存为某个特定赛道所用，也可以保存为有共同特征的几组赛道所用。

english: In Season Mode, you can play championships and series that have been created for you by the Project CARS 2 team and community. Or alternatively, create your own and save it to your Driver Network Race Locker to share with friends.
chinese: 在赛季模式里，你可以完成『Project CARS 2』团队和社群建立的锦标赛和系列赛。或者，你也可以建立你自己的比赛，并透过车手网路共享给好友。

english: Here you can see all the sessions that take place on this day. You can only enter sessions that are part of your current sport. You can drive, skip or simulate any of the practice and qualifying sessions. If you skip qualifying, you will be placed last on the grid for the race. When simulated, a result will automatically be calculated for all participants. You can also scale the length of each session within the minimum and maximum length limits.
chinese: 在这里你可以看到今天所有的赛程，你只能参加你目前比赛的。你可以自己驾驶、跳过或者模拟练习和排位赛。但是如果你跳过排位赛，你将从最后一名发车。当你进入模拟模式的时候，所有选手的结果都将模拟出来。你同样可以更改每个赛程的时间比例。

english: This is a practice session. All rounds start with a practice sesssion, where you can get a feel for the car and the track. You can use the Session Overview screen to monitor the other cars, accelerate time, simulate the session, or skip directly to the end of the session. Try turning off and on the assists on your car, such as traction and stability controls, and feel how they change your car's behavior.
chinese: 这是自由练习赛程。所有回合都是从为了熟悉车辆和赛道的自由练习开始。从赛程概要画面可以看到其他车辆的状态，加速时间，模拟赛程，跳至赛程结尾。将牵引控制和稳定控制等对车辆辅助设为开启或关闭，感受车辆动作的变化。

english: Qualifying determines your placement on the starting grid for the race. The faster time you set in qualifying, the higher up you will be on the race grid. The Setup & Strategy allows you to change the settings on your car and to configure a Pit stop strategy for the upcoming race. You can view a summary of your current series' rules and regulations. Take the car out for a few laps, then return to the pits and try tweaking your car setup to improve your laptimes. You can change tyres, fuel load, and many other settings on your car.
chinese: 排位赛决定正式比赛中你的发车格位置。排位赛中速度越快，发车的位置越靠前。在「设定和策略」中可以针对即将到来的比赛更改车辆设定和设定进站策略。你可以查看目前系列赛的规则概要。让车跑几圈，再返回维修区尝试调整车辆设定来提升圈速。你可以更改轮胎、载油量和很多其他设定。

english: OK, this is your first career race! You can make final adjustments to your vehicle setup, change tyres, and finalize any pitting strategy before the race starts. You will notice that the simulate and skip to end options are disabled. The number on it indicates the minimum duration that you need to drive before you can simulate the rest of the race. Alright, tap the Drive button as soon as you're ready to start your race!
chinese: 好的，这是你职业生涯的第一场比赛！你可以在比赛开始之前对你的车辆设定进行最终调整，换胎，决定进站策略。你会发现「模拟」和「跳至末尾」的选项无法使用。上面显示的数字表示在你模拟剩下的比赛之前，需要持续驾驶的最少时间。好了，准备好开始比赛时就按下「驾驶」按钮吧！

english: The remainder of the session will now be simulated in real time. An AI driver will control your car during Simulate mode. You can use the standings table to view the sector and laptimes for every driver. You can ride onboard your car by using the Player Onboard button. The Spectate button allows you to view the race from trackside or onboard cameras, and select which car you want to watch.
chinese: 赛程接下来的部分将即时模拟。一个AI车手将在模拟模式中代替你控制车辆。你可以在排名表上查看所有车手的区段和单圈时间。你也可以使用玩家参加按钮登上车辆。观战按钮让你可以从赛道旁边观看，或是选择玩家车用摄影机。

english: Here you can see the race results. The drivers are listed in order of their finish positions, along with the points that each driver earned. If the series assign team points, then you will also see the team points on this screen.
chinese: 在这里你可以看到比赛结果。车手在名单上按名次排序，并显示每个车手所获得的积分。如果是有车队积分的系列赛，则萤幕上同时会显示车队积分。

english: This table shows the driver and team standings in the current championship, based on the accumulated points earned in the races so far. Use this table to track how you and your team are doing in your pursuit of the championship crown. You can advance directly to the next round, or you can return to the Career Dashboard and continue the series at a later time.
chinese: 这个表格显示了车手和车队当在目前锦标赛中所处位置，依据的是目前比赛中累计获得的积分。使用这个表格来掌握你和车队在争夺总冠军的道路上表现如何。你可以直接晋级到下一轮，也可以返回生涯统计表，稍后再继续这个系列。

english: Fantastic! You have won your first championship! Make sure to check your inbox, as you will no doubt have received new contract offers. You can also renew your contract with your current team and stay on for another season.
chinese: 太棒了！你赢得了你的第一个锦标赛冠军！记得查看你的收件匣，你肯定会收到新的契约邀约。当然你也可以跟现在的车队续约，在下个赛季继续留着。

english: This race features a mandatory Pit stop. Your engineer will notify you once the pits are open. You must make a single Pit stop after you receive the Pit stop indicator, and before the race is over. Failing to stop will lead to disqualification from the race results.
chinese: 这场比赛要求强制进站。当维修区开放的时候你的工程师会通知你。你在收到进站指示之后并且在比赛结束之前，必须进站一次，否则会在比赛结果中被取消资格。

english: Welcome to your first invitational event. Invitational races cover a wide variety of cars - early vintage open wheel racers, street cars, classic GTs, insanely powerful supercars, and many more. These events do not form part of your core career series. They are optional annual events that you are invited to participate in, just for fun. Once you receive an invitation to an event, you will be able to participate in it every season. You receive these invitations based on how you perform in your career. The more you impress, the more invitations you will receive to these special events.
chinese: 欢迎来到你的第一场邀请活动。邀请活动包含了多种赛车：早期的开轮式赛车、民用车、经典GT赛车、疯狂的超跑等等。这些活动与你的生涯车赛无关，不是必须的，但是你必须收到邀请才能参加。当你收到邀请之后，你可以在每个赛季重复参加。邀请基于你在生涯中的表现而定，你表现的越好，你就越有机会收到这些特别活动的邀请。

english: Novice Handling mode with automatic gearing and all assists/onscreen guides visible. Vehicle degradation is off and motorsports rules are relaxed.  All visual stylization and speed effects are turned on and the default camera view is set to Chase.  Opponents are fairly aggressive and offer decent challenge.
chinese: 初级操作模式：自动排档及开放所有辅助/画面导引。关闭车辆降级，且赛事规则较为宽松。  开启所有视觉及速度效果，摄影机视角默认为追踪。  对手会较为积极以提升挑战性。

english: Sets the handling mode to Novice with automatic gearing.  Helpful driving assists and onscreen guides are turned on but vehicle damage is turned off and your car will not experience mechanical failures, depletion of fuel, or tyre wear.  Opponents offer a challenge but are conservative in their driving style whilst all flags & penalties are relaxed.
chinese: 将操作模式设定为初级并提供自动排档。  驾驶辅助系统及屏幕导引为开启状态，但车辆损害为关闭状态，你的车辆因此无法体验机械故障、油耗，及轮胎耗损。  对手具挑战性，但驾驶风格保守，所有旗子与处罚较宽松。

english: Sets the handling mode to Intermediate with automatic gearing and some helpful driving assists and onscreen guides on.  Vehicle damage is cosmetic only with fuel depletion and tyre wear occuring at a slow rate.  Opponents offer a greater challenge and are more diverse in their driving style whilst standard flags & penalties are present.
chinese: 将操作模式设为中级，关闭自动排档，并呈现部份驾驶辅助系统及屏幕导引。  只会遇到无伤大雅的油耗及轮胎耗损两种车辆损害，且不常发生。  对手更具挑战性，驾驶风格更多变，所有旗子与处罚皆套用。

english: Intermediate Handling mode with automatic gearing but no assists or onscreen guides. Vehicle degradation is standard and all motorsports rules are enforced.  Some visual stylization and speed effects remain on and the default camera view is set to Cockpit.  Opponents are professional and offer significant challenge.
chinese: 开启拥有自动排档，但无驾驶辅助及屏幕导引的中级操作模式。开启标准车辆降级，严格执行所有赛事规则。  开启部份视觉及速度效果，摄影机视角默认为驾驶舱。  对手为专业级并极具挑战性。

english: Sets the handling mode to Pro with manual gearing and no driving assists or onscreen guides.  Damage now affects the performance of the car with fuel depletion and tyre wear occuring at a standard rate.  Opponents offer significant challenge and have a variety of driving styles whilst full flags & penalties are in effect for each motorsport.
chinese: 将操作模式设为职业级，开启手动排档，并关闭所有驾驶辅助系统及屏幕导引。  油耗及轮胎耗损频率为一般，而损害将会影响车辆性能。  对手将极具挑战性并拥有多变的驾驶风格，旗子与处罚在各赛事中全面有效。

english: The FX slider in the FFB menu can enhance tire forces such as scrub, brake lockup, the feeling of over and understeer as well as the road surface irregularities.
Tires and brakes are at their optimal temperature range while green in the HUD Display - blue is under temp, yellow is over, and red is critically over temp at risk of failure.
The vehicle weight listed in the info above includes 85kg for the driver with complete racing gear, as well as other car fluids not including fuel.
Adjust your brake ducts to best suit the current track conditions - a higher brake duct setting will cool them more, while a lower will retain more heat.
Adjustable onboard anti-roll bars and brake bias are valuable tools to adjust the car balance as the tires wear and fuel tank runs low.
Brake ducts and radiator openings are important to cool brake and engine temperatures, but also add a small amount of aero drag & lift - don´t run them more open than you need to!

When driving on a drying track, try to make sure to keep the loaded outside wheels in a given corner inside the dry line - stepping them on a wet patch may lead to running wide and losing a lot of time!
The Low Force Boost slider in the FFB menu can help enhance low-end forces at the center - weaker wheels should use higher values, while DD wheels should have it low or zeroed.
Setup modifications are auto-saved and marked by "*" once it has modified from factory defaults - defaults may still be restored by clicking the "Reset to Default" button.
Keep an eye on the ambient and track temperatures in the monitor screen - they are critical to keep tire and brake conditions within their optimal range and avoid excessive wear.
The track altitude and resulting atmospheric pressure has a big impact in performance - the higher the location, the more aspirated engines will suffer, and the less aero will work.
Set your brake pressure just high enough to avoid locking up on the hardest braking zone - that may be determined by monitoring the brake disc temperatures.
Make sure to select and / or adjust your pit strategy in the In-Car menu before coming in for a pit stop.
The telemetry HUD page features various widgets that can help you better set up your car and force feedback.
Time Trial Mode allows you to measure up against the fastest drivers in any given car-track combo, and also download the setups used in their fastest times.
In cars with adjustable boost, higher values will generate more engine heat - make sure to adjust radiator opening accordingly to cool it down.
Make sure to respect the white lines exiting the pits in order to not get a penalty or cause collisions with approaching traffic.
If you are using headphones, make sure to select "Headphone Mix" in the Audio settings.
Adjusting field of view (FOV) correctly is crucial for an accurate perception of speed and distances.
If the session forecast is set to real or random weather, the chances of rain will vary according to the climate of the region.
Long tracks may see rain falling harder on some points of the circuit, and less in others - keep that in mind before diving into the pits!

english: The following section covers Car Setup and includes...
chinese: 接下来的部分将包含车辆设定……

english: - Information on each setup slider, with descriptions for both casual and veteran players/drivers alike  - Recommendations of settings to use  - Explanations of wider concepts such as oversteer/understeer, downforce etc..  - Diagrams, photos, and videos where appropriate  - Real-world examples
chinese: - 各区块设定上的信息，包含如休闲型及高手玩家/驾驶的描述  - 推荐使用的设定  - 更深度的说明，如转向过度/转向不足、下压力等…  - 适当的图表、相片和影像  - 真实世界范例

english: The two largest concepts when creating a car setup are Handling/Cornering and Acceleration/Top Speed. As a quick guide, the following tips may give significant improvements before going deeper into further sections...
chinese: 建立车辆设定时最重要的两个概念是操控/转向以及加速/极速。作为一个快速指南，以下技巧可以在深入介绍之前让车辆得到很大的提升……

english: A lower Ride Height means a lower center of gravity and a more stable car when cornering.  Similarly, more Downforce means more vertical force on the car and therefore increased friction and better grip on the road.  Toe In, negative Camber and stiff Anti-Roll Bars can also all contribute to better handling in corners.
chinese: 较低的底盘高度代表更低的重心及稳定的过弯。  同样地，更多下压力代表车辆有更多垂直引力，故而提升与地面的摩擦力与抓地力。  前束、负外倾角，及硬的防倾杆同样也可提升弯道控制。

english: Low Downforce reduces the amount of vertical force pushing the car onto the road and therefore allows for a higher top speed.  The Final Drive setting can be changed between allowing either quicker acceleration through faster gearing or a higher top speed at the penalty of slower acceleration.  Individual gears can also be changed to suit each location.
chinese: 低下压力会减少将车辆压向地面的垂直引力，故而允许更高的最高时速。  最终传动设定可以更快的传动速度提升加速，或牺牲加速换取更高的最高时速。  齿轮可因应每个位置而个别更换。

english: "To start with, the first thing a beginner should do, as far as setting up his car is concerned, is complete as many possible laps without worrying about other drivers.  He must try to learn all about the car, systematically changing key components to see how they affect it: try a different anti-roll bar, softer then harder springs, adjust aerodynamic downforce, that sort of thing.  Even in the junior formulae, driving skill alone is not enough, so you must know how to get the most out of your chassis.  At that skill level, you can probably gain a second per lap through skillful driving, but lose three times as much by setting up the car incorrectly."
chinese: 「首先，初学者在车辆设置完成后，第一件事就是在不在意其他车手的情况下，尽可能完成更多的圈数。  他必须要尝试更了解车辆、系统性地更换主要组件，看看它们有何影响。例如，尝试不同的防侧倾杆、更软及更硬的弹簧，或调整空气动力下压力。  就算在初级方程式，光有驾驶技术也是不够的，你必须要知道如何将车身底盘发挥至最好。  你或许可以藉由优秀技术每一圈增进一秒，但你会因为车辆设定错误而输掉三次。」

english: As the car's only contact with the driving surface, tyres are instrumental in perfecting a car setup.  Ideally, the optimal tyre setup will provide excellent grip around corners without a reduction in straight line speed.
chinese: 作为车辆唯一会与地面接触的部位，轮胎有助于完善车辆的设置。  理想而言，优化轮胎设定可提供进入弯道时不降低直线速度的优良抓地力。

english: If you're having trouble with too much understeer, try reducing the front tyre pressure. This will provide more grip at the front end and increase the relative tyre pressure at the rear where there will now be less roll and more responsiveness.
chinese: 如果你经常碰到转向不足，你可以尝试降低前轮的胎压，这样车辆前端会有更好的抓地力。同时增加后轮的胎压，这样车身侧倾将减小并且转向更加灵活。

english: If you're having too much oversteer, try reducing the rear tyre pressure to provide more grip at the rear end and thereby provide more at the front in relation.
chinese: 如果你经常碰到转向过度，尝试减少后轮的胎压，这样会增强后端的抓地力，提升车身在转向时的稳定度。

english: Greater tyre pressures increase responsiveness and reduce roll. Roll is more evident when taking a corner, and therefore this will be a greater issue on a track with many turns. With greater tyre pressure, the tyre responds more quickly because the contact patch is sharper and the tyre is quicker to turn.
chinese: 更高的胎压会增强轮胎的反应并减少侧倾。侧倾通常出现在转向的时候，所以在多弯的赛道更加明显。增加胎压之后，轮胎反应更快，转向的动作也更灵敏。

english: Lowering tyre pressure makes the tyre more pliable which means it ‘falls’ to the driving surface more, increasing the area of the contact patch and improving straight-line acceleration. If the pressure is too low, however, tyre roll can occur when cornering, resulting in both poor handling and responsiveness.
chinese: 降低轮胎胎压会使轮胎更容易变形，与地面有更多的接触面积，同时增强了直线加速性能。但是如果胎压过低，轮胎将会侧倾，这样转向将变得拖泥带水。

english: Tyre pressures are measured in Bar which is roughly the equivalent of 14.5 psi.  Normal road tyres usually vary between 30-50 psi (i.e., 1-3 Bar), but tyre pressures for competitive racing are usually much lower.  Formula 1 tyres, for example, generally run around 1.1 Bar due to the comparative weight of an F1 car (600kg) to an average family car (1,000kg). Therefore less pressure is needed to support the lower weight.
chinese: 胎压以Bar显示，相当于 14.5 psi。  正常道路的胎压落在 30-50 psi 之间 (即…1-3 Bar) 但用于竞赛的胎压通常更低。  以 F1 轮胎为例，由于 F1 赛车 (600 kg) 与平均房车 (1000 kg) 比较起来重量较低，一般会是 1.1 Bar。因此，重量较低，需要支撑重量的压力也就减少。

english: Tyre temperature readings can also give insight into a more beneficial tyre pressure setting.  An ideal contact patch would have the outside, center, and inside of the tyre at equal temperatures.
chinese: 胎温的显示也可提供一些更有利的胎压设定。  理想的接触点就是让轮胎的外侧、中心，及内侧皆为相同温度…

english: - If the central temperature is too high then this area is working too hard and the tyre should be deflated slightly  - If the extremeties are too high however, the tyre needs to be inflated slightly  - Alternatively if one side is hotter than the other, the camber of the wheels should be adjusted
chinese: - 如果中心温度太高，代表该区域摩擦过度，需要适当的放气  - 如果是末端温度太高，则代表需要适当充气  - 另外，如果有一侧比另一侧更热，则需要调整轮胎的外倾角

english: Setup Groups are collections of locations with similar properties (ie.. "Ovals", "Karting", or "Short & Twisty") and can be used to save a single setup to multiple locations that share a similar theme.
chinese: 设定组是一种相似赛道的集合（例如，椭圆赛道、卡丁赛道等），这样可以让相似的赛道共用一套车辆设定。

english: Starting off in karting, Lewis Hamilton's racing career progressed through Intercontinental A, Formula A, Formula Renault, Formula Three, GP2, and eventually to Formula 1 where he became 2008 World Champion and the youngest at the time to ever hold the title at the age of 23.

english: Tyre Compound refers to the type of tyre used on the car, with each compound made either for specific performance criteria, or to be used for particular weather, or climatic conditions.     Slick tyres are best for dry conditions, with a hard compound tyre better suited to hotter conditions than a soft compound. A grooved Rain or Wet tyre is better in wet track conditions. All-Terrain tyres utilize deeper and wider tread channels with soft rubber to grip dirt and gravel surfaces.  Winter tyres are suited to extremely cold, snowy conditions. Ice tyres feature hundreds of 7mm studs for digging into, and gripping frozen ground.     Using the right tyre compound in the right conditions is key to having a well-handling car.
chinese: 轮胎配方为车辆所使用的胎种，而每种配方制作都配合指定的性能标准，或是特定天气或气候条件。     热熔胎最适合用于干燥条件，而相较于软配方，硬配方的轮胎更适合燥热条件。刻有花纹的雨胎较适合用于湿润赛道。全地形轮胎利用更深更宽的胎纹配合软胶，增强在泥泞和碎石表面的抓地力。  雪胎适用于极度寒冷的下雪情形。雪胎拥有上百个用于切入并附着于结冰地面的 7 毫米金属钉。     适合条件下使用适合的轮胎配方是掌控车辆的关键。

english: This is the starting pressure of your tyres. Tyre pressure will change as you drive, and also vary depending on tyre temperature, track surface temperature, and weather conditions. Adjust your tyre pressures to optimize the contact patch, control tyre temperature, and maximise tyre performance for the track conditions.    Lower tyre pressure will soften the carcass and increase the contact patch size. This will soften cornering response and increase grip initially but generate more heat and rolling resistance.  Higher tyre pressure will stiffen the carcass and decrease the size of the contact patch. This will sharpen cornering response and decrease grip but also generate less heat and rolling resistance.     Finding the right tyre pressure for each individual tyre is key to tyre wear, cornering performance, and the overall balance of the car.
chinese: 这是你的轮胎起始压力。行驶过程中胎压会变换，其他变换的因素还有胎温、赛道表面温度及天气条件。调整你的胎压以实现最佳接触点、控制胎温，并使轮胎在赛道条件下发挥最佳性能。    较低的胎温会软化胎体，并增加接触点的范围。这会减缓过弯的灵敏度并提升抓地力，但会产生更多热温及回转抗性。  较高的胎压会硬化胎体，并减少接触点的范围。这会提升过弯的灵敏度并减少抓地力，但会产生较少热温及回转抗性。     为每个单独的轮胎找到适合的胎压是一大关键，将会影响轮胎磨损、过弯性能及车辆整体平衡。

english: Brake Pressure is used to adjust the strength or performance of the brakes when the brake pedal is pressed.    Higher Brake Pressure provides more braking power, meaning the car can decelerate faster under braking, but this will also increase the chances of locking up. Lower Brake Pressure allows for finer control under braking while helping prevent lock-ups, but will also provide less braking power and could lead to the car using its full braking performance potential.     Finding the right balance with Brake Pressure will result in both rapid braking, and no lock-ups under heavy braking.
chinese: 煞车压力用于调整踩下煞车踏板时的煞车强度或性能。    较高的煞车压力提供更多煞车强度，代表车辆可以迅速减速，但也会增加死锁的机率。较低的煞车压力能为煞车提供更佳的掌控并预防死锁，但也会减少煞车强度，并可能导致车辆发挥全部的潜在煞车性能。     找到适合的煞车压力平衡，便可进行紧急煞车，且不会在重度煞车时死锁。

english: Brake Balance sets the ratio of work done by both the front and rear brakes.    Setting the Brake Balance towards the front of the car will provide added stability under braking, but will also increase the chances of locking a front tyre when simultaneously turning and braking. Setting the Brake Balance more towards the rear can help maximise braking on all four tyres, but going too far can destabilise the car under braking, particularly if the rear tyres lock up first.    Finding the right Brake Balance, combined with Brake Pressure, will allow you to have a stable car under braking while both maximising braking performance and minimising braking distances.
chinese: 煞车平衡用于设定前后煞车的工作分配。    将煞车平衡向车头调整可提升煞车稳定度，但在过弯时煞车会提升前轮死锁的机率。将煞车平衡向车尾调整可让四个轮胎都实现最佳煞车性能，但调过头会造成车辆煞车时不稳，尤其是后轮先死锁的时候。    配合煞车压力找到正确的煞车平衡，可让你在煞车时保持车辆稳定，同时实现最佳煞车性能并减少煞车距离。

english: Adjusting the Brake Duct Opening for the front brakes allows for the efficient management of the front brake temperatures.      A smaller brake duct allows less air flow which will decrease aerodynamic drag, but the loss of cooling will increase the potential for the brakes to overheat. A larger brake duct allows more air-flow to the brakes but will also increase aerodynamic drag. Increasing the amount of cooling will reduce the chance of brakes overheating.     Finding the right Brake Duct Opening will keep the brakes in the right operating temperature window over long distance and minimise brake fade. Weather and temperatures will also affect how open or closed you want to run the Brake Duct Opening.    Brake temperature also has a strong influence on hot tyre pressure.
chinese: 调整前煞的煞车冷却导管开口，可更有效掌控前煞温度。      较小的煞车冷却导管能减少空气流动，进而减少气动阻力，但损失的冷却会提高煞车过热的可能性。较大的煞车冷却导管能增加煞车的空气流动，但也会提升气动阻力。提升冷却能够降低煞车过热的机率。     找到适合的煞车冷却导管开口，可长距离保持煞车的正常运作温度，并大幅减少煞车衰退。天候及气温也会影响煞车冷却导管开口的大小。    煞车温度也会大大影响热胎压。

english: Adjusting the Brake Duct Opening for the rear brakes allows for the efficient management of the rear brake temperatures.      A smaller brake duct allows less air flow which will decrease aerodynamic drag, but also increase the potential for the brakes to overheat as they will have less cooling. A larger brake duct allows more air-flow which will both increase aerodynamic drag but also increase the amount of cooling, thereby reducing the chance of overheating brakes .     Finding the right Brake Duct Opening will keep the brakes in the right operating temperature over long distance, minimising fade in braking performance. Weather and temperatures will also affect how open or closed you want to run the brake ducts.     Brake temperature also has a strong influence on hot tyre pressure.
chinese: 调整后煞的煞车冷却导管开口，可更有效掌控后煞温度。      较小的煞车冷却导管能减少空气流动，进而减少气动阻力，但也会因为较少的冷却而提高煞车过热的可能性。较大的煞车冷却导管能增加空气流动，进而提升气动阻力，但也会提升冷却量并减少煞车过热的可能性。     找到适合的煞车冷却导管开口，可长距离保持煞车的正常运作温度，并大幅减少煞车性能衰退。天候及气温也会影响煞车冷却导管的大小。     煞车温度也会大大影响热胎压。

english: Adjusting the Handbrake Pressure allows you to control the strength of the handbrake.     Increasing the pressure means the handbrake will be stronger, increasing the chance of locking up the tyres when the handbrake is applied. Decreasing the pressure means the handbrake will be weaker, decreasing the chance of locking the tyres when the handbrake is applied.
chinese: 调整手煞车的压力可让你控制手煞车的强度。     增加压力代表手煞车会更强，以致使用手煞车时轮胎死锁的机率上升。减少压力代表手煞车会更弱，以致使用手煞车时轮胎死锁的机率降低。

english: Front Downforce will allow you change the aerodynamics at the front of the car.    Increasing Front Downforce will increase high speed cornering grip at the front of the car, but increase drag and reduce potential top speed. Decreasing Front Downforce will reduce drag and improve straight line performance, but decrease high speed cornering grip at the front of the car.     Make sure to balance Front Downforce with the Rear, as too much Front Downforce can lead to oversteer at high speed. Conversely, too little Front Downforce can lead to a car that understeers at high speed.
chinese: 前方下压力让你可以变更车头的空气动力。    调高前方下压力可提升车头在过弯时的抓地力，但会增加阻力并降低可达的最高速。调低前方下压力可减少阻力并加强直线性能，但会降低车头在高速过弯时的抓地力。     切记要平衡车头与车尾下压力，因为过多的前方下压力会导致高速时转向过度。相反的，太少的前方下压力会导致车辆在高速时转向不足。

english: Rear Downforce will allow you change the aerodynamics at the rear of the car.     Increasing Rear Downforce will increase rear-end stability at high speed, but increase drag and reduce potential top speed. Decreasing Rear Downforce will reduce drag and improve straight line performance while decreasing rear-end stability at high speed.     Make sure to balance Rear Downforce with the Front, as too much Rear Downforce can lead to understeer at high speed, while setting Rear Downforce too low can lead to a car that oversteers at high speed.
chinese: 后方下压力让你可以变更车尾的空气动力。     调高后方下压力可提升车尾在高速时的稳定度，但会增加阻力并降低可达的最高速。调低后方下压力可减少阻力并加强直线性能，但会降低车尾在高速时的稳定度。     切记要平衡车头与后方下压力，因为过多的后方下压力会导致高速时转向不足，而太低的后方下压力则会导致高速时转向过度。

english: Adjusting the weight balance either toward the front or rear allows for the adjustment of the balance of the car through a corner.    Moving the weight more towards the rear can make the car feel more nimble, increase traction, and reduce power oversteer (unless the rear tyres become overloaded). Moving the weight toward the front can make the car understeer more and decrease traction. It can also result in power oversteer.     Finding a balance on the Longitudinal Weight Distribution will give the car a good balance throughout the corner while also making turning smoother.
chinese: 前后调整重量平衡可调整车辆过弯时的平衡。    将重量移向车尾可让车辆更加轻盈，增加牵引，并减少过度动力转向 (除非后轮超过负荷)。将重量移向车头会让车辆转向更加不足并减少牵引。那也可能造成动力转向过度。     找到直向重量分布，可让车子过弯时更平顺，同时保持良好平衡。

english: Adjusting the weight balance either more to the left- or right-hand side of the car allows you to counteract high loads on one particular side of the car.     Moving the weight more towards the left can help on counter-clockwise tracks, as the weight of the car naturally shifts to the right-hand side, and extra weight on the left counteracts the amount of load transfer to the right tyres. Moving the weight more towards the right of the car can help on clockwise tracks by balancing the load transfer to left tyres.    Balancing Lateral Weight Distribution can help reduce excess load on one side of the car. This will reduce both overheating and tyre wear on tracks where there are a lot of turns that punish one particular side of the car.
chinese: 将重量平衡往车辆的左右调整，可抵销车辆特定边的负重。     将重量偏向左侧有助于逆时针赛道，因重量会自然偏向右侧，而左侧的额外重量会抵销转移至右轮的负重。将重量偏向右侧有助于顺时针赛道，因为负重会平衡至左轮。    平衡横向重量分布可帮助减少车辆一边过高的负重。这会减少在拥有大量过弯的赛道上，车辆一侧轮胎的磨损及过热。

english: The Weight Jacker affects the cross-weight balance of the car, which can be used to adjust the car’s balance on oval tracks.      Increasing this value will add load to the right front and left rear. This will typically add entry understeer and exit traction in left-hand corners. Reducing the value will take load off the right front and left rear. This generally loosens the handling, and can be useful if understeer is a problem. Right-hand corners will see the opposite effect.    The Weight Jacker can be a useful tool for fine-tuning chassis balance on oval tracks as fuel burns off and tyres wear down. It’s not used on road courses, and is best used to fine-tune a car this is struggling with understeer or oversteer.
chinese: 重量转移器影响车身的对角荷重平衡，可用于调整车辆在椭圆赛道时的平衡。      将其调高可增加车头右侧及车尾左侧的负重。  这通常会增加在左弯进入时的低转向及出弯牵引。  将其调低可减少车头右侧及左车尾的负重。  这通常会让控制变容易，有助于解决转向不足。  右弯时则可看到相反效果。    在耗油且磨损轮胎的椭圆赛道中，重量转移器会是调整底盘平衡的有利工具。  它不会用于公路赛道，且最适合用于微调常常转向不足或转向过度的车辆。

english: The Steering Ratio represents the number of degrees of steering wheel movement required for one degree of front wheel rotation.     A higher Steering Ratio increases the amount of steering wheel movement needed, allowing for finer steering control. Decreasing the ratio will give more responsive steering, decreasing the amount of input needed, and making the car more sensitive to steering input.
chinese: 转向比代表前轮每旋转一度时，方向盘所需转动的度数。     较高的转向比会增加方向盘所需的动作，允许更佳的转向控制。调低转向比会让方向盘更灵敏，减少所需的动作，使车辆对于转向更敏感。

english: Caster Angle adjusts the side-view angle of the steering axis, with a Positive Caster Angle pointing the axis rearward at the top.    Positive Caster Angle will make the car more stable at high speeds and will increase camber gain with steering. Using too much positive Caster Angle will increase steering effort, making the car feel heavier and less responsive. Using a lower, positive Caster Angle will reduce both steering effort and jacking of the chassis with steering angle.     Most cars are not particularly sensitive to caster settings, so it’s best used in conjunction with other settings such as Camber Angles.
chinese: 后倾角调整转向轴的角度，从侧边视角来看，正后倾角代表轴心上方会指向车轮后方。    正后倾角会让车辆在高速时更稳定，增加转向的倾角增益。使用过多的正后倾角会导致转向变吃力，并感到车辆变重反应迟钝。使用较低的正后倾角会让转向变轻松，并减少底盘转移。     大部分的车辆对于后倾角较不灵敏，所以最好与外倾角之类的设定一起使用。

english: Camber Angle adjusts the angle of the wheel on the vertical axis, from a front-viewing angle, with negative Camber pointing the top of the wheel inward on the car.    Increasing the Camber Angle of the wheel can improve the car's cornering ability by compensating for sidewall flex and chassis roll through a corner, and maximising the tyre’s contact patch through a turn. Decreasing the Camber Angle of the wheel can improve acceleration and braking in a straight line, but comes at the detriment of cornering ability.
chinese: 外倾角调整车轮在垂直轴心的角度，从前方视角来看，负外倾表示车轮上方指向车辆内侧。    调高车轮的外倾角可抵销过弯时的胎侧弯曲及底盘侧倾，并实现最大轮胎接触面，进而提升车辆过弯能力。调低车轮的外倾角可提升直线时的加速及煞车，但会降低过弯能力。

english: Toe-In Angle adjusts the angle of the tyres pointing inward or outward from a top-down view.     Using Positive Toe-In (pointing the leading edge of the tyres inward towards each other) will make both wheels generate force against each other which gives better straight line stability, but at the expense of responsiveness. Using Negative Toe-In (pointing the leading edge of the tyres away from each other) will do the opposite, improving responsiveness and cornering ability, but making the car less stable in a straight line.     More negative or positive Toe Angle has an effect on tyre temperatures and also wear: The more negative or positive Toe Angle, the more the tyres will scrub across the track surface.
chinese: 调整轮胎的前束角，会决定俯视时轮胎指向内还是向外。     正的前束角 (车轮的前方指向内侧) 会让两个轮胎彼此产生抗力，让直线更加稳定，但会损失灵敏度。负的前束角 (车轮的前方指向外侧) 则相反，会提升过弯灵敏度及稳定性，但导致车辆在直线时较不稳。     过正或过负的前束角会影响胎温及磨损：前束角的正负调得越多，轮胎与赛道表面的摩擦就越多。

english: Ride Height allows you to adjust the height of the car above the track surface. Decreasing the Ride Height will lower the centre of gravity, add mechanical grip, increase overall stability, and improve aerodynamic performance. Generally, it’s always a case of “the lower the better”, but be careful, as lowering it too far reduces the amount of travel before the suspension or underside of the car bottoms-out on bumpy tracks, resulting in the car becoming unsettled. Adjust the front and rear Ride Heights to find the right balance for the track and also the car.    Ride height is a powerful tool in tuning the aerodynamics of many race cars. Flat-bottom cars benefit from forward rake (higher ride height at the rear) for increased downforce, particularly at the front axle. Cars with ground-effect tunnels tend to prefer a lower and more neutral ride height front-to-rear. Keep in mind that Ride Height should be tuned with speed in mind, as it will change at higher speeds when aerodynamics “push” the car down. Although the car may have rake in the setup, at high speed, the aero’ loads could be pushing things away from the desired position.
chinese: 底盘高度可调整车辆距离赛道表面的高度。 调低底盘高度会降低中心重力，增加机械抓地力，提升整体稳定度及空气动力性能。一般而言都是「越低越好」，但要小心过低会减少车辆悬挂系统或车底与颠簸赛道之间的距离，导致车辆变得不稳定。    调整前后底盘高度，并找出适合赛道及车辆的正确平衡。 底盘高度是许多赛车在调节空气动力时的强大工具。平底的车辆可获益于前倾 (后车身较高) 并提升下压力，特别是前轴。风扇车往往偏向于车身整体拥有较低且适中的高度。切记底盘高度应依据车速调节，因为高速时空气动力会将车身「压」低。车辆也许已设定为前倾，但空气动力的负重有可能导致设定无法发挥预期作用。

english: Changing the Spring Rate allows the tuning of the vehicle’s responsiveness and the attitude of the car through corners, leaning more towards either aerodynamic grip, or mechanical grip.  - Increasing Spring Stiffness will result in quicker, more responsive handling, and allow the car to run lower for better aerodynamics. However, this can also both decrease tyre grip, and increase tyre wear. Decreasing Spring Stiffness will make the chassis move around a little more, allowing it to maintain better contact with the track surface on bumpy tracks and increasing mechanical grip. However, this will require higher ride heights which, in turn, will decrease aerodynamic grip in higher speed turns.  - Adjust the front and rear Spring Rates to find the right balance for the track, the car, and your personal driving style. Having a softer rear decreases oversteer, but having it too soft could make it feel lazy and reluctant to rotate through a corner. It’s generally best to adjust the front and rear Spring Rates together.
chinese: 变更弹簧系数可调节车辆的灵敏度及过弯反应，使之拥有更多空气动力抓地力或机械抓地力。  - 调硬弹簧后，车辆的操控会更加灵敏快速，也让车身变得更低，可获得更佳的空气动力。但是这会降低轮胎抓地力及加快轮胎磨损。调软弹簧后，车身底盘会拥有更佳的弹性，进而与颠簸赛道保持良好的接触并提升机械抓地力。但是这需要较高的底盘高度，因此会减少高速弯的空气动力抓地力。  - 调整前后弹簧系数并找出适合赛道、车辆，以及你的驾驶风格的正确平衡。车尾较软可减少过度转向，但太软会反应迟钝以致过弯时转向不足。一般来说，最好是前后弹簧系数同步调整。

english: Adjustment of the Anti-Roll Bar allows you to control the amount of lateral chassis roll the car has when going through a turn.    Increasing the stiffness of the Anti-Roll Bar will keep the car more level in a turn and sharpen cornering response, but can potentially cause the inside wheels to lift off the ground in high-load corners. Decreasing the stiffness and running the Anti-Roll Bar softer will let the car roll more, increasing mechanical grip as more weight transfers to the outside tyres through a turn.     The Anti-Roll Bars are a useful chassis balancing tool. More roll resistance at the front (stiffer front and softer rear bars) can cause understeer, while more roll resistance at the rear can cause oversteer. A good rule of thumb for race cars is to set the Anti-Roll Bars such that the inside front tyre is just barely touching the track surface during high cornering loads.    For faster and smoother tracks, running stiffer Anti-Roll Bars can help maximise the aerodynamic grip by providing stable ride heights. For slower, bumpier, tighter tracks, running softer Anti-Roll Bars will increase mechanical grip.
chinese: 调整防倾杆可让你控制车辆过弯时的底盘侧倾量。    调硬防倾杆可让车辆急转弯时更灵敏且保持平衡，但有可能造成内侧轮胎在高负荷弯道时离地。调软防倾杆可让车辆更加倾斜，过弯时将重量释放至外侧轮胎，进而提升机械抓地力。     防倾杆是非常有效的底盘平衡工具。车头更多滚动摩擦时 (较硬前杆及较软后杆) 可能会造成转向不足，而车尾较多滚动摩擦时则会造成转向过度。将防倾杆设定至遇到高负荷弯时，前轮内侧看似几乎要碰到赛道表面的程度，是一个好的赛车经验法则。    遇快速平顺的赛道时，较硬的防倾杆可藉由稳定的底盘高度，实现最佳的空气动力抓地力。遇较慢的颠簸紧凑赛道时，较软的防倾杆可增加机械抓地力。

english: The Track Bar, or Panhard Bar, connects the chassis of the car to a solid rear axle. Adjusting the connection points changes how cornering forces are transferred from the chassis to the tyres.     Lowering the right side mounting point, without changing the left, means cornering forces from turning left will add grip on the rear axle, tightening the handling on corner entry. Raising the right side will generally loosen the car, and add oversteer during left-hand corners. The opposite happens for right-hand turns in both cases.    The Track Bar also sets the rear roll resistance, much like an anti-roll bar. Higher average Track Bar gives more roll resistance, while a lower Track Bar acts as a softer anti-roll bar.    For road courses, it is best to keep the values of the Track Bar equal on both the left- and right-hand sides of the car.
chinese: 止推杆将车辆底盘连接至坚固的后轮轴。调整接点会影响后轮转弯力如何从底盘释放至轮胎。     在不变更左侧的状况下调低右侧接点时，左转的后轮转弯力会增加后轮轴的咬力，使入弯时的操控紧缩。调高右侧一般会让车辆松弛，使进行左弯时的转向增加。相反的设定则会让进行右弯时发生同样的状况。    止推杆同时也可设置车尾的滚动摩擦，如同防倾杆。调高止推杆的平均值可增加滚动摩擦，而较低的止推杆的作用则会如同较软的防倾杆。    在公路赛道时，止推杆在车辆的左右数值最好保持相等。

english: The 3rd Spring controls the vertical chassis movement of the car when both wheels are moving upward from suspension compression due to driver input, downforce levels, and bumps on the track. This is particularly useful in high-downforce cars as it allows the car to handle the loads generated at high-speed without the need to use excessively stiff springs on each corner.    Increasing the 3rd Spring stiffness will resist vertical movement at that end of the car, potentially creating a more stable aerodynamic platform, but at expense of mechanical grip. Softening or removing the 3rd spring can improve mechanical grip, but risks the car bottoming out at high-speed and may allow chassis movement, which will reduce aerodynamic performance.
chinese: 轮胎因驾驶输入、下压力及赛道的颠簸，而自悬挂系统压缩上移时，第三弹簧会控制底盘的垂直运动。这特别有助于高下压力的车辆操控在高速下所产生的负荷，并且不需要使用过硬的弹簧来过每个弯道。    调高第三弹簧的硬度可抵制车尾的垂直运动，进而可能制造更稳定的空气动力，但会损失机械抓地力。调软或移除第三弹簧可增强机械抓地力，但会有车辆在高速时触地的风险，进而造成底盘运动并减少空气动力效能。

english: Adjustment of the Bump Stop is used to prevent the car from bottoming-out due to lower ride heights, softer spring rates, or strong dips and bumps on the track surface.     A longer Bump Stop will become engaged with less suspension movement, preventing the suspension from compressing any further by dramatically increasing the spring rate on that wheel.  This can help prevent the car scraping along the track surface, but mechanical grip and general handling balance may be negatively affected while riding on the bump stop.      As a general rule, set the Bump Stops long enough to help prevent the car bottoming-out, but not so long that they are active during normal driving.
chinese: 避震器缓冲垫用于防止车辆因低底盘高度、较软弹簧系数，或崎岖的赛道表面而触地。     较长的避震器缓冲垫会减少悬挂系统运动，藉由急速增加的弹簧系数防止悬吊系统压缩。  这有助于防止车辆与赛道表面摩擦，但使用避震器缓冲垫时，会影响到车辆的机械抓地力和一般操控平衡。      一般而言，将避震器缓冲垫设得够长可防止车辆触地，但不要设得过长而导致在正常驾驶时也发挥作用。

english: Slow Damping controls the car’s suspension compression in response to driver inputs. It controls the dynamic weight transfer and overall motion of the main chassis relative to the track surface when the car turns, slows, and accelerates. Most fine-tuning of the handling balance will be done with the Slow Damping settings.    Increasing the Slow Bump value will make the car react quicker and sharper in response to driver inputs resulting in a more responsive car when changing direction. Too much Slow Bump, however, can reduce mechanical grip, causing more “snappy” behaviour. It can also result in a car that is prone to sudden understeer when the front is too stiff, or sudden oversteer when the rear is too stiff.      Slow Rebound Damping controls the suspension extending back to its normal position after being compressed. Too much or too little Slow Rebound Damping for a given spring rate can cause the tyre to lose contact with the road, thereby reducing mechanical grip.    Adjust the front and rear Slow Damping to find the right balance for the type of circuit you’re on, and also your own driving style.
chinese: 慢速避震可控制驾驶输入时的悬挂系统压缩反应。当车辆过弯、减速或加速时，它能够依照赛道表面去控制主要底盘的动态重量转移及整体动态。大多操控平衡的微调将透过慢速避震设定进行。    增加慢速压缩的数值可让车辆对驾驶输入的反应更加快速敏锐，使车辆在变换方向时更灵敏。过多的慢速压缩避震则会减少机械抓地力，造成更多「暴怒」行为。车子在车头太硬时也有可能瞬间转向不足，车尾太硬时则可能瞬间转向过度。      慢速回弹避震控制因压缩而延伸回正常位置的悬挂系统。弹簧系数上过多或过少的慢速回弹避震有可能造成轮胎离地，进而减少机械抓地力。    调整前后慢速避震，并找出适合你的赛车场类型及驾驶风格的正确平衡。

english: Slow Damping controls the car’s suspension compression in response to driver inputs. It controls the dynamic weight transfer and overall motion of the main chassis relative to the track surface when the car turns, slows, and accelerates. Most fine-tuning of the handling balance will be done with the Slow Damping settings.    Increasing the Slow Bump value will make the car react quicker and sharper in response to driver inputs resulting in a more responsive car when changing direction. Too much Slow Bump, however, can reduce mechanical grip, causing more “snappy” behaviour. It can also result in a car that is prone to sudden understeer when the front is too stiff, or sudden oversteer when the rear is too stiff.      Slow Rebound Damping controls the suspension extending back to its normal position after being compressed. Too much or too little Slow Rebound Damping for a given spring rate can cause the tyre to lose contact with the road, thereby reducing mechanical grip.    Adjust the front and rear Slow Damping to find the right balance for the type of circuit you’re on, and also your own driving style.
chinese: 慢速避震可控制驾驶输入时的悬挂系统压缩反应。当车辆过弯、减速或加速时，它能够依照赛道表面去控制主要底盘的动态重量转移及整体动态。大多操控平衡的微调将透过慢速避震设定进行。    增加慢速压缩的数值可让车辆对驾驶输入的反应更加快速敏锐，使车辆在变换方向时更灵敏。过多的慢速压缩避震则会减少机械抓地力，造成更多「暴怒」行为。车子在车头太硬时也有可能瞬间转向不足，车尾太硬时则可能瞬间转向过度。      慢速回弹避震控制因压缩而延伸回正常位置的悬挂系统。弹簧系数上过多或过少的慢速回弹避震有可能造成轮胎离地，进而减少机械抓地力。    调整前后慢速避震，并找出适合你的赛车场类型及驾驶风格的正确平衡。

english: Fast Bump and Rebound Damping controls the tyre reactions over bumps and kerbs. Its job is to keep the rubber on the ground over rapid surface undulations. In bumpy sections of track, too much Fast Bump at the front can cause understeer, too much at the rear can cause oversteer.    To tune Fast Damping, pick a bumpy section of the track. Start with low Fast Bump and Rebound settings, and increase them until the front understeers, then back off a few clicks. Repeat this process for the rear until it oversteers on that bumpy section and, again, back off a few clicks. Now check the car’s response to the rest of the track, and over kerbs. This may require softer settings than the bumpy section: perfection is rare, and compromise is key.    Tune Fast Damping in sync’ with Spring Rate changes. The stiffer the spring, the stiffer the Fast Rebound setting.
chinese: 快速压缩及回弹避震，控制轮胎遇到颠簸或路肩时的反应。它的工作就是将轮胎保持在起伏不平的地面上。在赛道的颠簸路段时，车头过度的快速压缩会造成转向不足，车尾过度则会造成转向过度。    要调节快速避震时，可选择赛道的颠簸路段。从较低的快速压缩及回弹设定开始，一直增加到车头转向不足，然后往回点几下。车尾也重复此步骤直到在颠簸路段上转向过度，然后同样的，往回点几下。现在检查车辆在赛道其他地方及路肩的反应。与颠簸路段相比，这可能需要较软的设定：完美是罕见的，而妥协是必要的。    将快速避震与弹簧系数的变更同步调节。弹簧越硬，快速回弹的设定也越硬。

english: Fast Bump and Rebound Damping controls the tyre reactions over bumps and kerbs. Its job is to keep the rubber on the ground over rapid surface undulations. In bumpy sections of track, too much Fast Bump at the front can cause understeer, too much at the rear can cause oversteer.    To tune Fast Damping, pick a bumpy section of the track. Start with low Fast Bump and Rebound settings, and increase them until the front understeers, then back off a few clicks. Repeat this process for the rear until it oversteers on that bumpy section and, again, back off a few clicks. Now check the car’s response to the rest of the track, and over kerbs. This may require softer settings than the bumpy section: perfection is rare, and compromise is key.    Tune Fast Damping in sync’ with Spring Rate changes. The stiffer the spring, the stiffer the Fast Rebound setting.
chinese: 快速压缩及回弹避震，控制轮胎遇到颠簸或路肩时的反应。它的工作就是将轮胎保持在起伏不平的地面上。在赛道的颠簸路段时，车头过度的快速压缩会造成转向不足，车尾过度则会造成转向过度。    要调校快速避震时，可选择赛道的颠簸路段。从较低的快速压缩及回弹设定开始，一直增加到车头转向不足，然后往回点几下。车尾也重复此步骤直到在颠簸路段上转向过度，然后同样的，往回点几下。现在检查车辆在赛道其他地方及路肩的反应。与颠簸路段相比，这可能需要较软的设定：完美是罕见的，而妥协是必要的。    将快速避震与弹簧系数的变更同步调节。弹簧越硬，快速回弹的设定也越硬。

english: Bump and Rebound Transition allows for the advanced control of the switch from Slow to Fast Damping, without affecting their damping rates.    Increasing the Bump Transition will make the transition from Slow to Fast Bump longer: Here, the Slow Bump damper rate will act for longer before transitioning to the Fast Bump, and provide more overall damping. Decreasing the Bump transition will make the switch faster: Here, the Slow damper rate will act for a shorter period of time before switching to the Fast, and result in less overall damping.     If you tune this together with the Slow and Fast Bump, you can set the Slow Bump to a stiffer value with a low Bump Transition rate to achieve a stiffer initial damping, which then drops off quickly. For slower and more mellow initial damping, set the Slow Bump to a softer value, and use a higher transition rate.
chinese: 压缩及回弹转移可在不影响避震率的情况下，以进阶控制将慢速避震使为快速避震。    增加压缩转移可让低速压缩转移至快速压缩的时间更长：在此，慢速压缩避震率会在转移为快速压缩前维持更久，提供更多整体避震。减少压缩转移会使切换更快：在此，慢速避震率会在转移为快速前维持较短时间，提供更少整体避震。     如果你将此与慢速和快速压缩同时调节，你可以将慢速压缩调硬并以较低的压缩转移率达成更硬的初始避震，而后快速下降。需要较慢且较柔和的初始避震时，设定较软的慢速压缩值，并使用较高的转移率。

english: Rebound Transition allows control of the switch between Slow and Fast Rebound of the dampers, without affecting their damping rates.    Increasing the Rebound Transition will make the transition from Slow to Fast Rebound longer: Here, the Slow Rebound damper rate will act for longer before transitioning to the Fast Rebound, providing more overall damping. Decreasing the Rebound transition will make the switch faster: Here, the Slow Rebound damper rate will act for a shorter period of time before switching to the Fast, and result in less overall damping.     If tuned together with the Slow and Fast Rebound rates, setting the Slow Rebound to a stiffer value with a low Rebound Transition rate will result in a stiffer initial damping, which then drops off quickly. For slower and more mellow initial damping, set the Slow Rebound to a softer value, and use a higher transition rate.
chinese: 回弹转移可在慢速与快速回弹的避震中来回控制切换，且不影响避震率。    增加回弹转移可让慢速回弹转移至快速回弹的时间更长：在此，慢速回弹避震率会在转移为快速回弹前维持更久，提供更多整体避震。减少回弹转移会使切换更快：在此，慢速回弹避震率会在转移为快速前维持较短时间，提供更少整体避震。     如果与慢速和快速回弹率同时调节，以较低的回弹转移率将慢速回弹调硬会得到更硬的初始避震，而后快速下降。需要较慢且较柔和的初始避震时，设定较软的慢速回弹值，并使用较高的转移率。

english: This is the amount of fuel at the beginning of a race, beginning of a session, or when exiting the Pit lane in non-race sessions.     Having more fuel will allow the car to run for longer but it will have a negative effect on performance due to the extra weight. Rule of thumb is always to ensure you have enough fuel to go the distance required, as extra fuel adds weight, and weight has a negative effect on performance.
chinese: 这是比赛开始及非比赛时间离开维修通道时的油量。     更多的油可使车辆运行更久，但额外的重量会对性能有负面影响。确保你的油量足以走完所需距离一向是个经验法则，额外的油会增加重量，而重量会对性能有负面影响。

english: The Boost Pressure allows control over the power produced by the turbo or supercharger.     Having a higher Boost Pressure will increase the amount of airflow from the turbo to the engine, thereby increasing the power. This, however, will also use extra fuel, increase engine wear, and potentially make the car difficult to handle due to turbo lag. Decreasing the Boost Pressure will reduce the amount of airflow, decrease the power, use less fuel, help to reduce engine wear, and make the car easier to drive when the boost comes in.     Make sure to find a balance for the session or type of race entered. For Qualifying, for example, turn up the boost for more performance. For an endurance race, running lower Boost Pressure for fuel strategy and engine longevity may be best. Higher boost pressures may also require extra radiator cooling to avoid engine overheating.
chinese: 涡轮压力可控制由涡轮及超级增压器所产生的马力。     较高的涡轮压力会增加涡轮至引擎的气流，进而提升马力。但是，这也会消耗更多油量及加快引擎耗损，并可能因涡轮迟滞造成车辆不易掌控。降低涡轮压力会减少气流，降低马力，减少油耗，帮助降低引擎耗损，且在压力推进时更轻易掌控车辆。     确保你为加入的比赛及比赛类型找到平衡。以排位赛为例，将涡轮调高能获得更佳性能。以耐久赛而言，为了油量策略及引擎寿命，最好使用较低的涡轮压力。更高的涡轮压力为了避免引擎过热，有可能需要额外的水箱散热。

english: The Air Restrictor Diameter allows you to balance the car’s performance against other cars in the same class.     Lowering the Air Restrictor Diameter will decrease the amount of air getting into the engine and therefore reduce power. Increasing the diameter of the air restrictor will increase the airflow, increase power.     This is mainly used for Balance of Performance (BOP) purposes, but only applies to your own car.
chinese: 空气限流器让你可以平衡车辆与其他同等级车辆之间的性能。     调低空气限流器可减少进入引擎的空气，但相对会降低马力。增加空气限流器的直径会增加气流，并提升马力。     这主要是为了性能平衡制度 (BOP)，但只会套用到你自己的车子。

english: The Radiator Opening determines the amount of airflow into the radiator to cool the engine. This is important for managing both engine oil and water temperature. Bigger radiator opening means more engine cooling, but comes at the cost of aerodynamic drag, and reduced downforce.    Find a balance for the track, conditions, and type of race entered. Cooler conditions will allow the radiator opening to be run at a lower, and at a more closed, value. Damaging the car where the radiator is located can also reduce its effectiveness. The chance of blowing the engine if the water temperature rises too high is also heightened.
chinese: 水箱散热开口决定多少气流可通过水箱以冷却引擎。这对于掌控机油及水温很重要。更大的水箱散热开口代表引擎可更快冷却，但相对会产生气动阻力并减少下压力。    为加入的比赛类型及赛道和条件找到平衡。凉爽条件下，可以拥有较低和较小的水箱散热开口。伤害车辆存放水箱的部位也会降低其效能。水温如果升到太高时，引擎烧坏的机率也越高。

english: The Engine Braking Map setting will determine how much the engine works in the deceleration of the car off-throttle. This works as a bit of a compensation where the ECU opens the throttle slightly to reduce the amount of engine braking.     This is largely a driver preference setting. Low values result in greater braking torque from the engine when off-throttle, which may be desirable to achieve a slight trail-braking effect without using the brakes. Higher values give less engine braking torque, which may be beneficial in certain high speed corners to prevent changes in chassis balance when lifting off the throttle.    This does also have a slight effect on the amount of fuel used over the course of a lap.
chinese: 引擎煞车配置设定会决定车辆收起油门在减速时的引擎运作量。这能稍微帮助发动机控制器在油门微开时减少引擎煞车量。     这主要为驾驶偏好设定。低数值会使引擎在收起油门时造成更大的煞车扭力，能够在不使用煞车的情况下，实现轻微的后续煞车效果。高数值会给予较少引擎煞车扭力，有助于在高速弯放开油门时预防底盘平衡变动。    这也会些微影响赛场中单圈使用的油量。

english: The Final Drive Ratio adjusts the differential gear ratio, allowing the car to be dialed either toward acceleration or top speed. This ratio has an effect on all other gears.    Higher Final Drive Ratios allow more engine torque multiplication, increasing acceleration at the cost of a lower top speed. Lower Final Drive Ratios will give less wheel torque but will allow for a higher top speed.     Adjust the Final Drive Ratio so that the engine is just touching the rev’ limiter at the fastest part of the circuit. Too short a ratio means losing top speed. Too long a ratio means wasted engine power.
chinese: 最终传动比调整差速器齿轮比，让车辆准备好加速或达最高时速。此比例会影响其他所有齿轮。    较高的最终传动比会让引擎扭力倍增，提升加速但降低最高时速。较低的最终传动比会造成较少轮胎扭力，但可达到更高的最高时速。     调整最终传动比好让引擎在赛车场最快的路段，刚好抵达转速限制。太短的比例代表丧失最高时速。太长的比例代表浪费引擎马力。

english: Adjust the individual Gear Ratios so that the engine stays within its power band for as much of the track as possible. Higher ratios mean more acceleration, and less top speed.     As a general rule, set first gear up for getting off the grid with maximum acceleration, or for ideal acceleration out of the slowest turn on a track. Then set top gear so the engine is near peak power on the longest straight.      For the gears in between, there are two approaches. For some cars, it can be beneficial to select gear ratios so that there is no shifting gear mid-corner, as the act of shifting can upsets the chassis balance. This is less of an issue with modern, semi-automatic gearboxes, which mean ratios that give the best acceleration can be chosen: wider gaps for the low gears, which become closer the higher through the gearbox.
chinese: 调整个别的齿轮比好让引擎在赛道上尽可能保持最高动力。较高的比率代表加速更快，最高时速更低。    一般而言会先升档，以最大加速离开起跑位置，或以理想的加速离开赛道最慢的弯角。然后设定最高档位，好让引擎可在最长直线接近最高动力。      而中间的档位则有两个步骤。对一些车辆而言，选择齿轮比好让中角没有换档会是有益的，因为换档的动作有可能会扰乱底盘平衡。这对现代半自动变速箱而言就比较不是问题，因为可以选择提供最佳加速的比例：低齿轮间会有更宽的间隙，且越接近变速箱越缩小。

english: This allows for the adjustment of the red-line limit of the engine.     Increasing this allows for higher revs to be used in the engine, yielding more engine power at the cost of increased engine wear.     Set the rev’ limit to fit the type of race or session being run. Short races and qualifying sessions can sacrifice engine wear for the power increase. A lower rev’ limit is better for endurance races, to make sure the engine survives the distance.
chinese: 这里可以调整引擎红线限制。     调高后，引擎可使用更高转速，产出更多引擎马力，但会加快引擎耗损。     将转速限制设定为符合比赛类型。短程赛及排位赛可牺牲引擎耗损以换取马力。较低的转速限制适合耐久赛，确保引擎可撑过该距离。

english: This controls the amount of wheel slip allowed by the Traction Control system.    Lower values allow more slip, and are good for high grip situations: dry track, slick tyres, optimal weather.    High values cut power at lower wheel slip, and can be beneficial in low grip situations such as a wet track, or when tyre wear must be managed closely.
chinese: 这里可以控制牵引控制系统所允许的轮胎滑转量。    较高数值允许更多滑转，对于高抓地力情形是好的：干燥赛道、热熔胎、最佳天气。    低数值会减少马力使轮胎滑动降低，有助于如湿润赛道或需小心掌控胎损时的低抓地力情形。

english: This allows control of the strength of the Anti-Lock Braking System.     Increasing the value will make the system detect the wheels locking under heavy braking earlier, limiting the amount of tyre lock-ups, and retaining more cornering control for the driver. This is ideal for wet conditions on tarmac surfaces where the tyre is more sensitive to locking-up under heavy braking. Note: Increasing ABS strength does not automatically decrease the length of braking zones: in fact, it can make them longer as the system interrupts braking to a greater extent.    For loose surfaces, decreasing the ABS strength can help improve braking distances. This is because allowing the locking of the tyres will force them to dig into the surface, which stops the vehicle more quickly than if they were rotating on the surface of dirt, or deep snow, for instance.
chinese: 这里可以控制防死锁煞车系统的强度。     增加数值可让系统更快侦测到在重煞下死锁的轮胎，限制死锁的轮胎数，并为车手保留更多过弯掌控。这对于在湿滑柏油路上的条件非常理想，因轮胎对于在重煞下死锁会更敏感。注意：增加 ABS 强度不会自动减短煞车区的长度：事实上，由于系统在更大的程度上进行干扰，反而会让它们更长。    在松弛表面上，减少 ABS 强度可帮助提升煞车距离。这是因为允许轮胎死锁会使它们强制挖入地面，使它们在泥泞或厚重雪面旋转时更快停止车辆。

english: Adjusting the Fuel Map allows the control of fuel-flow into the engine, affecting power output, and also the mileage that can run on a single tank.     Increasing the Fuel Map allows more fuel-flow into the engine, producing more power, and increasing acceleration. This, however, comes at the expense of higher consumption. Decreasing does the opposite: The fuel will last longer, but the engine will produce less power.     This is particularly useful for pit strategy, and reducing the number of refueling stops required during a long race.
chinese: 调节供油曲线表可控制流入引擎的油量，影响马力输出，以及一桶可运行的里程数。     调高供油曲线表会让更多油流入引擎，产生更多马力并加快加速。然而，这样做的代价是油耗更高。调低则是相反：油量可支撑更久，但引擎会产生较少马力。     这对于维修站策略非常有用，并减少在长程赛时进站加油的次数。

english: This enables or disables a spool (locked differential).    Setting this to True will enable the use of a Spool which locks the differential, and forces the axles to spin at exactly the same speed. This helps to maximise traction when powering out of corners.  The tradeoff for this increased traction is reduced turning ability, as one side of the car will need to scrub the tyre across the track to follow a different path.    Setting this to False will disable the Spool, and keep the differential active, allowing the driven wheels to turn independently of each other.     Note: If the Spool is set to True, it will disable all other Differential options that are available on the car. Setting it to False allows the use and tuning of other Differential types.
chinese: 这里可启用或停用差速器锁定。    将设定设置为是会启用差速器锁定，强制轮轴以完全相同的速度旋转。这会帮助在加速出弯时实现最大牵引。  加大牵引的代价为降低过弯能力，因为车子的一侧需要在赛道上摩擦轮胎以跟上不同的路径。    将设定设置为否会关闭差速器锁定，保持差速有效，允许轮胎个别独立转动。     注意：如果差速器设定设置为是，将会停用车辆的其他差速器选项。设定为否则允许调节其他差速器类型。

english: This enables or disables a Geared Limited-Slip Differential. This is a torque-sensitive, mechanical differential which limits wheel-speed difference by biasing engine torque to the slower-spinning axle. If one tyre loses traction and begins to slip, the Geared LSD will sense this, and send a larger proportion of torque to the non-slipping tyre where it can be used more effectively. This Geared LSD biases torque only when needed, and consequently has less of an effect on vehicle handling than a Clutch LSD, or ratcheting locker.
chinese: 这里可以启用或停用齿轮式限滑差速器。这是一个扭力感应的机械差速器，藉由将引擎扭力分配至较慢旋转轴来限制轮胎差速。如果一个轮胎失去牵引开始滑行，齿轮式 LSD 会感应到，并传送更大比例的扭力至未滑行且可有效使用的轮胎。此齿轮式 LSD 只会在需要时分配扭力，因此与离合式 LSD 或棘轮锁定相比，较不影响车辆的操控。

english: This controls torque distribution of the Geared LSD when on-throttle.    Adjusting the Power Bias Ratio changes the amount of on-throttle torque that can be delivered to the tyre with better traction. For example, setting the Bias Ratio Power to a value of 3.0 will mean that the differential is capable of delivering up to 3.0 units of torque to the tyre, with better traction for every 1.0 units going to the slipping tyre.    Using a higher value will increase the locking effect when wheel-slip is detected, and a lower value decreases locking. Find a value which is high enough to prevent power loss from wheelspin on corner exit, but not with excessive locking so as to cause power-on understeer, or snap oversteer when both tyres suddenly lose grip.
chinese: 这里可以控制踩油门时齿轮式 LSD 分布的扭力。    调整马力偏差比会变更踩油门时，较好的牵引下传送至轮胎的扭力。例如，将偏差比马力数值设定为 3.0，代表差速器可传送高达 3.0 单位的扭力至轮胎，且每 1.0 单位以较好的牵引传送至打滑轮胎。    使用更高的数值会在侦测到打滑时增加锁定效果，较低则会减少锁定。找到够高的数值，好足以在出弯时防止打滑的马力损失，但不会过度锁定而造成动力转向不足，或双轮突然失去抓地力而瞬间过度转向。

english: This controls torque distribution of the Geared LSD when off-throttle.    Adjusting the Coast Bias Ratio changes how engine-braking torque is distributed between the tyres when off-throttle, and when slip is detected. This works in the same way as the Power Bias Ratio, where setting a ratio of 3.0 means the differential will send three times as much torque to the tyre spinning more slowly, but is active when the throttle is closed and the engine is outputting braking (negative) torque.    Higher values for Coast Bias Ratio will create a larger locking effect when off-throttle, increasing stability during turn-in, and corner entry. Too much locking in the coast phase, however, can lead to turn-in understeer. Lower values decrease the amount of coast-locking and can allow better turn-in, but can also potentially cause lift-off oversteer due to the lack of the stabilizing force.
chinese: 这里可以控制放油门时齿轮式 LSD 分布的扭力。    调整滑行偏差比会变更放开油门及侦测到打滑时，引擎煞车分布至轮胎的扭力。这和马力偏差比是相同原理，将比率设定为 3.0 代表差速器可传送三次扭力至转速较慢的轮胎，但只有在油门关闭和引擎释出煞车 (负) 扭力时才会启用。    较高的滑行偏差比会在放油门时制造更大的锁定效果，提升转弯及进弯稳定度。过多的滑行锁定则有可能导致进弯时转向不足。较低数值会减少滑行锁定并更轻易过弯，但可能因欠缺稳定力量而造成离地过度转向。

english: This enables or disables a Salisbury-type Clutch Limited-Slip Differential.     This type of differential uses the same components as an open differential, but adds a set of friction clutches to bind the two axle halves together. These clutches are activated by preload springs and cam-ramps, which convert engine torque into a locking “moment” across the differential.
chinese: 这会启用或停用锥型离合式限滑差速器。     此类的差速器与开放式差速器使用相同的组件，但增加了一组摩擦离合器以结合两个半轴。这些离合器由弹簧压紧的锥型齿轮启用，将引擎扭力转换成差速器上的锁定「瞬间」。

english: This controls of the amount of built-in lock applied to the differential clutches before any Power or Coast effects are added. As such, it will affect the balance of the car when cornering in a neutral throttle situation, and will also affect the smoothness of the transition going from off-throttle to on-throttle.    Low settings here will improve manoeuvrability, whilst a higher setting will reduce it. As long as the torque differential doesn’t overcome the preload, the differential remains locked.    Balance the Preload so it is high enough to give stability during neutral-throttle cornering, but low enough not to create excess understeer.
chinese: 这控制在马力或滑行效果加入时，有多少内建锁会套用到差速器离合器。因此，在中性油门状态下过弯时，会影响车辆的平衡，同时也会影响从放油门到踩油门的平稳性。    低设定会提升机动性，高设定则会减少。只要扭力差速器不要超过预载，差速器就会保持锁定。    将预载平衡，好足以在中性油门过弯时获得稳定性，且不至于过低而造成过多的转向不足。

english: This adjusts differential locking of the Clutch LSD when on-throttle.   - Lower ramp angles create more force on the clutch friction plates, increasing the locking effect.  This can improve acceleration out of corners by preventing the inside tyre from spinning, and sending power to the tyre with most grip instead. Too much locking effect can give power understeer in light-throttle situations by binding the axle too quickly.  - Higher ramp angles reduce side force on the clutches with 90° giving no locking effect on power, and thus effectively disabling this feature of the differential.  - Use a power ramp angle to give enough locking effect so that excess wheelspin is prevented on corner exit. Bear in mind the engine power when setting this value: an engine with low power may want lower, more aggressive ramp angles, as there is less torque to turn into a locking effect from the start.
chinese: 这里可以调整离合式 LSD 在踩油门时的差速器锁定。   - 较低的倾斜角度会对离合器片制造更多力量，提升锁定效果。  这可以透过防止内轮旋转增强出弯的加速，并以最大的抓地力将动力传递给轮胎。太多锁定效果会导致轴太快结合，在轻油门情况下造成动力转向不足。  - 较高的倾斜角度会以 90 度减少离合器侧边动力，使锁定效果无力，进而成功停用此差速器功能。  - 使用动力倾斜角度提供足够锁定效果，好预防出弯时的过多轮转。设定此数值时记住引擎马力：较低的引擎马力也许会需要更低，更强的斜坡角度，因为从一开始能变成锁定效果的扭力就比较少。

english: This adjusts differential locking of the Clutch LSD when off-throttle.     Lower ramp angles create more force on the clutch friction plates, thereby increasing the locking effect. This can help stabilize the car on corner entry by using engine braking to bind the axles together more tightly. Too much coast locking can lead to understeer during turn-in.    Higher ramp angles reduce side force on the clutches with 90° giving no locking effect on coast, and effectively disabling this feature of the differential.
chinese: 这里可以调整离合式 LSD 在放油门时的差速器锁定。     较低的倾斜角度会对离合器片制造更多力量，提升锁定效果。使用引擎煞车将双轴更紧密结合，可帮助稳定进弯。太多滑行锁定会导致进弯时转向不足。    较高的倾斜角度会以 90 度减少离合器侧边滑行，使锁定效果无力，进而成功停用此差速器功能。

english: Changing the number of clutches adjusts overall strength of the Clutch LSD without altering the relative Power and Coast ramp angles. Adding clutches simply multiplies the locking effect from the differential ramps: a setup with 4 clutches, for instance, provides double the lock of a setup with 2 clutches.    Preload torque is not affected by the number of clutches.
chinese: 变更离合器的数量可在不变动马力及滑行的倾斜角度下，调整离合器 LSD 的整体强度。增加离合器基本上会倍增倾斜差速器：以四个离合器为例，会提供两个离合器的双倍锁。    预载扭力不会受到离合器数量影响。

english: This enables or disables a Viscous Limited-Slip Differential.     This type of differential uses the hydrodynamic friction of plates spinning in a highly viscous fluid to generate a locking effect between the axles. When the two sets of plates are rotating in unison, no viscous force is created.  When the plates start rotating at different speeds, shear from the fluid creates a torque to resist this which is proportional to the amount of differential.    Viscous differentials are smooth as the locking is purely proportional to the amount of axle speed difference, and not dependent on torque output from the engine. They can not, however, prevent wheelspin before it has happened, as some slip is required to create the locking action, and the viscous friction of that action will consume some engine power.
chinese: 这里可以启用或停用黏性限滑差速器。     此类差速器利用在高度黏性液体的旋转片所产生的流体动力摩擦力，使轮轴之间产生锁定效果。两组旋转片的旋转一致时，不会产生黏性压力。  当旋转片以不同速度旋转时，释出的液体会制造与差速器成正比的扭力来抵抗。    粘性差速器非常平滑，由于锁定与轴速差成正比，不需依靠引擎的扭力输出。但是它们无法预防打滑，有些打滑必须先制造锁定动作，该动作的黏性摩擦力会消耗一些引擎马力。

english: This adjusts the amount of locking from the Viscous LSD. Units for this are locking torque per 50RPM of wheel-speed difference.    Higher viscous locking will add stability during turn-in, as well as traction on-power during corner exits. Too much, however, can cause too much resistance to chassis yaw which will create understeer, much like with a Spool. It can also cause excess drag on the driveline by generating too much viscous friction when not all of it is needed to balance the car.
chinese: 这里可以调整黏性 LSD 锁定的量。这个的单位是将扭力锁定在每 50RPM 的轴速差。    更高的黏性锁会增加进弯时的稳定度，以及加速出弯时的牵引。但是过多可能会对底盘偏航造成过多阻力并产生转向不足，与差速器锁定非常相似。当产出过多平衡车辆的黏性摩擦时，有可能会对传动系统造成过度的阻力。

english: The Rear Power Balance allows control of how much of the driven power is sent to the rear wheels in an all wheel drive (4WD) car.     Increasing the Rear Power Balance will bias more of the engine power towards the rear wheels, making them do more work in delivering the power to the road surface while also increasing power oversteer. Decreasing the Rear Power Balance will put less power to the rear wheels and more on the front wheels, thereby increasing understeer on-throttle.    Consider the track type and weather conditions when setting the Rear Power Balance. A dry track with fast corners may benefit from more Rear Power Balance to aid with corner exit, as the fronts are already under hard loads from cornering. A wet track, or one with slower turns, may better suit more power being sent to the front in order to get better launches off corner exits.
chinese: 车尾动力平衡可控制多少驾驶动力，传送到四轮传动车辆的后轮。     提升车尾动力平衡会将更多引擎马力分配至后轮，使动力传送至道路表面，同时增加过度动力转向。降低车尾动力平衡会对后轮释出更少动力，对前轮释出更多，进而增加踩油门时的转向不足。    设定车尾动力平衡时，将赛道类型及天气条件也纳入考虑。拥有急转弯的干燥赛道可藉由更多的车尾动力平衡协助出弯，因为前轮已处在过弯的重荷下。遇湿滑或拥有慢速弯的赛道时，最好将动力送至车头以便达到更好的出弯。

english: This allows the enabling or disabling of the Ratcheting Differential.     Setting this to True will enable the Ratcheting Differential, which is a simple differential type that fully locks up on-power while remaining fully open when coasting. This maximizes traction on power, like a Spool, while keeping the car nimble during cornering, like an open differential.  Drawbacks include the potential for notchy handling, as the transition from fully-locked to fully-open is abrupt, and controlled only by your right foot.
chinese: 这里可以启用或停用棘轮限滑差速器。     将设定设置为是会启用棘轮限滑差速器，是一种简单的差速器类型，能够完全锁定动力并在滑行时保持完全开启。这会最大化牵引动力，如差速器锁定一样，同时在车辆过弯时保持敏捷，如同开放式差速器。  缺点在于潜在的操控难度，因为要从完全锁定转至完全开启是一瞬间的，且仅由右脚操控。

english: Determine whether the length of the race is based on the number of laps, or based on time.
chinese: 决定赛道长度是基于圈数或时间。

english: Select the number of laps for the race. Minimum of 1 lap, maximum of 999 laps.
chinese: 选择赛事的圈数。最少 1 圈，最多 999 圈。

english: Determine the length of the race in Hours and Minutes. The minimum length is 5 minutes, the maximum length is 24 hours.
chinese: 决定赛事的小时与分钟长度。最短 5 分钟，最长 24 小时。

english: Configure the in-game date that the race will take place on.  - Current Date: The current real-life date.    - Default Date: A pre-programmed date as to when a main race takes place on that circuit. This date will always be the same for the specific track that is chosen.  - Custom Date: Allows you to enter a specific date. Warning: This has an effect on the Seasons option that will be used on the track.
chinese: 设置游戏内的赛事举办日期。  - 目前日期：目前现实生活的日期。    - 预设日期：该赛车场预先编排会举行正赛的日期。此日期在选定的赛道会永远相同。  - 自定日期：允许自行输入指定日期。注意：这会影响在赛道上使用的赛季选项。

english: Enter the specific in-game Day and Month the race will take place on.
chinese: 输入游戏内赛事举行的月与日。

english: The in-game start time for the session.
The speed at which time progresses during the session.
chinese: 赛事中时间进展的速度。

english: The choice for which season of the year the race will take place in. Warning: This has an effect on the Date Type option.
chinese: 选择赛事发生在一年四季中哪一季。注意：这会影响日期类型选项。

english: This allows you to select the number of weather slots to configure for the session. Minimum is 1 weather slot, maximum is 4 weather slots.
chinese: 你可以选择要设置在比赛中的天气空位数量。  最少为1个，最多则4个天气空位。

english: This will allow you to configure the weather for a specific slot in the session. The first slot is the weather that the session will start with, before progressing to the other weather types (if enabled) configured after it. If only one slot is configured, the weather will remain fixed to that condition throughout the entirety of the session.
chinese: 你可以为比赛的特定空位设置天气。  第一空位为比赛开始的天气，之后会进到其他天气类型 (如已开启)。  如果只有设置一个空位，整场比赛过程中，天气都会维持该条件。

english: This allows you to determine the speed at which the weather progresses from one slot to the next. With ‘Real Time’ weather, each slot represents the top-of-the-hour mark, with slot 1 being Hour 0 (the start of the race), slot 2 being Hour 1, slot 3 being Hour 2, etc. Accelerating the progression alters the speed at which time progresses: for example, 2x progression means each slot takes half the time, with slot 1 being hour 0, slot 2 being 30 minutes, slot 3 being hour 1, etc. The actual start point of the transition from one slot to another, and the time it takes to complete the transition, is random. The ‘Sync to Session’ option evenly spreads the number of selected weather slots across the session, and transition between them all within the session's duration.
chinese: 你可以决定天气自一个空位进展到下一个的速度。  在「现实时间」天气，各个空位都代表整点时间，空位1为0小时 (赛事的开始)，空位2为1小时，空位3为2小时，以此类推。  加快进度会改变时间进展的速度：  例如，2x进度代表各个空位需消耗一半时间，空位1为0小时，空位2为30分钟，空位3为1小时，以此类推。  实际从一个空位转到下一个空位的开始点，与转移所消耗的时间为随机。  在「同步至比赛」选项中会将选择的天气空位平均分配至比赛中，所有天气之间的转移时间会在比赛长度内。

english: Choose whether the start of the race will be a Standing or Rolling start.
chinese: 选择赛事为静态起跑或动态起跑。

english: Choose whether to enable or disable the Manual Formation Lap for the start of your race.
chinese: 选择开启或关闭赛事开始前的手动暖胎圈。

english: Choose whether to enable or disable a Mandatory Pit stop for your race.
chinese: 选择开启或关闭赛事中的强制停站。

english: This determines the length of the session that you are configuring in Hours and Minutes. The minimum length of an active session is 5 minutes, the maximum length of an active session is 24 hours.
chinese: 这决定你要设置的比赛小时和分钟数。有效比赛的最短长度为 5 分钟，最长长度为 24 小时。

english: The number of AI drivers you will compete against.
chinese: 要进行竞赛的 AI 驾驶数。

english: This setting defines the level of AI driver performance around corners for every condition.     The effect of this setting on AI speed on specific corners will be heavily dependent on how demanding the corner is for the car in use; it has little to no impact on AI performance for ex. when racing the Daytona Oval in the dry with a High Downforce Formula Car as the corners can be easily done flat-out in such cars and Skill isn´t a factor.    For a typical road course of average length (ex. Interlagos GP) each incremental point should result in AI lap times being one to three tenths per lap faster depending on the car.

The class of opponents you will be competing against:    - Identical Opponents: AI competitors race in the same vehicle that you have selected.    - Same Class: AI competitors race in the same vehicle class as the vehicle that you have selected.    - Multi-Class: Allows you to configure races with a maximum of 10 vehicle classes. The first slot always matches the vehicle class of the car you have selected in Vehicle Selection, but you can add 9 additional classes for the AI to compete with.

Your starting position for the race when a Qualifying session isn’t used:    - Player First: This places you on pole position.    - Player Middle: This places you in the middle of the grid.    - Player Last: This places you at the back of the grid.    - Player Random: This randomly places you in any position on the grid.    - Player Custom: This allows you to determine your exact starting grid position.
chinese: 没有排位赛时，你在赛事的起跑顺位：    - 玩家优先：这会把你排在杆位。    - 玩家中间：这会把你排在中间的起跑位置。    - 玩家最后：这会把你排在后面的起跑位置。    - 玩家随机：这会随机安排你的起跑位置。    - 玩家自定：这会由你决定精确的起跑顺位。

english: This option enables or disables the use of flags in the sessions.
chinese: 此选项可启用或停用比赛中的旗子。
