english: This option enables or disables the use of Track Limit penalties in the sessions.
chinese: 此选项可启用或停用比赛中的赛道限制处罚。

english: This option allows you to configure how much total Time Penalties can be accumulated before getting Drive Through penalties.
chinese: 此选项可设置在受到通过维修区处罚前，可累积的加时处罚。

english: This option allows you to configure how much the penalty system tolerates contact before penalising drivers.
chinese: 此选项可设置在受到处罚前，可允许的碰撞容许度。

english: This option allows you to enable or disable Drive Through penalties.
chinese: 此选项可启用或停用通过维修区处罚。

english: This option allows you to enable or disable penalties for crossing the white line that extends out onto the track at the exit of the Pit lane.
chinese: 此选项可启用或停用跨越维修通道出口延伸至赛道的白线，所受到的处罚。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Rallycross include:   Car Classes  - Rallycross.  - Rallycross Supercar Lites.    Tracks  - Rallycross tracks only.    Race  - 6 laps.  - Standing Start.    Opponent Settings  - 5 AI opponents.  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - Drive Through Off.  - Pit Exit Penalties Off.    Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    场地拉力赛的预设设定包含：   车辆等级  -场地拉力赛。  -场地拉力赛超轻量房车。    赛道选择  -限场地拉力赛道。    赛事  -6圈。  -静态起跑。    对手设定  -5名AI对手。  -对手范围设为相同等级。    常规与规则  -关闭通过维修区处罚。  -关闭出维修区处罚。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Indycar include:   Car Classes  - Indycar.    Track Select  - Oval track type.  - Circuit track type.    Race Settings  - 20 laps.  - Rolling Start.    Session Settings  - Practice On.  - Qualifying On.    Opponent Settings  - 31 AI opponents.  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.    Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    Indy赛车的预设设定包含：   -车辆等级  -Indy赛车。  -赛道选择  -限椭圆及环形赛道。  -赛事设定  -赛事  -20圈。  -动态起跑。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -开启排位赛。  -对手设定  -31名 AI 对手   -对手范围设为相同等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for GT include:   Car Classes  - GT cars only.    Track Select  - Circuit track types only.    Race Settings  - 20 laps.  - Rolling Start type.    Session Settings  - Practice On.  - Qualifying On.    Opponent Settings  - 29 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limited number of pit garages).  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.     Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    GT赛车的预设设定包含：   -限选择 GT 车辆。  -赛道选择  -限环形赛道。  -赛事设定  -5圈。  -动态起跑型。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -开启排位赛。  -对手设定  -29名AI对手   (视所选赛道及维修站限制数量可减少)。  -对手范围设为相同等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Endurance include:   Car Classes  - LMP1.  - LMP2.  - GTE.    Track Select  - Oval track type.  - Circuit track type.    Race Settings  - 1 Hour  - Rolling Start type.    Session Settings  - Practice On.  - Qualifying On.    Opponent Settings  - 31 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limited number of pit garages).  - Opponents Field set to Custom Class.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.     Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    耐久赛的预设设定包含：   -车辆等级  -LMP1。  -LMP2。  -GTE。  -赛道选择  -限椭圆及环形赛道。  -赛事  -1小时。  -动态起跑型。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -开启排位赛。  -对手设定  -31名AI对手  (视所选赛道及维修站限制数量可减少)。  -对手范围设为自定义等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Prototypes include:      - Selection of Prototype cars only.     - Track Select        - Circuit track types only.     - Race        - 10 Minutes.        - Rolling Start type.     - Session Settings        - Practice On.        - Qualifying On.     - Opponent Settings        - 29 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limit of pit garages).        - Opponents Field set to Same Class.     - Rules & Regulations        - All rules and regulations set to on.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    原型车的预设设定包含：   -限选择原型车。  -赛道选择  -限环形赛道。  -赛事  -10分钟。  -动态起跑型。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -开启排位赛。  -对手设定  -29名AI对手  (视所选赛道及维修站限制可减少)。  -对手范围设为相同等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Open Wheeler include:   Car Classes  - Open Wheel cars only, excluding Karts.    Track Select  - Oval track type.  - Circuit track type.    Race Settings  - 5 Laps.  - Standing Start.    Session Settings  - Practice On.   - Qualifying On.    Opponent Settings  - 19 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limited number of pit garages).  - Opponents Field set to Identical Car.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.     Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    开轮式赛车的预设设定包含：   -限选择开轮式赛车，卡丁车除外。  -赛道选择  -限椭圆及环形赛道。  -赛事  -5圈。  -静态起跑。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。   -开启排位赛。  -对手设定  -19名AI对手  (视所选赛道及维修站限制数量可减少)。  -对手范围设为相同车辆。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Touring Cars include:   Car Classes  - Touring Cars only.    Track Select  - Circuit track type only.    Race Settings  - 5 Laps.  - Standing Start.    Session Settings  - Practice On.  - Qualifying On.    Opponent Settings  - 25 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limited number of pit garages).  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.     Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    房车赛的预设设定包含：   -限选择房车。  -赛道选择  -限环形赛道。  -赛事  -5圈。  -静态起跑。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -开启排位赛。  -对手设定  -25名AI对手  (视所选赛道及维修站限制数量可减少)。  -对手范围设为相同等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Track Day include:   Car Classes  - Track Day A.  - Track Day B.    Track Select  - Oval track type.  - Circuit track type.    Race Settings  - 10 Mins.  - Standing Start.    Session Settings  - Practice On.    Opponent Settings  - 15 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limited number of pit garages).  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.     Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    赛道日的预设设定包含：   -限选择赛道日车辆。  -赛道选择  -限椭圆及环形赛道。  -赛事  -10分钟。  -静态起跑。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -对手设定  -15名AI对手  (视所选赛道及维修站限制数量可减少)。  -对手范围设为相同等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Road include:   Car Classes  - Road Cars only.    Track Select  - Excludes Rallycross and Kart Tracks.    Race Settings  - 5 Laps.  - Standing Start.    Session Settings  - Practice On.    Opponent Settings  - 15 AI opponents (or lower depending on track selected and limited number of pit garages).  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - All rules and regulations set to on.    Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    路车的预设设定包含：   -限选择路车车辆。  -赛道选择  -不包含场地拉力赛及卡丁车赛道。  -赛事  -5圈。  -静态起跑。  -比赛设定  -开启练习赛。  -对手设定  -15名AI对手  (视所选赛道及维修站限制数量可减少)。  -对手范围设为相同等级。  -常规与规则  -开启所有常规与规则。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: PLEASE SELECT THE TRACK YOU WISH TO DRIVE ON

Here’s where you decide how much fuel to add during your pit stop. The amount of fuel you can add during a pit stop is limited by the size of your car’s fuel tank. Also remember that the more fuel you add, the longer the pit stop.
chinese: 你可在此设定停站时要加多少油。进站时可加入的油量，会视你的油箱大小而有所限制。切记加入的油量越多，停站的时间就会越长。

english: Here’s where you decide which tyres to change during the pit stop.    Selecting:  All: Your mechanics will replace all four tyres  None: Your mechanics will replace none of your tyres  Front: Your mechanics will only replace the front tyres  Rear: Your mechanics will only replace the rear tyres
chinese: 你可在此设定停站时要更换的轮胎。    选择：  全部：技师会帮你更换全部四个轮胎  无：技师不会帮你更换任何轮胎  前：技师只会帮你更换前轮胎  后：技师只会帮你更换后轮胎

english: Setting this to YES means your mechanics will use the same tyre compounds on all four corners, no matter which corner is adjusted. Setting this to NO will allow the use of individual compounds on different corners of the car.
chinese: 将此设定为「是」时，技师会用同样的配方更换全部四个轮胎，不论之前是否有调整过。将此设定为「否」时，表示同意用不同的配方更换每个轮胎。

english: This is the tyre compound that you want the mechanics to fit during the pit stop.     Slick tyres are best for dry conditions: A hard compound tyre is better suited to hotter conditions than a soft compound. A Rain or Wet tyre is ideal for rainy track conditions. All-Terrain tyres utilize deeper and wider tread channels with soft rubber to grip on dirt and gravel surfaces. Winter tyres are suited to extremely cold conditions like snow. Ice tyres feature hundreds of 7mm studs for digging into frozen ground.
chinese: 此为你在停站时想要技师使用的轮胎配方。     热熔胎最适合用于干燥条件：与软配方相比，硬配方更适合燥热的条件。雨胎仅适用于雨天赛道条件。全地形轮胎利用更深更宽的胎纹配合软胶，增强在泥泞和碎石表面的抓地力。雪胎适用于如下雪的极度寒冷条件。雪胎拥有上百个用于嵌入结冰地面的 7 毫米金属钉。

english: This is the tyre pressure that you want your mechanics to set during the pit stop.  Warning: The pressure you choose here will be applied to your tyres irrespective of whether you are changing the tyres, or keeping the same set.
chinese: 此为你在停站时想要技师设定的胎压。  注意：不论是否要更换轮胎，都会套用所选择的胎压。

english: This allows for an override of the global Force Feedback settings that were configured in the Game Options. You can toggle this either ON or OFF. Having this option set to ON will allow you to change the Force Feedback of only the specific car being driven.
chinese: 这会覆盖游戏选项内设置的整体回馈力道设定。可将其切换为「开」或「关」。设定为「开」后，可变更指定车辆的回馈力道设定。

english: Volume allows for the adjustment of the Force Feedback’s “weight” by altering the shape of the Force Feedback curve. Increasing the volume setting will make the wheel feel heavier, but details such as road surface and kerbs will be less pronounced. Decreasing the volume setting will make the wheel feel lighter, but details such as road surface and kerbs will be more pronounced, while not affecting their overall firmness.    Volume presets are determined by the Flavour profile selected. How Volume affects the Force Feedback remains the same.
chinese: 使用大小改变回馈力道曲线，可调节回馈力道的「重量」。调高大小设定会增加方向盘的重量感，但会导致道路面及路肩的细节无法突显。降低大小设定会让方向盘感觉更轻盈，但路面及路肩的细节会更加显著，且不影响整体稳固性。    大小默认由所选的喜好资料决定。大小对回馈力道的影响保持相同。

english: Tone is the feeling of surface detail and tyre slip. Note that this is also dependent on the “Flavour” that was chosen in Game Options. The setting is an open sweep from Aligning Torque (Mz) force at “0” (where surface detail is more pronounced, but there is less feel when it comes to tyre slip), to Side Load (Fy) force at “1” (where there is a stronger feel with respect to tyre slip, but less surface detail). Find the balance that suits your own personal preference.
chinese: 调性是指路面及胎滑细节的触感。请注意这也是由游戏选项中选择的「喜好」决定。设定可自由从「0」回正扭力 (Mz) (路面细节较显著，但胎滑细节较无感)，转换到「1」侧载 (Fy) (对胎滑细节较有感觉，对路面细节则较无感)。找出最符合你个人偏好的平衡。

english: Ideal for drivers who are inexperienced in tuning a car’s setup.
chinese: 适合对车辆调校无经验者。

english: For full adjustment of the car's setup, and ideal for more experienced setup engineers.
chinese: 完整的车辆调校，适合对设定有较多经验的技师。

english: Adjustment of car-specific Force Feedback settings.
chinese: 车辆特定回馈力道调节。

english: For sharing and receiving car setups from players and friends.
chinese: 可分享或接受玩家或好友的车辆调校。

english: Select up to 10 Car Classes to participate in your Championship.
chinese: 为锦标赛选择高达 10 个车辆等级参赛。

english: Select NAME to add or change the Driver you want to edit. Select VEHICLE to configure the car and livery that the Driver will be competing with. Vehicle selection will be based on both the Car Classes you have chosen for the Online Championship, and also on whether you have “Identical Opponents” set in the Driver Roster Main Screen. Selecting DELETE will remove the Driver from the Online Championship.
chinese: 选择「名称」以加入或变更你想编辑的车手。选择「车辆」以设置车手竞赛用的车辆及涂装。车辆选择取决于你为在线锦标赛选择的车辆等级，以及你是否有在主画面的车手名单设定「相同对手」。选择「删除」会将车手自在线锦标赛移除。
将全部设定为与对手相同

english: Select NAME to add or change the Driver you want to edit. Select VEHICLE to configure the car and livery that the Driver will be competing with. Vehicle selection will be based on both the Car Classes you have chosen for the Online Championship, and also on whether you have “Identical Opponents” set in the Driver Roster Main Screen. Selecting DELETE will remove the Driver from the Online Championship.
chinese: 选择「名称」以加入或变更你想编辑的车手。选择「车辆」以设置车手竞赛用的车辆及涂装。车辆选择取决于你为在线锦标赛选择的车辆等级，以及你是否有在主画面的车手名单设定「相同对手」。选择「删除」会将车手自在线锦标赛移除。

english: Select TEAM NAME to add or change the name of the Team. Select DRIVER ROSTER to configure the Drivers that are competing for this Team, based both on the Drivers added to the Online Championship in the Driver Roster, and any Drivers that are not currently assigned to a Team. A Driver can only compete for one Team at any one time. Selecting DELETE will remove the Team from the Online Championship.
chinese: 选择「车队名称」以加入或变更车队名称。选择「车手名单」以配置为车队竞赛的车手，由在线锦标赛的车手名单及任何尚未指定车队的车手组成。一位车手同时间只可为一个车队竞赛。选择「删除」会将车队自在线锦标赛移除。

english: With this setting enabled, the engine will restart automatically in the case of a stall on-track. With this setting disabled, the driver will need to restart the car manually if the engine stalls.
chinese: 启用此设定后，在赛道上发生熄火状况时，引擎会自动重新发动。关闭此设定后，当引擎熄火时，车手必须手动重新发动车辆。

english: This will force all drivers in the lobby to use one of the interior cockpit views. No external views will be permitted.
chinese: 这会强制大厅内的所有车手，使用其中一个内部驾驶舱视点。不允许任何外部视点。

english: This will force the driving-line assist off for all drivers in the lobby. Having this option set to NO will allow drivers to use the driving-line assist if they have it enabled in their Game Options.
chinese: 这会强制关闭大厅内所有车手的行车线辅助。将此选项设为「否」时，车手如果有在游戏选项内启用行车线辅助，则允许使用。

english: This will force all drivers in the lobby to use the default setup for the car that they are driving. This will be applied to all rounds of the Championship. Drivers, however, will still be able to adjust their Force Feedback settings for their car.
chinese: 这会强制大厅内的所有车手，使用预设设定来驾驶车辆。这会套用至锦标赛的所有回合。但车手仍可为他们的车辆调节回馈力道设定。

english: This will force all drivers in the lobby to shift gears in the race, irrespective of whether the car has a manual, sequential, or semi-automatic gearbox. Having this option set to NO will allow the use of both manual and automatic gear shifting, depending on each driver’s preference which they have set in their Game Options.
chinese: 这会强制大厅内所有车手在赛事中换档，无论车辆为手排、序列式，或半自动变速箱。将此选项设为「否」时，可允许使用手动或自动换档，视各车手在自行游戏选项中的偏好而定。

english: This will force all cars to use their real-world driving aids, irrespective of each driver’s preferences. The driving aids cannot be turned on or off, but if the car allows for it in the car’s setup options, they can have their level of aggressiveness adjusted.
chinese: 这会强制所有车辆使用真实世界驾驶辅助系统，无视各车手的偏好。驾驶辅助系统无法开启或关闭，但如果车辆调校选项中允许此功能，则可调节其强度。

english: This will allow all drivers to make use of the Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) driving aid if set to YES. Setting this option to NO will force it off for all drivers. This option, however, is overridden by the “Force Realistic Driving Aids” setting.
chinese: 如果设定为「是」，所有车手将可使用防死锁煞车系统 (ABS) 驾驶辅助。设定此选项为「否」时，则会强制为所有车手关闭。但「强制真实驾驶辅助系统」设定会覆盖此选项。

english: This will allow all drivers to make use of the Traction Control (TC) driving aid if set to YES. Setting this option to NO will force it off for all players. This option, however, is overridden by the “Force Realistic Driving Aids’ setting.
chinese: 如果设定为「是」，所有车手将可使用牵引控制 (TC) 驾驶辅助。设定此选项为「否」时，则会强制为所有玩家关闭。但「强制真实驾驶辅助系统」设定会覆盖此选项。

english: This will allow all players to make use of the Stability Control (SC) driving aid if set to YES. Setting this option to NO will force it off for all players. This option, however, is overridden by the “Force Realistic Driving Aids’ setting.    Note: Stability Control (SC) will automatically enable both ABS and TC when SC is turned ON, as it requires both to function. Therefore if you Force both ABS and TC OFF but allow SC, players will still be able to make use of ABS and TC systems.
chinese: 如果设定为「是」，所有玩家将可  使用车身稳定控制(SC)驾驶辅助。  设定此选项为「否」时，则会强制  为所有玩家关闭。但「强制真实驾  驶辅助系统」设定会覆盖此选项。    注意：车身稳定控制(SC)设定为  「开」时，由于功能使用需求，会  自动启用ABS及TC。因此，就算强  制关闭ABS及TC单开启SC时，玩家  仍可使用ABS及TC系统。

english: This will allow cars to become ghosted and non-collidable if they either:  - Become stationary  - Drive in the wrong direction around the circuit  Setting this option to NO will keep collisions on, and cars will not become ghosted in the above scenarios.
chinese: 当符合以下条件时，车辆可以变成无法碰撞的幽灵车：  静止时  在赛车场反方向行驶时  将此选项设为「否」会保持碰撞开启，车辆将不会在以上条件变为幽灵车。

english: This will determine the type of damage that the vehicle can sustain. There are 4 options to select from:    - Off: Damage to the vehicle is disabled completely  - Visual Only: Damage is only applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics, and will not affect vehicle performance  - Performance Impacting: Damage is applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics and performance, but will not allow for any damage that will prevent race completion  - Full: Damage is applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics and performance. If enough damage occurs, the vehicle may not be able to complete the race
chinese: 这会决定车辆可承受的损伤类型。可自 4 种选项选择：    - 关：完全关闭对车辆的损伤  - 只有外观：损伤仅影响车辆美观，并不会影响性能  - 影响性能：损伤影响车辆的美观及性能，但不会导致无法完成赛事  - 完整：损伤影响车辆的美观及性能。损伤太多可能导致车辆无法完成赛事

english: This will determine whether the vehicle can suffer from mechanical failures on-track, such as a blown engine, gearbox failure, or suspension failure. Setting this option to ON will make it possible for mechanical failures to occur. Switching this option to OFF will prevent any mechanical failures from occurring.
chinese: 这会决定车辆在赛道上是否可承受机械故障，如引擎爆缸、变速箱故障，或悬挂系统失灵。设定此选项为「开」时，车辆有可能发生机械故障。设定此选项为「关」时，会预防任何机械故障发生。

english: This will determine whether the pit crew can make random errors, or the car sustain random failures, during a pitstop. Typical crew errors include dropped wheel nuts, slow tyre changes, while random car failures can include short-term battery failure. Switching this option ON will allow for these errors to potentially occur during a pit stop. Switching this option OFF prevents any pit stop errors from occurring.
chinese: 这会决定技师团队是否会发生随机失误，或车辆是否可承受进站时发生随机失误。一般的技师团队失误包含车轮螺帽掉落、换胎速度太慢，而随机车辆失误可能包含短暂电瓶故障。将此选项切换至「开」时，这些失误有可能在进站时发生。将此选项切换至「关」时，会预防停站时出现失误。

english: This will determine the amount of tyre wear that will occur whilst driving out on track. There are 3 settings to select from:  - Off: Tyre Wear is disabled  - Authentic: Tyres will wear at a real-life rate  - Accelerated: Tyres will wear at a faster than real-life rate
chinese: 这会决定在赛道上的轮胎磨损量。可自 3 种设定选择：  - 关：关闭轮胎磨损  - 真实：轮胎磨损率会和真实生活中一样  - 加速：轮胎磨损会比真实生活中来得快

english: This will determine whether or not fuel is used during a session. Switching this option to OFF prevents any fuel being used when out on track. Switching this option to ON will result in fuel being used at the vehicle’s real-life rate.
chinese: 这会决定比赛中是否使用汽油。将此选项切换至「关」时，会防止赛道上的油耗。将此选项切换至「开」时，油耗率会和真实生活中一样。

english: This will determine whether drivers will be forced to perform manual Pit stops. Setting this option to YES will mean that all drivers will have manual control when both entering and exiting the Pit lane. Setting this option to NO will mean that all drivers will have control taken away from them when entering the Pit lane where the AI will drive the car down Pit lane. Control will be returned to the driver upon leaving pit lane.
chinese: 这会决定是否强制车手执行手动停站。设定此选项为「是」时，所有车手可以手动控制进入及离开维修通道。设定此选项为「否」时，车手在进入维修通道时，将无法操控车辆，并由 AI 取代。离开维修通道时，车手即可再次进行操控。

english: This will determine whether drivers will retain control of the car after crossing the Start / Finish line at the end of a session in order to perform a manual cooldown lap. Setting this option to ON will allow drivers to keep manual control of the car after they cross the Start / Finish line. Setting this option to OFF will mean the AI will take control of the car after the driver crosses the Start / Finish line at the end of a session.     Warning: Drivers’ actions will affect their Online Reputation Grade during this cooldown lap period.
chinese: 这会决定车手在比赛结束穿越起点/终点线后，是否能继续操控车辆，以手动进行冷胎圈。设定此选项为「是」时，车手在穿越起点/终点线后能够继续操控车辆。设定此选项为「关」时，在比赛结束穿越起点/终点线后将改由 AI 操控。     注意：在此冷胎圈期间，车手的行动将会影响在线声望级数。

english: YOU NEED TO REACH AFFINITY STATUS TO GAIN ACCESS. CURRENT STATUS
chinese: 需要达成熟悉度条件方可进入。目前状态

english: The overall difficulty level of the AI.

Scales various AI behavioral variables. Lowering this setting reduces the aggression of the more aggressive AI drivers; raising it does the opposite.    Higher AI aggression settings lead to AI drivers being more determined to overtake, less willing to yield, quicker to react, and more likely to go off-track rather than back out in a tight situation.    For more realistic racing  Medium or High settings are recommended, Medium suiting heavier cars (GTs, Road cars), and High best for grippier classes (Formulas, Prototypes)..
chinese: AI 在竞速中对峙时的激进等级。

english: Allows the option to restart the session you are currently in.
chinese: 允许开启重新开始目前比赛的选项。

english: Steering Assistance automatically ensures there is enough steering input to make it around any corner, while ensuring that the driver retains control of the car’s steering.
chinese: 转向辅助会自动确保在任何弯道都有足够的转向力，同时确保车手可维持车辆转向的操控。

english: Braking Assistance automatically ensures that the car is braking and slowing so that it can make it around any corner, while also ensuring that the driver still retains primary control over the car’s braking.
chinese: 煞车辅助会自动确保车辆煞车及减速以通过任何弯道，同时确保车手仍握有车辆煞车的主导权。

english: Driving Assists acts as the parent control for ABS, Stability Control, and Traction Control.     There are 3 settings:  - Off: All 3 assists are switched OFF, and cannot be switched on when out on track.  - Full: All 3 assists are switched ON, but can be switched off and on when out on track.  - Authentic: The available driving assists will match the assists that come on the real-life car counterpart.
chinese: 驾驶辅助系统作为一母体，负责控制 ABS、车身稳定控制及牵引控制。     共有 3 个设定：  - 关：所有 3 种辅助都会关闭，且在赛道上时无法切换为开启。  - 完整：所有 3 种辅助都会开启，但在赛道上时可以切换为关闭。  - 真实：驾驶辅助系统所提供的帮助，将与车辆于真实生活中的相对应。

english: Anti-Lock Brakes (ABS) prevents the car’s wheels from locking up under braking. Switching this option to either LOW or HIGH will enable ABS and determine the assists strength (HIGH allowing less wheel lock up), but also allow you to toggle its setting when out on track. Switching this option OFF will disable ABS altogether.    Note: This setting may get overridden by game modes that have their own rules for assists, such as Time Trial, or Multiplayer lobbies and Online Championships where the host has forced off the ABS assist.
chinese: 防死锁煞车系统(ABS)会预防煞车时车辆轮胎发生死锁。  将此选项设定为高或低可启用ABS并藉此指定辅助强度(设定为高可减少轮胎发生死锁)，同时也可在赛场上时切换此选项。  将此选项切换至「关」时，会完全停用ABS。    注意：此设定可能会被其他游戏模式本身的辅助规则所覆盖，例如计时赛或可将ABS辅助强制关闭的多人大厅及在线锦标赛。

english: Stability Control (SC) reduces the chances of the vehicle sliding, particularly when cornering. If the beginning of a slide is detected, power is either cut, or small amounts of braking is applied to individual wheels to push the vehicle back to the desired direction, thereby regaining stability. Switching this option ON will allow you to enable or disable SC when out on track. Switching this option OFF will disable SC altogether.    Note: Stability Control (SC) will automatically enable both ABS and TC when turned ON, as it requires both to function. Also, this SC setting may get overridden by game modes that have their own rules for assists, such as Time Trial, or Multiplayer lobbies and Online Championships where the host has forced the SC assist off.
chinese: 车身稳定控制(SC)会减少车辆滑行的机率，尤其是过弯时。  当侦测到开始滑行时，动力将会被切断，或在每个轮胎上套用微量的煞车，以车辆推回期望的方向，进而重拾稳定度。  将此选项切换至「开」时，可在赛道上启用或停用SC。  将此选项设为「关」时，会完全停用SC。  注意：车身稳定控制(SC)设定为「开」时，由于功能使用需求，会自动启用ABS及TC。  此外，此SC设定有可能会被其他游戏模式本身的辅助规则所覆盖，例如计时赛或可将SC辅助强制关闭的多人大厅及在线锦标赛。

english: Traction Control (TC) monitors the rotational speed and traction of each wheel with electronic sensors.  If a wheel is losing traction (spinning more than its counterpart), TC reduces the power going to the wheel to help the vehicle regain traction.  Switching this option to either LOW or HIGH will enable TC and determine the assists strength (HIGH allowing less wheel spin), but also allow you to toggle its setting when out on track. Switching this option OFF will disable TC altogether.    Note: Stability Control (SC) will need to be disabled in the car if you wish to turn off Traction Control (TC). Also, this TC setting may get overridden by game modes that have their own rules for assists, such as Time Trial, or Multiplayer lobbies and Online Championships where the host has forced the TC assist off.
chinese: 牵引控制(TC)会以电子传感器控制每个轮胎的转速及牵引。   当轮胎失去牵引时(与对侧相比旋转过多)，TC会减少该轮胎的动力以帮助车辆重拾牵引。  将此选项设定为高或低可启用TC并藉此指定辅助强度(设定为高可减少轮胎打滑)，同时也可在赛场上时切换此选项。  将此选项设为「关」时，会完全停用TC。    注意：如果想要关闭牵引控制(TC)就必须停用车身稳定控制(SC)。  此外，此TC设定有可能会被其他游戏模式本身的辅助规则所覆盖，例如计时赛或可将TC辅助强制关闭的多人大厅及在线锦标赛。

english: Damage Type determines the type of damage that can be sustained by the vehicle. There are 4 options to select from:    - Off: Damage to the vehicle is disabled completely.  - Visual Only: Damage is only applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics, and will not affect vehicle performance.  - Performance Impacting: Damage is applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics and performance, but will not allow for any damage that will prevent the completion of a race.   - Full: Damage is applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics and performance. If enough damage occurs, the vehicle may not be able to complete the race.
chinese: 损伤类型会决定车辆所能承受的损伤类型。可自 4 种选项选择：    - 关：完全关闭对车辆的损伤。  - 只有外观：损伤仅影响车辆美观，并不会影响性能。  - 影响性能：损伤影响车辆的美观及性能，但不会导致无法完成赛事。   - 完整：损伤影响车辆的美观及性能。损伤太多可能导致车辆无法完成赛事。

english: Mechanical Failures determines whether the car can suffer mechanical damage which may eventually lead to complete failure whilst out on track. This can include a blown engine, gearbox failure, or suspension failure. Switching this option to YES will make it possible for mechanical failures to occur. Switching this option to NO will prevent any Mechanical Failures from occurring.
chinese: 机械故障决定车辆是否能够承受可能造成赛事终止的机械损害。  这包含引擎爆缸、变速箱故障，或悬吊系统失灵。  将此选项切换至「开」时，车辆有可能发生机械故障。  将此选项切换至「关」时，会预防任何机械故障发生。

english: Pit stop Errors determines whether the pit crew can make random errors and whether the car can suffer a random mechanical failure during a pit stop. Typical errors include dropped wheel nuts, slow tyre changes, and short term battery failures. Switching this option ON will allow for these errors to potentially occur during a pit stop. Switching this option OFF prevents any Pit Stop Errors from occurring.
chinese: 进站失误决定停站时，技师团队是否会发生随机失误，或车辆是否可承受随机机械故障。一般的失误包含车轮螺帽掉落、换胎速度太慢，以及短暂电瓶故障。将此选项切换至「开」时，这些失误有可能在停站时发生。将此选项切换至「关」时，会预防停站时出现失误。

english: Tyres Wear determines the amount of wear and tear that will occur whilst driving out on track. There are 3 options to select from:  - Off: Tyre wear is disabled.  - Authentic: Tyres will wear at their real-life rate.  - Accelerated: Tyres will wear at a faster than authentic, real-world rate.
chinese: 轮胎磨损决定在赛道上的轮胎磨损量。可自 3 种选项选择：  - 关：关闭轮胎磨损。  - 真实：轮胎磨损率会和真实生活中一样。  - 加速：轮胎磨损会比真实生活中来得快。

english: Fuel usage determines whether fuel is consumed during a session or not. There are 3 options to choose from:    - Off: By turning off this option, you will prevent fuel from being consumed on the track.  - x2, x3, x4, x5: These options accelerate fuel consumption by the multiplying number.  - Authentic: By setting this option, the vehicle will consume fuel at a rate similar to real life.
chinese: 燃油消耗决定比赛中是否会消耗燃油。  可自3种选项选择：    -关：此选项切换至「关」时，会防止赛道上的油耗。  -慢：此选项切换至「慢速」时，会使该车辆的油耗率变为标准真实生活的一半。   -真实：此选项切换至「真实」时，油耗率会和标准真实生活相同。

english: Auto Start Engine determines whether the engine will automatically restart after stalling. If this option is set to NO and you stall your vehicle, you will need to restart the engine with the Engine Start button. If this option is set to YES, the clutch automatically engages, and pressing the accelerator will automatically fire the engine back up.
chinese: 自动点火决定引擎熄火时是否会自  动重新发动。如果将此选项设定为  「否」，车辆熄火时将需要使用引  擎发动按钮重新点火。如果将此选  项设定为「是」，离合器会自动作  用按压加速器，并重新点火。

english: Flags determines the use of marshall and steward flags whilst driving out on track. The following flags can be displayed during the session:    - Green: Racing conditions begin/resume.   - Checkered Flag: Race has been completed.  - Yellow: Caution, crash/incident/obstacle ahead, slow down with no overtaking permitted.  - Yellow with Red Vertical Stripes: Debris, fluid or oil on track  - White: Slow car ahead on track.  - Blue: Faster car approaching from behind. Let them past safely at earliest opportunity.  - Black and White Diagonal: Warning for Unsportsmanlike conduct.  - Black: Penalty or Disqualification.  - Black with Orange Dot: Return to pits to service Mechanical problem/heavy damage.    Switching this option ON will allow the use of flags. Switching this option OFF prevents any flags from being enabled when out on track.    Note: This option does not affect Career, where Flags will be forced on in the Career game mode. This also won't affect Time Trial or Community Events, where they too have their own set of Rules.
chinese: 旗子决定在赛道上时是否使用赛事工作人员及赛事监管人员旗子。比赛中可展示下列旗子：    - 绿旗：赛车开始/暂停。   - 方格旗：赛事结束。  - 黄旗：警告，撞车/事故/前方障碍物，减速且不得超车。  - 红黄相间条纹旗：赛道上有碎石，湿滑或油滑  - 白旗：前方有慢车。  - 蓝旗：后方有领先车接近。尽早让他们安全超过。  - 黑白旗：警告车手行为违反运动精神。  - 黑旗：处罚或失格。  - 黑橘旗：返回维修区以修复机械故障/严重损害。    将此选项切换至「开」时，可使用旗子。将此选项切换至「关」时，会防止在赛道上时启用旗子。

english: If you exceed track limits and gain an advantage, a time penalty is applied unless you slow down in order to negate the advantage. The time penalty duration is dependent on the amount of time gained when leaving the track. Each time penalty is cumulative and added to the total time penalty. Exceeding the threshold of cumulative time penalties will result in a drive-through penalty.    Switching this option ON will make the Track Cutting Penalties active. Switching this option OFF prevents the Track Cutting Penalty from being applied.
chinese: 如果因超过赛道限制而获得优势时，必须减速以抵销该优势，否则将会收到加时处罚。加时处罚长度将根据离开赛道时所增加的时间。每一个加时处罚都会累积并计入总加时处罚。超过累积加时处罚的门坎时，将会受到通过维修区处罚。    将此选项切换至「开」会开启抄近路处罚。将此选项切换至「关」会防止受到抄近路处罚。

english: Drive-through penalties are received for infringements such as excessive track limit abuse, speeding in the Pit lane, or failure to follow warnings and instructions.  A Drive-through penalty requires you to drive through the Pit lane whilst keeping within the Pit lane speed limit. You must exit the pit lane without stopping, meaning Pit stops can not be performed whilst serving a Drive-through penalty.    Switching this option ON will make Drive-through Penalties active. Switching this option OFF prevents Drive-through Penalties from being applied in Custom Races.
chinese: 发生超出赛道限制、维修通道加速，或未能遵循警告及指示等违规时，会受到通过维修区处罚。  受到通过维修区处罚时，必须在保持速限下通过维修信道。必须在不停下的情况下离开维修通道，这代表受到通过维修区处罚时无法停站。    将此选项切换至「开」会开启通过维修区处罚。将此选项切换至「关」会防止受到通过维修区处罚。

english: The solid white pit exit line at the end of the Pit lane, which extends out onto the track, divides the Pit lane from the main track to prevent any collisions when exiting the pits. Crossing this pit exit line results in a penalty.     Switching this option ON will make the Pit Exit Penalty active. Switching this option OFF prevents any Pit Exit penalties from being applied.
chinese: 维修通道尾端延伸至赛道的白色实心出口线，会将维修通道及主要赛道分开，以防止出维修区时发生撞击。越过此维修出口线将会受到处罚。     将此选项切换至「开」会开启出维修区处罚。将此选项切换至「关」会防止受到出维修区处罚。

english: Choose whether other vehicles can collide with your vehicle, or not, when:  - Stationary for [X] seconds.  - Facing the wrong direction on track.    Switching this option OFF will remove all collisions on your vehicle, making it ghosted.
chinese: 选择其他车辆是否可撞击你的车辆：  - 静止 [X] 秒钟。  - 在赛道反方向行驶。    将此选项切换至「关」会排除车辆所有撞击，使车辆成为幽灵车。

english: Manual Pit stop determines whether or not you keep full control of the car in the Pit lane and during a Pit stop, requiring you to drive in, stop, and exit your pit box. Switching this option to YES gives you full control of your vehicle when in the Pit lane. Switching this option to NO removes any manual control of the vehicle when in the Pit lane, handing control to AI, until you cross the pit exit line, at which point you will resume complete control of your car.
chinese: 手动进站决定你在车辆进入维修通道和进站期间，是否保持对车辆的完全操控，并且自行驶入、停车及离开维修站。  将此选项切换至「开」时，你在维修通道时能完全操控车辆。  将此选项切换至「关」时，会在车辆进入维修通道时移除所有手动操控，并转由 AI 操控，直到跨过维修区出口线后，才重拾对车辆的完全操控。

english: Pit Stop Cinematic Cameras determines whether you want to view a pit stop with cinematic cameras.     Switching this option ON will allow the use of the cinematic cameras when you are in your pit box. Switching this option OFF results in a more immersive experience, keeping you in the same driving view you were in when entering the pit box.
chinese: 停站电影化镜头决定是否要以电影模式观看进站。     将此选项切换至「开」时，可以在进入维修站时使用电影化镜头。将此选项切换至「关」时，会保持进入维修站时的视角，让你更加身历其境。

english: Manual Cooldown Lap determines whether you keep control of the car when crossing the Start / Finish line at the end of the race. Switching this option to ON allows you to keep control of your vehicle after you cross the Finish line. Switching this option OFF gives the AI control of your vehicle after crossing the Finish line.
chinese: 手动冷胎圈决定在比赛结束穿越起点/终点线后，是否能继续操控车辆。将此选项切换至「开」时，你在穿越终点线后能够继续操控车辆。将此选项切换至「关」时，会在穿越终点线后改由 AI 操控车辆。

english: Select from 4 HUD level options,  each displaying different amounts of HUD information when out on track:  - Off  - Full  - Light  - Telemetry    The layout of the HUD and the displayed elements can also be adjusted from the Edit HUD Layout option in the Pause Menu when out on track.
chinese: 从5种信息显示等级选项中选择，在赛道上各显示不同数量的信息  显示：  -关  -全开  -精简  -遥测数据    在赛道外开启暂停菜单的编辑信息显示编排，可以调整信息显示要素及编排。

english: Display Units allows you to select between using Metric (km/h, kg) and Imperial (mph, lbs) measurements.
chinese: 选择使用公制 (km/h、 kg)或英制(mph、 lbs) 度量系统。

english: The Proximity Marker is an on-screen indicator that adjusts in colour and position depending on your opponent's location and distance behind you. This marker will fade from Green (far) through to Red (close) depending on the distance an opponent is to the rear of your car.    Switching Proximity Markers ON will allow the use of them whilst out on track. Switching the Proximity Markers OFF will disable their use when driving out on track. Note: This option is forced OFF when playing in VR.
chinese: 防撞指示器会在屏幕上，以不同颜色及位置，显示对手的地点和落后你的距离。取决于对手在你后方的距离，标记会从绿色(远)转变为红色(近)。    将防撞指示器切换至「开」可让你在赛道上时使用该功能。将防撞指示器切换至「关」会让你在赛道上时停用该功能。注意：使用VR进行游戏时该功能将强制关闭。

english: The Driving Line draws the best line around the circuit for you to follow. When you reach a corner or braking zone, the driving line colours indicate whether you need to slow down more (red) or can easily accelerate (green).     Switching the Driving Line Assist ON will allow the use of the assist whilst out on track. Switching the Driving Line Assist OFF will disable its use when driving out on track.
chinese: 驾驶线可在赛车场上画出所要遵循的最佳路线。接近弯道或煞车区时，驾驶线的颜色会告诉你是否需要多减速 (红线) 或是可轻易加速 (绿线)。     将驾驶线辅助切换至「开」可让你在赛道上时使用该辅助。将驾驶线辅助切换至「关」会让你在赛道上时停用该辅助。

english: The Turn Indicator is an on-screen assist to tell you what kind of corner is coming up next, indicating both its direction and severity.     Switching the Turn Indicator ON will allow its use whilst out on track. Switching the Turn Indicator OFF will disable it when driving out on track.
chinese: 转向指示是种屏幕辅助，会告诉你即将接近的弯道类型，并指示其方向和弯度。    将转向指示切换至「开」可让你在赛道上时使用该功能。将转向指示切换至「关」会让你在赛道上时停用该功能。

english: Starting Grid Lights shows an on-screen image of the starting lights and their sequence, allowing you to clearly see the start lights rather than trying to look out for the lights on the track itself.     Switching the Starting Grid Lights ON will allow them to appear on the HUD at the start of the race. Switching the Starting Grid Lights OFF will prevent them from appearing on the HUD at the start of the race.
chinese: 发车灯会在屏幕上显示起跑灯号及顺序，让你可以清楚看见灯号，不必找赛道上的实际灯号。    将发车灯切换为「开」可使其在赛事开始时显示于HUD。将发车灯切换为「关」可防止其在赛事开始时显示于HUD。

english: The Cockpit Wheel/Driver option is for toggling wheel and driver animations when in cockpit views. Switching this option ON enables full driver and wheel animations. Switching this option OFF removes the driver's arms and steering animations when in cockpit view. The steering wheel is also removed unless a display is fixed to the wheel, in which case it remains motionless in a fixed, centred position.
chinese: 将此选项切换为「开」会启用完整车手及轮胎动画。将此选项切换为「关」会在驾驶舱视角时，移除车手手臂及转向动画。方向盘也会被移除，但显示器固定在方向盘上时，方向盘会保持静态固定于中间位置。

english: The Race Engineer feeds you with various pieces of race information as well as motivational encouragement, where appropriate.     There are 3 options:  - Off: Race Engineer does not provide any race information.  - Authentic: Race Engineer race information is true to the era and motorsport.  - Always: Race Engineer provides all race information, regardless of era and motorsport.
chinese: 赛车技师会提供你各式各样的赛事信息，同时在适当时机给予鼓励。  共有3个选项：  -关：赛车技师不提供任何赛事信息。  -真实：赛车技师提供符合时代及赛事的真实信息。  -随时：赛车技师提供所有赛事信息，不管是否符合时代及赛事。

english: The Spotter feeds you information about the location of your opponents and their proximity around you.     There are 3 options:  - Off: Spotter does not provide any race information.  - Authentic: Spotter will be only used if found in the real-life motorsport.  - Always: Spotter will be used, regardless of motorsport.    Note: For the full functionality of the Rallycross spotter, make sure to enable the Rallycross Motorsport Preset in Custom Event or Custom Online Event.
chinese: 观察员会提供你对手位置，以及与你之间距离的相关信息。  共有3个选项：  -关：观察员不提供任何赛事信息。  -真实：观察员只有在真实赛事中存在时才会使用。  -随时：在任何赛事都使用观察员。  注意：如果要场地拉力赛的观察员完全发挥其功用，别忘了启用自定义赛事或自定义在线赛事的场地拉力赛赛事预设。

english: Radio Subtitles displays whenever the Race Engineer or Spotter is used in-game. Race Engineer and Spotter must both be switched ON for Subtitles to be available for selection.
chinese: 游戏内使用赛车技师或观察员时显示字幕。赛车技师及观察员皆需切换至「开」方可在选项中选择字幕。

english: The Pit stop Visual Cue indicates where your pit box is located in the Pit lane. Switching this option ON will highlight the location of your pit box. Switching this option OFF will hide this indicator, and you will have to identify your pit crew yourself.
chinese: 停站视觉提示会指示维修站在维修信道上的位置。将此选项切换为「开」会标记你的维修站位置。将此选项切换为「关」会关闭指示，你将需要自行辨识你的技师团队。

english: Select the manufacturer name of the controller that you are using.
chinese: 选择所使用控制器的制造商名称。

english: This will be the name of the controller model that you are using.
chinese: 这将是你所使用的控制器型号名称。

english: Select between Separate and Combined pedal options:   - Separate Pedals is for use when you have individual axis (i.e. pedals) for controlling the throttle and brake (and also clutch where applicable).   - Combined Pedals is for use if you only have a single axis, and need to combine both the throttle and brake to a single input.
chinese: 选择分离式或结合式踏板选项：   - 分离式踏板适用于拥有个别轴向 (例：踏板) 控制油门及煞车时 (以及离合器适用时)。   - 结合式踏板适用于拥有单一轴向，并需要将油门及煞车结合为单一输入时。

english: Select your preferred controller type and model from a list of Preset and Custom options.
chinese: 从默认及自定选项中，选择偏好的控制器类型及型号。

english: Automatic Clutch is an assist that will engage the clutch for you when changing gear (if the clutch is needed), as well as when in a stall situation. Switching this option ON will enable the use of the Automatic Clutch. Switching this option OFF will mean that you will have manual control of the clutch, and will need to engage it when changing gears in cars without sequential gear boxes, or in situations where the car is about to stall. If you have this option set to OFF, ensure you have the clutch as well as the engine start button assigned in Edit Assignments.
chinese: 自动离合器为进行换档时的辅助 (如需使用离合器)，也用于熄火状况。将此选项切换至「开」将启用自动离合器。将此选项切换至「关」代表将需要手动控制离合器，并且要在没有序列式变速箱，或在车辆即将熄火时，使车辆换档。如果将此选项设置为「关」，请确保在编辑按钮配置时有分配离合器及引擎启动按钮。

english: Gearing allows the selection between Automatic or Manual shifting. Manual gives you complete control when changing up and down through the gears. If you select Automatic, the vehicle computer will automatically change gears for you when needed.
chinese: 传动装置可允许在自动排档及手动排档之间做选择。手动可让你完全掌控升档或降档的切换。选择自动时，车辆的计算机会在需要时自动为你换档。

english: Inverted Gearing is for drivers who are happy with the preset controller configuration, but who want to swap round the shift up and down buttons.
chinese: 反转传动装置适合车手在对预设控制设定感到满意，但想要互换升降排文件按钮时使用。

english: Resets all control settings to default, removing any changes previously made.
chinese: 将所有控制设定重设为预设，移除之前的所有变更。

english: Adding a deadzone creates a range or area where input is ignored, affecting how much you need to rotate the steering wheel before input is detected. The higher the deadzone number, the greater this area, and therefore the more steering rotation needed before the wheel in-game begins to turn.
chinese: 增加死角会建立一个无视输入的区域范围，决定方向盘在侦测到输入前需要旋转多少。死角的数值越高范围就越大，代表更多的转向旋转才可使游戏内的方向盘开始转向。

english: Steering Sensitivity affects how much the vehicle’s wheels in-game turn in relation to your own steering wheel input. For the vehicle's wheels in-game to match your own steering input, set this to 50%. If you want the wheels to be more sensitive and turn more with less steering input, increase the Steering Sensitivity value. If you want the wheels to be less sensitive and turn less, requiring more steering input, decrease the Steering Sensitivity.
chinese: 转向灵敏度决定你的方向盘输入，如何影响游戏内车辆方向盘的转向。要让游戏内方向盘符合你的方向盘输入时，请将此设定为 50%。如果想要方向盘更灵敏，以更少的转向输入旋转更多，则增加转向灵敏度的数值。如果不希望方向盘过于灵敏，且希望能旋转少一点，则需要更多的转向输入，可藉由减少转向灵敏度的数值达成。

english: Adding a deadzone creates a range or area where input is ignored, affecting how much you need to press on the throttle before input is detected. The higher the deadzone number, the more movement needed before input-detection.
chinese: 增加死角会建立一个无视输入的区域范围，决定油门需采多少才会侦测到输入。死角的数值越高，侦测到输入前所需的动作就越多。

english: Throttle Sensitivity affects how much throttle is applied in-game in relation to your own throttle inputs. For the throttle amount used in-game to match your own throttle input, set this to 50%. If you want the throttle to be more sensitive upon initial application and require less input, increase the Throttle Sensitivity. If you want the throttle to be less sensitive upon initial application and require more input initially, then decrease the Throttle Sensitivity.
chinese: 油门灵敏度决定你的油门输入，如何影响游戏内套用的油门。要让游戏内油门符合你的油门输入时，请将此设定为 50%。如果想要油门的起始应用更灵敏，且只需少量输入，则增加油门灵敏度。如果不希望油门的起始应用过于灵敏，且需要大量起始输入，则减少油门灵敏度。

english: Adding a deadzone creates a range or area where input is ignored, affecting how much you need to press on the brake before input is detected. The higher the deadzone number, the more movement needed before input-detection.
chinese: 增加死角会建立一个无视输入的区域范围，决定煞车需采多少才会侦测到输入。死角的数值越高，侦测到输入前所需的动作就越多。

english: Brake Sensitivity affects how much brake is applied in-game in relation to your own brake inputs. For the brake amount used in-game to match your own brake input, set this to 50%. If you want the brake to be more sensitive upon initial application and require less input, increase the Brake Sensitivity. If you want the brake to be less sensitive upon initial application and require more input initially, then decrease the Brake Sensitivity.
chinese: 煞车灵敏度决定你的煞车输入，如何影响游戏内套用的煞车。要让游戏内煞车符合你的煞车输入时，请将此设定为 50%。如果想要煞车的起始应用更灵敏，且只需少量输入，则增加煞车灵敏度。如果不希望煞车的起始应用过于灵敏，且需要大量起始输入，则减少煞车灵敏度。

english: Adding a deadzone creates a range or area where input is ignored, affecting how much you need to press on the clutch before input is detected. The higher the deadzone number, the more movement needed before input-detection.
chinese: 增加死角会建立一个无视输入的区域范围，决定离合器需采多少才会侦测到输入。死角的数值越高，侦测到输入前所需的动作就越多。

english: Clutch Sensitivity affects how the clutch moves in-game in relation to your own clutch inputs. For the amount of clutch movement in-game to match your own clutch input, set this to 50%. If you want the clutch to be more sensitive upon initial input and move more initially, increase the Clutch Sensitivity. If you want the clutch to be less sensitive upon initial input and move less initially, then decrease the Clutch Sensitivity.
chinese: 离合器灵敏度决定你的离合器输入，如何影响游戏内的离合器启用。要让游戏内离合器符合你的离合器输入时，请将此设定为 50%。如果想要离合器的起始输入更灵敏并更快启用，则增加离合器灵敏度。如果不希望离合器的起始输入过于灵敏且较慢启用，则减少离合器灵敏度。

english: Speed Sensitivity allows you to adjust how sensitive your vehicle is in response to your controller steering input, and how much steering lock is applied, at high speed. A higher value will make the vehicle less sensitive with the wheels turning less at higher speeds. Using a lower value will make the car more twitchy and sensitive to input at high speed, as the wheels will turn more, and at a faster rate.
chinese: 速度灵敏度调节车辆对于控制器转向输入的反应灵敏度，以及高速时应用多少转向锁。较高的数值会降低车辆灵敏度，使轮胎在高速时转向较少。较低的数值会使车辆在高速时对输入更加颠簸敏感，方向盘会以更快的速率转向更多。

english: Damper Saturation artificially controls the weight of the wheel. Setting this to a higher value will make the wheel feel heavier, and setting it to a lower value will make it feel lighter.
chinese: 避震饱和可人为控制方向盘的重量。此数值设得越高，方向盘会越重，而设的越低则感觉越轻。

english: Controller Damping allows you to adjust how quickly you can steer from left to right, or right to left. Setting this to a higher value allows you to steer left and right quicker, and setting this to a lower value makes the steering slower.
chinese: 控制器避震可调节由左至右，或由右至左的转向速度。此数值设得越高，可让你左右转向越快，而设得越低则转向越慢。

english: Controller Vibration allows you to control the strength of vibrations / rumble of the gamepad controller when riding kerbs, going off-track, or over rough surfaces. A higher value increases the strength of the vibration, and a lower value decreases it with 0 being off.
chinese: 游戏手把振动可控制游戏手把控制器，在通过路肩、偏离赛道或经过不平路面的震动强度。较高数值会增加震动强度，而较低数值会降低，0 则为关闭。

english: If your controller or wheel has an RPM or Gear display attached, you can turn that display ON and OFF with this option.
chinese: 如果你的控制器或方向盘有附加每分钟转速或排文件显示，可在此选项将显示设为「开」或「关」。

english: Force Feedback replicates the forces that a driver experiences when driving a real vehicle, informing you as to how the vehicle reaction in response to your inputs.    There are 3 Force Feedback profiles (Flavours), each with their own preset settings:  - Immersive: Replicates the feel of road surfaces, kerbs, tyre slip, weight, and suspension movements felt through the steering wheel and as experienced in the real world.  - Informative: Designed to give more of a detailed feel of road surfaces, kerbs, tyre slip, weight, and suspension movements.  - Raw: Unfiltered Force Feedback, allowing you feel their full strength of the various forces felt by drivers.
chinese: 回馈力道会重现驾驶真实车辆时，车手所体验的力道，让你感受车辆对你的输入的反应。    回馈力道有3种档案 (偏好)，各有其预设的设定：  -身历其境：将真实世界的道路表面、路肩、胎滑、重量和悬挂系统动作体验，藉方向盘重现。  -信息化：给予更细腻道路表面、路肩、胎滑、重量和悬挂系统动作体验。  -原始：未经过滤的回馈力道，让你完整体验车手所感受到各式力道强度。

english: Field of View is the horizontal measurement (in degrees) of what can be seen by the camera. Select an angle between 35 (narrow) and 120 (wide) degrees.
chinese: 视野范围为镜头在水平度量 (依角度) 的可视范围。选择介于 35 (窄) 及 120 (宽) 的角度。

english: Speed Sensitivity enables the camera Field of View to adjust as you accelerate or brake, giving a greater sense of motion. This option determines the minimum Field Of View value at slower speeds.
chinese: 速度敏感度可让镜头视野范围，  在加速或煞车时进行调节，呈现  更佳的动静对比。此选项决定在  低速时的最低可视范围数值。

english: Speed Sensitivity enables the camera Field of View to adjust as you accelerate or brake, giving a greater sense of speed. This option determines the maximum Field Of View value at higher speeds.
chinese: 速度敏感度可让镜头视野范围，  在加速或煞车时进行调节，呈现  更佳的速度感。此选项决定在高  速时的最高可视范围数值。

english: Set the minimum speed at which the Field of Vision will start to adjust at when accelerating or braking.
chinese: 设定在加速或煞车时，视野范围开始调整的最低速度。

english: Set the maximum speed at which the Field of Vision will start to adjust at when accelerating or braking.
chinese: 设定在加速或煞车时，视野范围开始调整的最高速度。

english: As the car speed increases, the camera will begin to shake to give a greater sense of speed and emphasis on bumps.
chinese: 车速加快时，摄影机会开始摇晃以呈现更佳的速度感，并强调颠簸。

english: Define how much road surface bumps affect your vehicle. The lower the number, the less car and camera movement you will experience. The higher the number, the more car and camera movement you will experience.
chinese: 决定道路表面颠簸对车辆的影响程度。数值越低，感受到的车辆及镜头动作就越少。数值越高，感受到的车辆及镜头动作就越多。

english: Define how much the camera moves under g-forces caused by acceleration, braking, and cornering. The lower the number, the less g-force is applied to the camera: the higher the number, the greater the effect.
chinese: 决定在加速、煞车及过弯时，因 G 值离心力所造成的镜头动作。数值越低，摄影机受到的 G 值离心力越少，数值越高则越大。

english: A helmet is placed around the edge of the screen (in the Helmet cam), and the in-game sounds are dampened in order to replicate the experience of a driver wearing a helmet.
chinese: 显示驾驶头盔(车内视点)，游戏内的声音会重现车手戴上头盔的体验。

english: Replicating driver focus at high speed, the outer edges of the screen and cockpit become blurred, and only the track in front of you will remain in focus.
chinese: 为重现车手在高速时的焦点，屏幕及驾驶舱外围会变得模糊，唯有赛道前方会维持聚焦。

english: Replicating real-life driver head movement through corners, the Helmet looks towards the apex of the upcoming corner as you approach it. As you drive through the corner, the camera pans through and out towards the exit.     Select between 0-100 to adjust how much the camera moves when looking to the apex of a corner. The higher the number, the larger the movement.
chinese: 为重现现实车手在过弯时的头摆动作，接近弯道时头盔将会面向弯道顶端。通过弯道时，摄影机会扫过并朝向出口。     选择介于0-100的数值，来决定看向弯道顶点时的摄影机动作。数值越高，动作越大。

english: Replicating real-life driver head movement through corners, the Helmet tilts or leans in the direction of the apex of the upcoming corner as you approach it. As you drive through the corner and out towards the exit, the helmet returns to a more upright position.    Select between 0-100 to adjust how much the Helmet tilts or leans in the direction of the apex. The higher the number, the greater the amount of tilt or lean.
chinese: 为重现现实车手在过弯时的头摆动作，接近弯道时头盔会朝弯道顶端倾斜。通过弯道朝出口时，头盔会转正位置。    选择介于0-100的数值，来决定头盔倾向弯道顶点时的角度。数值越高，倾斜角度越大。

english: Replicating real-life driver head movement through corners, the Camera tilts or leans in the direction of the apex of the upcoming corner as you approach it. As you drive through the corner and out towards the exit, the camera returns to a more upright position.    Select between 0-100 to adjust how much the camera tilts or leans in the direction of the apex. The higher the number, the greater the amount of tilt or lean.
chinese: 为重现现实车手在过弯时的头摆动作，接近弯道时摄影机会倾向弯道顶端。通过弯道朝向出口时，摄影机会转正位置。    选择介于 0-100 的数值，来决定摄影机倾向弯道顶点时的角度。数值越高，倾斜角度越大。

english: The overall volume of the entire game, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 整个游戏的整体音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume when selecting or highlighting options in menus, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 选择或标记菜单选项时的音量，范围为100(最大)至 0(最低)。

english: The volume for the in-game music, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 游戏内音乐的音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of your own vehicle's engine when when driving on-track, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 在赛道上驾驶时的引擎音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of your opponent’s engine sounds, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 在赛道上驾驶时对手的引擎音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of transmission, suspension, and damaged component sounds, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 传动、悬挂系统及受损组件的音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of tyre sounds when sliding, locking and spinning, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 轮胎滑行、锁定、摩擦及旋转的音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of sounds when crashing into other cars or objects around the track, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 在赛道上撞击其他车辆或物体的音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of the track surfaces, grass, and gravel, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 赛道表面、草皮及碎石的音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of the sounds in the environment around the track such as crowds and Tannoy systems, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 赛道上群众及扩音器等环境音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: The volume of general, whoosh effects, and other miscellaneous sounds. This has a numerical value between 0 (lowest) and 100 (highest), with 100 as the default.
chinese: 一般、其他音效、飞快移动声及其他杂音。此数值介于 0 (最低) 至 100 (最大) 之间，100 为预设。

english: The volume level of the Pit Engineer and Spotter, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 技术团队及观察员的音量，范围为 100 (最大) 至 0 (最低)。

english: This enables or disables the use of a Post-Processing Filter to adjust the look of the game. This applies subtle changes in overall colour and contrast to the look of the game when turned ON, and removes it when turned OFF.
chinese: 这会启用或停用后制处理过滤器，启用时可调节游戏外观。设定为「开」时会套用细微变化至游戏整体色彩及对比，「关」时则会移除。

english: This enables or disables Sun Flare effects in exterior driving cameras and replays.
chinese: 这会启用或停用外部驾驶镜头及回放的光晕效果。

english: This enables or disables Sun Flare effects in interior driving cameras.
chinese: 这会启用或停用内部驾驶镜头的光晕效果。

english: This enables or disables Bloom, which accentuates glows and flares around bright objects, lights, and also car reflections.
chinese: 这会启用或停用泛光，启用时可突显明亮对象、车灯及车辆反射的光晕。

english: This enables or disables Heat Haze, also called a mirage, which is a hot air effect that creates distant shimmering just above ground level.
chinese: 这会启用或停用热霾，或称海市蜃楼，为热气流影响下在地面远处所产生的蒸腾现象。

english: This enables or disables the use of Global Specular Irradiance, which uses light sampled from around the camera to be fed back into the specular lighting of the world. For example, if the camera is passing a red building, there will be more red in the lighting on that side.
chinese: 这会启用或停用全局镜像辐照，启用时使用镜头周围的采光，并反应至世界的镜像光影。例如，当镜头通过红色大楼时，该侧会有更多的红色打光。

english: This allows the adjustment of exposure to make the scene brighter, or decrease the compensation to make the image darker.
chinese: 你可以调节曝光使场景更明亮，或减少曝光补偿使影像变暗。

english: This enables or disables Rain Drops appearing on the camera lens.
chinese: 这会启用或停用镜头上出现的雨滴。

english: This enables or disabled Vignette, which darkens the edges of the camera to draw focus towards the centre of the display.
chinese: 这会启用或停用晕影，启用后角落会变暗并将画面的焦点转向中央。

english: This enables or disables Crepuscular Rays, which are rays of sunlight that appear to radiate from the point in the sky where the sun is located.
chinese: 这会启用或停用云隙光，为太阳所在点所放射出的阳光。

english: This enables or disables dirt appearing on the camera lens, which is best seen when the camera is facing towards the sun.
chinese: 这会启用或停用镜头上出现的泥泞。

english: This enables or disables the mirrors of the car, which are best viewed from the cockpit.
chinese: 这会启用或停用车辆的镜子，最适于驾驶舱视角。

english: Set the screen resolution you would like your graphics set to. Your monitor or TV screen resolution will automatically be detected and and applied as default.
chinese: 将画面分辨率设定为你想要的画质。自动检测你的屏幕或电视分辨率，并设为默认。

english: Select whether you want to play the game in windowed, or full-screen mode.
chinese: 选择要以窗口模式或全屏幕模式进行游戏。

english: Select the quality of the textures displayed in-game. The higher the setting, the higher the resolution, and therefore the more detailed the textures displayed in-game.
chinese: 选择游戏内显示的纹理质量。设定越高，分辨率越高，因此会在游戏内显示更细致的纹理。

english: Texture filtering smoothes out textures by using the texture colours from nearby pixels. There are two types of texture filter available:    - Trilinear: Ensures a smooth transition in texture quality (aliasing) as the distance from the camera increases.  - Anisotropic: Also eliminates aliasing effects, but improves on Trilinear filtering by reducing blur and preserving details at wide and distant viewing angles. The higher the level of Anisotropic Texture Filtering, the better the results, but also the bigger the performance impact.
chinese: 纹理过滤会以外围像素的纹理色彩消除纹理。有两种纹理过滤可供使用：    - 三线性：随着与镜头距离的增加，确保纹理质量 (锯齿) 的平顺转移。  - 非等相性：同样消除锯齿效果，但改良三线性过滤，并以更广更远的视角减少模糊和保留细节。非等相性纹理过滤的等级越高，结果越好，但相对性能影响也越大。

english: V-Sync synchronises your framerate with your monitor’s refresh rate. Enabling this may cause input lag, but will prevent screen tearing and provide a more stable framerate if the framerate is varying wildly.
chinese: 垂直同步可让你的影格率与屏幕的更新速率同步。将此开启有可能会造成输入延迟，但会防止画面撕裂，并在影格率大幅变化时，提供更稳定的影格率。

english: MSAA minimises jagged objects while providing a good balance between performance and image quality.
chinese: 多重采样反锯齿 (MSAA) 会大幅减少锯齿对象，同时提供性能与影像质量之间的良好平衡。

english: Post AA has a minimal performance impact to achieve less jagged objects, but images may seem blurry and have less contrast. Using Post AA settings may be suitable for lower-end video cards.
chinese: 后制处理反锯齿 (PPAA) 以最小的性能影响减少锯齿对象，但影像有可能会模糊且拥有较低对比度。后制处理反锯齿适合使用于低端显示适配器。

english: Super Sampling provides the best looking smoothed edges, but is video card intensive, and may have a larger effect on performance compared to MSAA or Post AA.
chinese: 超级采样提供最佳的柔和边缘，但由于显示适配器要求，与 MSAA 及 PPAA 相比之下，可能会对性能造成更大的影响。

english: Select the quality of in-game wet surface reflections. The higher the setting, the clearer and more detailed the wet track surface reflections will appear.
chinese: 选择游戏内地面上的水面反射质量。设定越高，湿滑赛道上的水面反射就会更加清晰细腻。

english: Select the quality of in-game reflections seen on the car bodywork and windows. The higher the setting, the clearer and more detailed the reflections will appear.
chinese: 选择游戏内车辆车身及窗户的反射质量。设定越高，反射就会更加清晰细腻。

english: Select the level of detail for your own and opponents’ cars in-game. The higher the setting, the more detailed and smoother the car’s bodywork will appear.
chinese: 选择你和对手的车辆在游戏内的精细度等级。设定越高，车身显示更细腻柔顺。

english: Select the level of detail of trackside objects in-game. The higher the detail level, more trackside objects will appear in the scene.
chinese: 选择赛道旁对象在游戏内的精细度等级。精细度等级越高，场景中会出现越多对象在赛道旁。

english: Select the level of detail for the shadows in-game. The higher the detail level, the sharper and more accurate the shadows that will be displayed in the scene.
chinese: 选择游戏内影子的精细度等级。精细度等级越高，场景中的影子就会越清晰精准。

english: Motion Blur is an effect that accentuates the perception of speed and movement by blurring objects as you pass them, or move quickly in the camera's view.
chinese: 动态模糊是一种藉由通过对象使其模糊，或在镜头视角中快速移动，进而强调速度感及动感的效果。

english: Improves visual smoothness, preventing screen stutter by rendering frames in advance. The more frames that are rendered in advance, the smoother the image will appear, but at the cost of GPU performance.
chinese: 增强视觉顺畅，事先计算影格来预防画面跳格。事先计算越多影格，影像就会显得更顺畅，但会影响视觉处理器的性能。

english: Select your preferred grass detail level. The higher the setting, the more detailed and further away you’ll be able to see grass detail.
chinese: 选择偏好的草皮精细度等级。设定越高，便可从更远处看到更精细的草皮细节。

english: Select your preferred particle detail level. The higher the setting, the further away you’ll be able to see the particles, and the more detailed they will appear.
chinese: 选择偏好的粒子精细度等级。设定越高，便可从更远处看到粒子，且细节更多。

english: Select your preferred particle density level. The higher the setting, the more particles you’ll be able to see at any one time.
chinese: 选择偏好的粒子密度等级。设定越高，同时间可看到的粒子就越多。

english: This decides the number of pit crew members visible when in the Pit lane. You can select between the following options:   - None: Only the players lollipop man will be visible. No other pit crew members for the player or any other opponents around you in the pit lane will be visible.   - Player Only: Only the players full Pit crew will be visible. For all other opponents around you, only the lollipop man will be displayed.  - All: Both the player and all other opponents will have their full Pit crews visible.
chinese: 这决定在维修通道时可见的技师团队人数。你可从下列选项选择：   - 无：车手在维修信道时不会显示任何技师团队成员，或任何附近的其他对手。   - 仅限玩家：只显示车手的完整技师团队。附近的其他对手将会以棒棒糖显示。  - 全部：车手及对手都将完整显示各自的技师团队。

english: This allows you to Toggle ON or OFF the crowds at the side of the circuit.
chinese: 你可以将赛场旁的群众切换为「开」或「关」。

english: This allows for the ability to use menu selection functionality by looking at the UI when in the main menus. You can select between the following options:  - Off: This will disable gaze control of the VR headset, allowing menu selection and control to be operated normally via mouse, keyboard, controller, or wheel.  - Auto Select: This will allow you to look around the menu screen with the small reticule being controlled by your head movements. Hovering the reticule over a menu option for a short amount of time will select it.  - Manual Select: This will allow you to look around the menu screen with the small reticule being controlled by your head movements, but selection of that option will require you to press the associated “select” button on your mouse, keyboard, controller, or wheel.
chinese: 你可在主菜单观看用户界面时，使用菜单选择功能。  可选择下列：  -关：关闭VR头戴式显示器的凝视操作，允许正常使用鼠标、键盘、控制器、或方向盘操作菜单选项。  -自动选择：可使用头部动作控制光罩，检视菜单画面。将光罩停在菜单选项上一会后即可选择。  -手动选择：可使用头部动作控制光罩，检视菜单画面，但选择选项时需要按压鼠标、键盘、控制器、或方向盘「选择」按键。

english: This allows the adjustment of image clarity, with higher values creating a clearer and better looking picture in the VR display with smoother edges, but at the cost of performance. The highest value of 2.0 will give a better image quality, but may affect framerate and require more GPU performance. The lowest value will give you better framerates but will affect the quality of the image on the VR display.
chinese: 你可以调整影像清晰度，越高的数值下，VR 显示器将显示更清晰、优良、柔边的影像，但会影响性能。最高值 2.0 可提供更佳的影像质量，但会影响影格率并要求更高的视觉处理器性能。最低的数值会提供更佳的影格率，但会影响 VR 显示器的影像质量。

english: This allows for you to set whether you want the VR headset to be automatically recentered each time the game is started.
chinese: 你可以设定 VR 头戴式显示器，是否在每次游戏开始时自动置中。

english: This allows for you to set whether you want the view to automatically be recentered at the start of the race. You can select between the following options:   - Off: It will never automatically recenter the camera at the beginning of a race.  - Once: It will automatically recenter the camera at the beginning of the race, but will not recenter if the race is restarted.  - Always: It will automatically recenter the camera at the beginning of each race, including restarts.
chinese: 你可以设定视角是否在每次比赛开始时自动置中。你可从下列选项选择：   - 关：永远不在比赛开始时将镜头自动置中。  - 一次：会在比赛开始时将镜头自动置中，但比赛重新开始时不会置中。  - 每次：在比赛开始时将镜头自动置中，包含重新开始时。

english: This allows you to set how close to the camera you want objects to be rendered, determining how much the camera clips through objects. This may need to be adjusted if you have changed your Field of View (FOV) and/or camera position.     The lowest setting is 0.010 which allows for rendering of objects closer to the camera. The furthest setting is 0.100, which will prevent objects close to the camera from being rendered.
chinese: 你可以设定对象需要离镜头多远才能生成，决定镜头通过对象的程度。如果视野范围 (FOV) 或镜头位置有变更时，则需要调整。     最低设定 0.010 下，可生成接近镜头的物件。最远设定 0.100 下，不会生成接近镜头的对象。

english: Select if you want the game Audio being played through the speakers on the VR headset, either ON or OFF.
chinese: 选择「开」或「关」，决定是否要在 VR 头戴式显示器的耳机播放游戏音源。

english: This allows you to select how the game is displayed on the monitor or TV screen when using a VR headset. You can choose to either have it set to Full Screen, Windowed Mode, or OFF.
chinese: 你可以选择在使用 VR 头戴式显示器，游戏将如何显示于屏幕或电视上。你可以选择设定为全屏幕、窗口模式或关闭。

english: Gain determines how strongly, on a scale 0 - 100, you feel the Force Feedback. Adjust the Gain until you find a strength that suits your driving style, whilst also preventing Force Feedback clipping.
chinese: 增益会以 0-100 的范围，决定你可感受的回馈力道强度。调节增益直到找到符合你驾驶风格的强度，同时预防回馈力道过快。

english: 'Use Shared Memory' allows you to switch between allowing the game to connect with external applications that run with the game, and which versions of those external applications you wish to use. Set this to OFF if you aren't using any external applications. If the external application you wish to use was made for Project CARS, set this to “Project CARS 1”. If the external application was created for Project CARS 2, set this to “Project CARS 2”.
chinese: 使用「共享纪录」可让你决定是  否允许连接至支持此游戏的外部  应用，以及要使用哪一个版本的  外部应用。如未使用任何外部应  用，请将此设定为「关」。如欲  使用的外部应用是为Project CARS  而打造，请设为「Project CARS 1」。  如果该外部应用是为Project CARS 2  而打造，请设为「Project CARS 2」。

english: UDP Frequency sets how frequently data gets sent to the external applications you are connecting to. Setting this to a higher value will send data packets more often, and decreasing this to a lower value will send data packets at a slower rate decreasing network traffic.
chinese: 这会设定连接至外部应用的数据传送频率。数值设定越高，使用者数据报协议的频率就会更频繁，将数值减少则会以较慢的频率传送封包，并减少网络流量。

english: UDP Protocol Version allows you to toggle between which versions of external applications you wish to use. If you wish to use external applications that were made for and working with the first Project CARS game, set this to ‘Project CARS 1’. If you have applications that were created for the second game, set this to ‘Project CARS 2’.
chinese: 你可以在想要使用的外部应用中进行切换。如果你希望使用专为第一款 Project CARS 游戏打造的外部应用，则设定为「Project CARS 1」。如果你有专为第二款游戏打造的应用，则设定为「Project CARS 2」。

english: This allows you to determine whether the picture is stretched across the triple screen setup, or whether each screen renders the game individually.
chinese: 这可以决定影像是否要延伸至三屏幕设定，或是在各屏幕单独显示游戏。

english: This allows you to set the monitor's horizontal (width) pixel resolution.
chinese: 你可以设定屏幕的水平 (宽) 像素分辨率。

english: This allows you to set the monitor’s vertical (height) pixel resolution.
chinese: 你可以设定屏幕的垂直 (高) 像素分辨率。

english: This is the horizontal (width) measurement of the monitor (in centimetres).
chinese: 这是屏幕的水平 (宽) 测量 (公分)。

english: This is the vertical (height) measurement of the monitor (in centimetres).
chinese: 这是屏幕的垂直 (高) 测量 (公分)。

english: This is the horizontal (width) measurement of the distance between the right edge of the left screen display, and left edge of the centre screen (in centimetres). This should effectively be the measurement of the border between the left and centre screens.
chinese: 这是左屏幕的右边，与中央屏幕的左边之间的水平 (宽) 侧量距离 (公分)。这是左屏幕及中央屏幕之间边界的有效侧量。

english: This is the horizontal (width) measurement of the distance between the left edge of the right screen display, and the right edge of the centre screen (in centimetres). This should effectively be the measurement of the border between the right and centre screens.
chinese: 这是右屏幕的左边，与中央屏幕的右边之间的水平 (宽) 侧量距离 (公分)。这是右屏幕及中央屏幕之间边界的有效侧量。

english: This is the difference in height between the screen as it is positioned compared to the centre screen. This option will be disabled for the centre screen column.
chinese: 这是屏幕与中屏幕相比时的高度差异。此选项将在中央屏幕空位中被停用。

english: This is the angle of the rotated screen as compared to the centre screen. This option will be disabled for the centre screen column.
chinese: 这是旋转屏幕与中央屏幕相比时的角度。此选项将在中央屏幕空位中被停用。

english: If your output device’s setting is set to Stereo, enabling the Headphone Mix will provide a sound mix that is better optimised for use with stereo headphones.
chinese: 如果你的输出装置设定是立体声，启用耳机混音会提供立体声耳机更佳混音效果。

english: Accolades are earned by achieving certain goals in your Career. The level of accolade received – Gold, Silver, or Bronze – depends on the difficulty of the goal. You are able to view all accolades in your Career Dashboard.
chinese: 荣誉可藉由达成生涯中的指定目标获得。取决于目标的难度，获得三种荣誉等级：金、银或铜。你现在可在生涯统计表查看所有荣誉。

english: Lifetime Goals are special achievements attained by hitting major milestones, or specific criteria in your Career. You are able to view all Lifetime Goals in your Career Dashboard:
chinese: 终身目标是达成重大里程碑，或生涯中的特定标准后，而获得的特殊成就。你现在可在生涯统计表查看所有终身目标：

english: Affinity is unlocked by driving a particular manufacturer’s cars until you pass the threshold of accrued mileage. Once unlocked, you’ll receive a message informing you that you have achieved “Manufacturer Affinity”, which will then allow you to enter manufacturer-specific events and drives.
chinese: 熟悉度会在驾驶特定制造商车辆，直到达成累积里程的门坎时解锁。一旦解锁时，你将会收到讯息通知你已达成「制造商熟悉度」，并获准进入制造商特殊赛事及赛道。

english: This allows you to select the lobby type that you want to display in the online browser. You can select between the following options:
chinese: 你可以选择在线浏览器所显示的大厅类型。你可从下列选项选择：

english: This allows you to hide any lobbies that have been filled to their maximum player limit.
chinese: 你可以隐藏所有玩家数已满的大厅。

english: This allows you to hide any lobbies that are currently empty and have no players connected.
chinese: 你可以隐藏目前为空房且并无玩家联机的大厅。

english: This will allows you to search for lobbies that are running a specific car class. The following options can be filtered:
chinese: 你可以搜寻正在执行特定车辆等级的大厅。可以过滤以下选项：

english: This will allow you to search for lobbies that have a specific track type. The following options can be filtered:
chinese: 你可以搜寻有特定赛道类型的大厅。可以过滤以下选项：

english: This will allow you to search for lobbies that have races configured to specific lengths. The following options can be filtered:
chinese: 你可以搜寻有特定比赛长度的大厅。可以过滤以下选项：

english: Each driver has a network profile that stores all statistics and information.   Selecting this option will allow you to directly compare your:    - License details  - Performance summary  - Experience statistics  - Focus statistics  - Vehicle affinity  - Location affinity
chinese: 各车手皆有保存了所有成绩及资讯的网络个人资料。  选择此选项允许你直接比较你的：    -执照细节  -表现总结  -经验状态  -焦点状态  -车辆熟悉度  -场所熟悉度

english: To add another player to your friends’ list and network of friends, simply send them a Friend Request. If the player accepts your request, you will be able to invite them to Online Championships, as well as enjoy other player-interaction features such as Chat.
chinese: 要将另一位玩家加到你的好友列表及好友网络，只需对他们发送好友邀请即可。当该玩家接受你的邀请时，你将可邀请他们到在线锦标赛，并享受聊天等玩家互动功能。

english: Only available in multiplayer lobbies, the Vote to Kick option is a poll that determines whether a driver should be kicked out of the lobby. The way this works is simple: All drivers in the lobby are notified that a vote to kick the selected driver is about to take place. Voting is only possible during the voting time period, at the end of which, if enough votes to kick are made, the selected driver will be kicked from the lobby. If not enough votes to kick are made, the selected driver remains in the lobby.
chinese: 投票踢出选项是一种决定是否将某车手踢出大厅外的投票功能，仅限于多人大厅。运作方式非常简单：大厅内所有车手都接获通知，即将要投票是否踢出某一选定车手。  投票只可在投票期间进行，结束时如果票数足够，该车手将被踢出大厅。如果踢出的票数不足，该选车手将留在大厅。

english: Only available in multiplayer lobbies, Mute disables any VOIP communications from one, or a number of, selected drivers. Even if a driver is muted, they will still be able to send messages via Chat.
chinese: 静音可停用任何语音通话，不管是一个、多个还是选定车手的通话，限于多人大厅。车手遭静音时，还是可以传送聊天讯息。

english: In the Highlights section of the Driver Network profile, you can interact with your saved photos and replays, and view them fullscreen. You’ll also be able to manage and delete both your saved photos and videos from your profile.
chinese: 在车手网络个人资料的重点区块中，你可使用你保存的相片或回放，并以全屏幕观看。你也可以从你的个人资料管理及删除你保存的相片和影片。

english: Driver Network Comparison is a stripped-down version of the Driver Network Profile, and enables you to compare the following stats with another driver:    - Competitive License  - Performance Summary Stats  - Experience Stats  - Focus Stats  - Vehicle Affinity  - Location Affinity    Each section displays a direct comparison of each driver’s stats side-by-side. You can also choose to compare stats in Solo, Online, or Overall (Solo and Online combine) modes.
chinese: 车手网络比较是简化版的车手网络个人资料，让你可以与其他车手比较下列成绩：    - 竞争执照  - 表现成绩总结  - 经验状态  - 焦点状态  - 车辆熟悉度  - 场所熟悉度    各区块会直接左右对照车手的成绩。你也可以选择比较单人、在线或整体 (单人加线上) 的成绩。

english: Enter a unique lobby name that identifies the experience inside the lobby, and also serves to attract more drivers.
chinese: 输入一个独特的大厅名称，以代表大厅内的体验并吸引更多车手。

english: Setting a password for your lobby enables you to determine who joins, creating a more personalised experience.
chinese: 为大厅设定密码可让你决定谁可以加入，为你制造更多个人化体验。

english: Select who can find and join your lobby. There are 3 options to choose from:    Public: Anyone can join the lobby.  Friends Only: Only friends of the admin, or friends of players inside the lobby, will be able to join.  Private: Only players who are invited to join the lobby by the admin, or players inside the lobby, can join. This will also prevent the lobby from appearing in the Online Browser.
chinese: 选择谁可以看到及加入你的大厅。可自 3 种选项选择：    公开：任何人皆可加入大厅。  仅限好友：只有厅主的好友，或大厅内玩家的好友可加入。  私人：只有受到厅主或大厅内玩家邀请的玩家可加入。这也会防止大厅显示在在线浏览中。

english: Choose whether you want to allow for a Director and Broadcaster in your lobby, facilitating the possibility to record and/or live-stream sessions and races.
chinese: 选择是否允许总监或播报员加入大厅，协助录制或直播比赛及赛事。

english: With this setting enabled, the engine will restart automatically in the case of a stall on-track. With this setting disabled, the driver will need to restart the car manually if the engine stalls.
chinese: 允许自动发动引擎    启用此设定后，在赛道上发生熄火状况时，引擎会自动重新发动。关闭此设定后，当引擎熄火时，车手必须手动重新发动车辆。

english: This will force all drivers in the lobby to use one of the interior cockpit views. No external views will be permitted.
chinese: 强制车内视点    这会强制大厅内的所有车手，使用其中一个内部驾驶舱视点。不允许任何外部视点。

english: This will force the driving-line assist off for all drivers in the lobby. Having this option set to NO will allow drivers to use the driving-line assist if they have it enabled in their Game Options.
chinese: 强制关闭行车线    这会强制关闭大厅内所有车手的行车线辅助系统。将此选项设为「否」时，车手如果有在游戏选项内启用行车线辅助系统，则允许使用。

english: This will force all drivers in the lobby to use the default setup for the car that they are driving. This will be applied to all rounds of the Championship. Drivers, however, will still be able to adjust their Force Feedback settings for their car.
chinese: 强制预设设定    这会强制大厅内的所有车手，使用预设设定来驾驶车辆。这会套用至锦标赛的所有回合。但车手仍可为他们的车辆调节回馈力道设定。

english: This will force all drivers in the lobby to shift gears in the race, irrespective of whether the car has a manual, sequential, or semi-automatic gearbox. Having this option set to NO will allow the use of both manual and automatic gear shifting, depending on each driver’s preference which they have set in their Game Options.
chinese: 强制手动排档    这会强制大厅内所有车手在赛事中换档，无论车辆为手排、序列式，或半自动变速箱。将此选项设为「否」时，可允许使用手动或自动换档，视各车手在自行游戏选项中的偏好而定。

english: This will force all cars to use their real-world driving aids, irrespective of each driver’s preferences. The driving aids cannot be turned on or off, but if the car allows for it in the car’s setup options, they can have their level of aggressiveness adjusted.
chinese: 强制真实驾驶辅助系统    这会强制所有车辆使用真实世界驾驶辅助系统，无视各车手的偏好。驾驶辅助系统无法开启或关闭，但如果车辆调校选项中允许此功能，则可调节其强度。

english: This will allow all drivers to make use of the Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS) driving aid if set to YES. Setting this option to NO will force it off for all drivers. This option, however, is overridden by the “Force Realistic Driving Aids” setting.
chinese: 允许防死锁煞车系统 (ABS)    如果设定为「是」，所有车手将可使用防死锁煞车系统 (ABS) 驾驶辅助。设定此选项为「否」时，则会强制为所有车手关闭。但「强制真实驾驶辅助系统」设定会覆盖此选项。

english: This will allow all drivers to make use of the Traction Control (TC) driving aid if set to YES. Setting this option to NO will force it off for all drivers. This option, however, is overridden by the “Force Realistic Driving Aids’ setting.
chinese: 允许牵引控制 (TC)    如果设定为「是」，所有车手将可使用牵引控制 (TC) 驾驶辅助。设定此选项为「否」时，则会强制为所有车手关闭。但「强制真实驾驶辅助系统」设定会覆盖此选项。

english: This will allow all drivers to make use of the Stability Control (SC) driving aid if set to YES. Setting this option to NO will force it off for all drivers. This option, however, is overridden by the “Force Realistic Driving Aids’ setting.
chinese: 允许车身稳定控制 (SC)    如果设定为「是」，所有车手将可使用车身稳定控制 (SC) 驾驶辅助。设定此选项为「否」时，则会强制为所有车手关闭。但「强制真实驾驶辅助系统」设定会覆盖此选项。

english: This will allow cars to become ghosted and non-collidable if they either:  - Become stationary  - Drive in the wrong direction around the circuit  Setting this option to NO will keep collisions on, and cars will not become ghosted in the above scenarios.
chinese: 允许幽灵车撞击    当符合以下条件时，车辆可以变成无法碰撞的幽灵车：  - 静止时  - 在赛车场反方向行驶时  将此选项设为「否」会保持碰撞开启，车辆将不会在以上条件变为幽灵车。

english: This will determine the type of damage that the vehicle can sustain. There are 4 options to select from:  - Off: Damage to the vehicle is disabled completely  - Visual Only: Damage is only applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics, and will not affect vehicle performance  - Performance Impacting: Damage is applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics and performance, but will not allow for any damage that will prevent race completion  - Full: Damage is applied to the vehicle’s aesthetics and performance. If enough damage occurs, the vehicle may not be able to complete the race
chinese: 损害类型    这会决定车辆可承受的损伤类型。可自 4 种选项选择：  - 关：完全关闭对车辆的损伤  - 只有外观：损伤仅影响车辆美观，并不会影响性能  - 影响性能：损伤影响车辆的美观及性能，但不会导致无法完成赛事  - 完整：损伤影响车辆的美观及性能。损伤太多可能导致车辆无法完成赛事

english: This will determine whether the vehicle can suffer from mechanical failures on-track, such as a blown engine, gearbox failure, or suspension failure. Setting this option to ON will make it possible for mechanical failures to occur. Switching this option to OFF will prevent any mechanical failures from occurring.
chinese: 机械故障    这会决定车辆在赛道上是否可承受机械故障，如引擎爆缸、变速箱故障，或悬挂系统失灵。设定此选项为「开」时，车辆有可能发生机械故障。设定此选项为「关」时，会预防任何机械故障发生。

english: This will determine whether the pit crew can make random errors, or the car sustain random failures, during a pitstop. Typical crew errors include dropped wheel nuts, slow tyre changes, while random car failures can include short-term battery failure. Switching this option ON will allow for these errors to potentially occur during a pit stop. Switching this option OFF prevents any pit stop errors from occurring.
chinese: 停站错误    这会决定技师团队是否会发生随机失误，或车辆是否可承受进站时发生随机失误。一般的技师团队失误包含车轮螺帽掉落、换胎速度太慢，而随机车辆失误可能包含短暂电瓶故障。将此选项切换至「开」时，这些失误有可能在进站时发生。将此选项切换至「关」时，会预防进站时出现失误。

english: This will determine the amount of tyre wear that will occur whilst driving out on track. There are 3 settings to select from:  - Off: Tyre Wear is disabled  - Authentic: Tyres will wear at a real-life rate  -Accelerated: Tyres will wear at a faster than real-life rate
chinese: 轮胎磨损    这会决定在赛道上的轮胎磨损量。可自 3 种设定选择：  - 关：关闭轮胎磨损  - 真实：轮胎磨损率会和真实生活中一样  - 加速：轮胎磨损会比真实生活中来得快

english: This will determine whether or not fuel is used during a session. Switching this option to OFF prevents any fuel being used when out on track. Switching this option to ON will result in fuel being used at the vehicle’s real-life rate.
chinese: 油耗    这会决定比赛中是否使用汽油。将此选项切换至「关」时，会防止赛道上的油耗。将此选项切换至「开」时，油耗率会和真实生活中一样。

english: This will determine whether drivers will be forced to perform manual Pit stops. Setting this option to YES will mean that all drivers will have manual control when both entering and exiting the Pit lane. Setting this option to NO will mean that all drivers will have control taken away from them when entering the pit lane where the AI will drive the car down Pit lane.
