Control will be returned to the driver upon leaving Pit lane.
chinese: 强制手动停站    这会决定是否强制车手执行手动进站。设定此选项为「是」时，所有车手可以手动控制进入及离开维修通道。设定此选项为「否」时，车手在进入维修通道时，将无法操控车辆，并由 AI 取代。离开维修通道时，车手即可再次进行操控。

english: This will determine whether drivers will retain control of the car after crossing the Start / Finish line at the end of a session in order to perform a manual cooldown lap. Setting this option to ON will allow drivers to keep manual control of the car after they cross the Start / Finish line. Setting this option to OFF will mean the AI will take control of the car after the driver crosses the Start / Finish line at the end of a session.
chinese: 强制手动冷胎圈    这会决定车手在比赛结束穿越起点/终点线后，是否能继续操控车辆，以手动进行冷胎圈。设定此选项为「是」时，车手在穿越起点/终点线后能够继续操控车辆。设定此选项为「关」时，在比赛结束穿越起点/终点线后将改由 AI 操控。

english: Determine whether the length of the race is based on number of laps, or based on time.
chinese: 长度类型    决定赛道长度是基于圈数或时间。

english: Select the number of laps for the race. Minimum of 1 lap, maximum of 999 laps.
chinese: 圈数/长度    选择赛事的圈数。最少 1 圈，最多 999 圈。

english: By default the race weekend always consists of a race session. You can also choose to have a practice session. Once activated, you can set the duration, start time, time progression, and weather slots.
chinese: 练习赛    预设中，赛车周末都包含正式比赛。  你也可以选择来一场练习赛。  一旦启用，你可设定长度、开始时间、时间进展及天气空位。

english: By default the race weekend always consists of a race session. You can also choose to have a qualifying session. Once activated, you can set the duration, start time, time progression, and weather slots.
chinese: 排位赛    预设中，赛车周末都包含正式比赛。  你也可以选择来一场排位赛。  一旦启用，你可设定长度、开始时间、时间进展及天气空位。

english: Select how many opponents you want to race against, human or computer controlled (AI).
chinese: 起跑格上限    选择要与多少对手竞赛，真人或计算机操作 (AI)。

english: Select the maximum number of human opponents on the grid.
chinese: 真人对手上限    选择起跑格内的真人对手上限。

english: If you activate this option, any empty spaces on the grid will be filled by AI opponents.
chinese: 对手以 AI 填满    如果启用此选项，起跑格上的空位都会以 AI 对手填满。

english: This option allows you to determine whether sessions and races will count towards players’ Online Reputation, and their competitive license.     When this setting is set to ON, all other options will be set to their defaults and become non-configurable. Players’ actions and results will then count toward their competitive license. When this setting is set to OFF, you will be able to configure the various flags and penalties. Players’ actions and results will not count towards their competitive license.
chinese: 此选项将允许你决定比赛和赛事是否会纳入玩家的在线名誉，以及竞争执照。     当此设定设为「开」时，所有其他选项皆会被设为默认值且无法更改。玩家的行动及结果会反应在他们的竞争执照上。当此设定设为「关」时，你将可设置各式旗子和处罚。玩家的行动及结果不会反应在他们的竞争执照上。

english: Set the Minimum Online Reputation Grade that players will need to have acquired in order to join your lobby. This can only be set as high as your own reputation grade, or lower.
chinese: 设定玩家要进入你的大厅所需要的最低在线名誉等级。不能设定高于你目前的名誉等级。

english: Set the Minimum Online Reputation Strength that players will need to have acquired in order to join your lobby. This can only be set as high as your own reputation grade, or lower.
chinese: 设定玩家要进入你的大厅所需要的最低在线名誉强度。不能设定高于你目前的名誉等级。

english: The Track Map shows the layout of the track and the location of cars around you. Switching the Track Map ON will display the track map on the HUD when driving. Switching the Track Map OFF will hide it.
chinese: 赛地道图显示赛道的样式和你外围车辆的位置。将赛地道图设置为「开」，驾驶时赛地道图会出现在信息显示上。将赛地道图设置为「关」则会将其隐藏。

english: Lap Info displays information on the HUD about the current and other laps, during your session. There are the following options for this setting:   - Default: This will display the Lap Info widget on the HUD when using the Full HUD mode, in Time Trial, Practice and Qualifying sessions.  - On: This will display the Lap Info widget on the HUD in all HUD modes, except Telemetry mode. This will be visible in Time Trial, Practice, Qualifying and Race sessions.  - Off: This disables the Lap Info widget in all HUD modes and game modes or session types.  - Edited: This will automatically be selected when you make alterations to the HUD in the HUD editor, and will be displayed in the HUD modes you enabled it in and all game modes and session types, excludes Telemetry mode.
chinese: 单圈信息会在显示该赛事目前及其他单圈的信息。将单圈信息设置为「开」会在信息显示上列出信息。将单圈信息设置为「关」则会将其隐藏。

english: This is the distance from your eyes to the centre screen.
chinese: 这是您的眼睛与中央屏幕之间的距离。

english: Select VEHICLE to configure the car and livery that the Driver will be competing with. Vehicle selection will be based on both the Car Classes you have chosen for the Online Championship, and also on whether you have 'Identical Opponents' set in the Driver Roster Main Screen.     Selecting DELETE will remove the Driver from the Online Championship.
chinese: 选择「车辆」以设置车手竞赛用的车辆及涂装。车辆选择取决于你为在线锦标赛选择的车辆等级，以及你是否有在主画面的车手名单设定「相同对手」。    选择「删除」会将车手自在线锦标赛移除。

english: Select TEAM NAME to add or change the name of the Team.    Select DRIVER ROSTER to configure the Drivers that are competing for this Team, based on the Drivers added to the Online Championship in the Driver Roster, and any Drivers that are not currently assigned to a Team. A Driver can only compete for one Team at any one time.    Selecting DELETE will remove the Team from the Online Championship.
chinese: 选择「车队名称」以加入或变更车队名称。    选择「车手名单」以配置为车队竞赛的车手，由在线锦标赛的车手名单及任何尚未指定车队的车手组成。一位车手同时间只可为一个车队竞赛。    选择「删除」会将车队自在线锦标赛移除。

english: Begin the calibration process for your wheel controller.
chinese: 开始进行方向盘控制器的校准。

english: Begin the calibration process for your pedal controller.
chinese: 开始进行踏板控制器的校准。

english: Opponent Names displays the name of the driver above their car whilst driving out on circuit and are in close proximity to you. There are 4 options to choose from:  - Off:  Turns off Opponent Names completely and won't be displayed above their car.  - Multiplayer Only:  Enables Opponent Names when playing in Multiplayer game modes and keeps them disabled in Singleplayer game modes.  - Singleplayer Only:  Enables Opponent Names when playing in Singleplayer game modes, but keeps them disabled in Multiplayer sessions.  - On: Enables Opponent Names for all game modes when competing against other drivers.
chinese: 对手名称决定在赛场上接近你的车辆，是否在车辆上方显示车手名称。可自 4 种选项选择：  - 关：  完全关闭对手名称，不会在车辆上方显示名称。  - 限多人游玩：  进行多人游戏模式时启用对手名称，并在单人游戏模式时保持关闭。  - 限单人游玩：  进行单人游戏模式时启用对手名称，并在多人游戏模式时保持关闭。  - 开：在所有与其他车手竞赛的模式中启用对手名称。

english: Chat Box allows you to toggle the text chat appearing whilst driving out on track in Multiplayer sessions, displaying important messages about the sessions and any chat messages from players. Switching the Chat Box ON will allow the box to appear on the HUD whenever a new message is received. Switching the Chat Box OFF will keep it hidden from the HUD.
chinese: 聊天窗口可让你在进行多人赛事时，在赛道上切换至文字框，并显示赛事重要讯息及来自其他玩家的讯息。将聊天室窗切换为「开」，可在接收到新讯息时列于信息显示。将聊天室窗切换为「关」则会自信息显示中隐藏。

english: Chat Profanity Filter will remove any explicit text sent in the Chat Box during Mutliplayer sessions. Switching Chat Profinity Filter ON will prevent any explicit words from being displayed, replacing characters with an *.
chinese: 聊天禁语过滤将删除多人赛事期间，所有发送至聊天室的不雅言语。将聊天禁语过滤切换为「开」，可预防显示任何不雅言语，并以 * 取代。

english: Enhanced Mirror improves visual fidelity of the scene displayed in cockpit mirrors of the car, improving their visual quality and making details sharper, but it may impact frame rate performance.
chinese: 强化镜像可提升车辆驾驶座内的镜子所显示的场景视觉真实度，提高视觉质量并使细节更加清晰，但可能会影响影画面更新率的效能。

english: Duration Type allows you to set the session to be either distance or time-based.  The starting time of the session, along with how time passes within it, and the weather forecast can also be set on a per-session basis.  You can also choose whether to start on the grid or on a rolling start, whether all drivers perform a formation lap beforehand, and whether pit stops are mandatory and/or allow player control.
chinese: 长度类型可让你依照赛道长度或时间设定比赛。  赛事开始时间，时间流动的方式，以及天气预报都能够以个别赛事为基准进行设定。  你也可设定要在起跑点开始，或让驾驶预先进行暖胎圈的动态起跑，也可设定是否强制停站或让玩家控制。

english: Opponent Number sets the size of the grid that will participate in the event.  Opponent Skill adjusts the difficulty of the AI drivers. And you can use the Class and Field options to choose which vehicles they use and how they're distributed.  Use The Grid Layout and Grid Position values to then change where you'd like to appear amongst the pack.
chinese: 对手的数量会决定赛事中的起跑格数量。  对手技术会调整 AI 车手的难易度。而您可使用「等级」和「范围」选项选择他们可使用哪些车辆及如何分配。  使用起跑格样式及起跑顺位的数值来变更你出现在集团的位置。

english: By default, your race weekend will always consist of a race session. However, you can choose to also have a number of prior practice or qualifying sessions if you wish. Simply activate them on to include them in your event.  Duration Type allows you to set the session to be either distance or time-based.  The starting time of the session, along with how time passes within it, and the weather forecast can also be set on a per-session basis.  You can also choose whether to start on the grid or on a rolling start, whether all drivers perform a formation lap beforehand, and whether pit stops are mandatory and/or allow player control.
chinese: 预设中，你的赛车周末都会包含正式比赛。然而，你也可以选择安排一些预先练习赛或排位赛。只要启用它们即可将它们加入你的赛事。  长度类型可让你依照赛道长度或时间设定比赛。  赛事开始时间，时间流动的方式，以及天气预报都能够以个别赛事为基准进行设定。  你也可设定要在起跑点开始，或让驾驶预先进行暖胎圈的动态起跑，也可设定是否强制停站或让玩家控制。

english: The Rulebook allows you to assign regulations to your event from an existing, known motorsport.  Alternatively, choose Custom to define the regulations yourself including how penalties are incurred for incidents and exceeding track limits.
chinese: 规则手册可让你将现有的已知赛事规则，加到你的赛事中。  或是选择「自定义」来制定自己的规则，包含发生事故和超出赛道限制时的处罚。

english: With this setting enabled the tilt controls of the camera will be reversed.
chinese: 启用此设定会使摄影机的倾斜控制反转。

english: Select the type of controller that you are using.
chinese: 选择所使用控制器的类型。

english: Set the Minimum Competitive License that players will need to have acquired in order to join your lobby. This can only be set as high as your own Competitive License rating, or lower.
chinese: 设定玩家要进入你的大厅所需要的最低竞争执照。不能设定高于你目前的竞争执照等级。

english: Rules & Penalties allows you to determine the types of penalties that are given when out on track.     With this option ON, Penalties will be enabled by default and you will be able to customize them in the Custom Event and Online Custom Event game modes. With Rules & Penalties OFF, all penalties except those applied for Mandatory Pitstops and Joker Laps will be disabled.     Note: This option does not affect Time Trial or Community Events, which have their own set of Rules.
chinese: 常规与处罚可让你决定赛道上会受到哪些类型的处罚。     此选项设为「开」时，处罚将会预设为启用，你可在自定义赛事及在线自定义赛事模式中自行调整。常规与处罚设置为「关」时，会停用适用于强制停站及小丑圈以外的所有处罚。     注意：此选项不会影响自己设有常规的测时赛或社群赛事。

english: The In-Car Management (ICM) menu allows you to adjust a number of options and systems relating to your car and race, whilst driving out on track.     With this menu, you can adjust the following:   - Vehicle Features (ABS, TC, Fuel Map levels etc)  - Adjust Pit Strategy  - Adjust car specific Force Feedback settings  - Adjust Brake Bias and Anti-Roll Bar settings    Configuring a button to this assignment will allow you to access the ICM menu.
chinese: 车内管理(ICM)菜单可让你在赛道上时，调整多项与车辆及赛事相关的选项及设定。     在此菜单，你可调整以下内容：   - 车辆特性(ABS、TC、供油调节水平等)  - 调整进站策略  - 调整车辆指定回馈力道设定  - 调整煞车分配器及防倾杆设定    为此任务配置按键可让你进入ICM菜单。

english: Inside the cockpit of various cars are Motec LCD displays. These are often situated either behind or on the steering wheel, or on the centre dashboard of the car. These Motec displays often come with multiple pages of information, and assigning a button to this option allows you to toggle through the available pages. The information displayed on each page, and the number of pages is dependent on the car.
chinese: 在多款车辆的驾驶座内，是采用 Motec 液晶仪表显示器。通常位于方向盘的后方或上方，或是在车辆的中央仪表板上。Motec 显示器通常会有多页的信息，为此选项配置按钮可让你在可用页面之间进行切换。页数及每一页所显示的信息取决于车款。

english: Assiging a button to cycle the HUD allows you to cycle through the various preset HUD layouts. These include:  - Full  - Light  - Telemetry  - Off    Note: You can customize the arrangement and toggle the visibility of HUD elements displayed or hidden, for each of the above HUD layouts via the HUD Editor in the Pause Menu.
chinese: 为信息显示配置循环按键可让你循环浏览各种默认的信息显示。这些包含：  - 完整  - 光影  - 遥测  - 关    注意：你可透过暂停菜单中的信息显示编辑器，为以上信息显示样式自定义配置，并将信息显是要素切换为显示或隐藏。

english: If the car has a KERS (Kenetic Energy Recovery System) or a Push to Pass system available, assigning a button to this control will allow you to utilise the cars feature.     - For KERS systems, pressing and holding this button, will activate KERs for as long as the button is held. Recovery of energy is done under braking, but only so much KERS boost can be used over 1 lap.  - For Push to Pass systems, a single press of the button will deploy a boost for a limited time period. Be sure to keep an eye out on the HUD as to how many Push to Pass shots you have, as they are limited during a race.
chinese: 车辆拥有 KERS (运动能量回收系统) 或手动超车系统时，为此控制配置按钮可让你善用车辆功能。     - 在 KERS 系统中，按压此按钮会持续启用 KERS 直到放开按钮。能量可在煞车时进行回复，但一圈所能使用的 KERS 加速只有这些。  - 在手动超车系统中，单击按钮即可在一定时间内进行加速。切记要留意 HUD，检视所剩的手动超车使用次数，因为每场赛事都有次数限制。

english: If the car has DRS (Drag Reduction System) available, assigning a button to this control will allow you to utilise the cars feature.     Using a single press of the DRS button will active DRS, reducing the angle of a part of the the cars rear wing. This opens a gap to allow air to pass through, which reduces drag and increases top speed. This will however also decrease rear downforce and can make the car unstable when cornering.    If you have pressed the DRS button and the system is active, you can deactivate DRS by either pressing the button again, or by pressing the Brake which will close the DRS system automatically.
chinese: 车辆拥有 DRS (减少空气阻力系统) 时，为此控制配置按钮可让你善用车辆功能。     按一次 DRS 按钮即可启用 DRS，减少车辆部份尾翼的角度。此开口会让气流通过，减少阻力并提升最高速。但这也会减少后方下压力，并造成过弯时车辆不稳。    已按下 DRS 按钮且该系统已启用时，可藉由再按压一次按钮停用 DRS，或是煞车即可自动关闭 DRS 系统。

english: The Pit Speed Limiter is a system that will prevent the car exceeding the pit lane speed limit (60kph/37mph) when activated. This can be toggled On and Off at any time whilst in control of the car, and is especially useful when you have the Manual Pitlane Control option ON.
chinese: 维修站限速器系统启用时，可防止车辆超过维修通道速限 (时速 60 公里/37 英里)。这可在操作车辆时随时切换开关，在手动维修信道控制选项开启时特别有帮助。

english: FX affects the strength of surface detail. Note that this is also dependent on the “Flavour” that was chosen in Game Options. Using a higher setting will make the effects of surface detail, such as road bumps and curbs, stronger and more pronounced, but could potentially lead to clipping with larger and bigger force feedback spikes. Using a lower setting will make the effects weaker, preventing clipping and giving a smoother feeling to the force feedback when riding over bumps and curbs. Find the balance that suits your own personal preference whilst trying to avoid force feedback clipping during heavy cornering and curb usage.
chinese: FX 影响地面细节的强度。请注意这也是由游戏选项中选择的「喜好」决定。使用更高的设定会使颠簸和路肩的地面细节效果更加强烈显著，但也可能会造成超过负荷导致强大的回馈力道冲击。使用较低的设定会使效果减弱，会预防超过负荷并使颠簸和路肩的回馈力道更加平顺。找出符合你个人喜好的平衡，并避免通过急转弯和路肩时回馈力道超出负荷。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Karts include:   Car Classes  - Karts only.     Track Select  - Kart Tracks  - Suitable short track variations, excludes Point to Point tracks.    Race Settings  - 5 laps.    Opponent Settings  - 15 AI opponents.  - Opponents Field set to Identical Car.    Rules & Regulations  - Drive Through Off.  - Pit Exit Penalties Off.    Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据  所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    卡丁车的预设设定包含：   车辆等级  -仅限卡丁车。     赛道选择  -卡丁车赛道  -适当的短赛道变化，排除点到点赛道。    赛事设定  -5圈。    对手设定  -15名AI对手。  -对手范围设为相同车辆。    常规与规则  -关闭通过维修区处罚。  -关闭出维修区处罚。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: This allows you to select which playback device, or sound card output, you want to use for the games audio. This will automatically detect the same available outputs as what can be found in your Windows Sound settings, and allow you to use an alternate sound card or audio output to your system sounds. This is extremely useful for using multiple audio channels for video recording and editing, or live streaming. By default, this will automatically select the playback device you have currently selected and using.
chinese: 你可以选择要使用于游戏音效的  播放装置或声卡输出。这会自动  侦测与你的Windows音效设定相  同的可用输出，可以让你为你的  系统音效选用其他声卡或音源输  出。在使用多音频进行影片的录  制、编辑、或直播时会非常有帮  助。默认设定会自动选择目前选  择使用的播放装置。

english: Any changes to this option in-game, will be saved, and will take effect once you have returned to Race Central and have restarted a new session.
chinese: 游戏进行中对此选项的变更会进行保存，并会在返回赛车中心重新开始新赛事时套用。

english: Any changes to this option in-game, will be saved and will only take effect once you have restarted the game.
chinese: 游戏进行中对此选项的变更会进行  保存，并会在重启游戏时套用。

english: This allows you to determine whether the Pre-Race screen is displayed at the beginning of a race session. Set this option to ON if you want to allow players to be able to use the Pre-Race screen to adjust their tuning setup, pit strategies, or make final adjustments to their game options before the race begins. Set this option to OFF if you wish to prevent the Pre-Race screen from being displayed. This will mean you and the other players in your lobby will move straight onto the grid at the beginning of a race.
chinese: 你可决定预赛画面是否要显示于赛事开头。  将此选项设定为「开」可让玩家在预赛画面中调整他们的设定、进站策略、或对游戏选项做最后的调整。  将此选项设定为「关」可防止预赛画面显示。  这代表你和位于你的大厅的玩家将会在赛开始时直接前往起跑位置。

english: In key sections of Project CARS 2, there are tutorial texts, accompanied by speech, that are designed to explain features and functionalities, or provide enhanced instructions. Having this option set to ON will activate these tutorials the first time you visit a particular screen, and will not appear again once viewed. Setting this option to OFF will disable these tutorials entirely, and prevent them appearing altogether, irrespective of whether you have previously activated a tutorial or not.    Note: If you set to this option to OFF, and turn it back ON again, the tutorials will be reset and activate when visiting each screen again.
chinese: 在Project CARS 2的主要段落中会有语音配合的教学文字引导，用于解说特色及功能，或提供进阶的引导。  将此选项设定为「开」可在首次拜访特定画面时启用此教学，观看过后则不会再显示。  将此选项设定为「关」会完全停用教学并防止它们显示，不论之前是否有启用过教学。

english: Controller Damping allows you to adjust how quickly you can steer from left to right, or right to left. Setting this to a lower value allows you to steer left and right quicker, and a setting with a higher value makes the steering slower.
chinese: 控制器避震可调整由左至右，或由右至左的转向速度。  此数值设得越低，可让你左右转向越快，而设得越高则转向越慢。

english: Camera Controls allow you to select the type of camera that you wish to use. Certain camera types limit the amount of movement control you can enjoy, and are also limited to altering the angle and zoom levels only.     Using the Drone Cam gives you more freedom of camera motion, altering its angles and zoom levels in order to focus and position on the subject of your photo. The drone camera, however, is locked to be within the confines of the track and within a limited distance from the player's car.
chinese: 摄影机控制可让你选择要使用的摄影机类型。  部份摄影机类型会限制动态控制可玩度，部份则限制仅可变更角度放大缩小程度。    使用空拍摄影机可让你的摄影机在动态上更加自由，任意变更角度及放大，让你拍摄的照片可聚焦于目标的位置。  但是空拍摄影机被锁定限制在轨道上，且必须与玩家的车辆保持一定的距离。

english: Exposure allows you to control how much light passes through the lens and onto the image, thereby controlling how bright or dark the image will appear. Higher values create a brighter image, and lower values create a darker image.
chinese: 曝光可让你控制多少灯光可穿越镜片投射到影像上，藉此控制影像的明亮度。  较高的数值会让影像越明亮，越低则会越灰暗。

english: Aperture allows you to control the amount of light on the lens, affecting the Depth of Field in the image, and the range of distance over which objects will appear in focus. Higher values will allow for a bigger sharp-focus area. Lower values will allow for a smaller sharp-focus area.
chinese: 光圈可让你控制镜片上的灯光，藉此控制景深及对焦点的范围。  较高的数值会让对焦范围越广，较低的数值会让对焦范围越小。

english: Focal Length acts like a Field of View and determines how much of the scene will be captured, along with adjusting the magnification. Higher values allows for a wider Field of View and a lower magnification. Lower values create a much narrower Field of View and provides a higher magnification.
chinese: 焦距就如同视野范围，决定多少景象可被捕捉以及调整放大倍率。  较高的数值会让视野范围较广及较低的放大倍率。  较低的数值会让视野范围变狭窄及较高的放大倍率。

english: Focal Distance adjusts the position of the sharp-focus point. A higher value moves the sharp-focus point further away from the camera, making the background appear sharper. Lower values moves the sharp-focus point closer to the camera, thereby making the foreground appear sharp and in focus, while the background will appear more blurred.
chinese: 焦距可调整对锐聚焦的位置。  较高的数值会让锐聚焦距离镜头更远，使背景更加明显。  较低的数值会使锐聚焦距离镜头更近，使前景更加清晰而背景变得模糊。

english: Bokeh Shape changes the number of blades on the aperture which in turn affects the shape of the bokeh blur effect in a photograph. A higher value will have more blades, and therefore will have a softer, rounded shape to the blur. A lower value will have less blades, creating a more hexagonal shape.
chinese: 散景形状会改变光圈的叶片数，可影响照片中散景模糊的形状。  较高的数值叶片数会越多，因此会有更圆滑的模糊效果。  较低的数值叶片数会越少，因此会有产生偏六角的形状。

english: Shutter Speed determines the amount of motion blur in a photo. The faster the shutter speed, the sharper an action shot will appear, whereas the slower the shutter speed, the more moving objects will be blurred along the direction of motion.
chinese: 快门速度决定了照片中有多少动态模糊效果。  快门速度越快，捕捉的动态会更加清晰。  快门速度越慢，捕捉的动态则会沿着动作变模糊。

english: Photo Filter allows you to utilise a set of different filters that can be applied to the photograph, replicating different lens filters that can be attached to the camera, as well as different types of film, and also colour grading.
chinese: 相片滤镜可让你分别使用多种可用于照相的滤镜，重现多样可套用于摄影机的滤镜，以及各式类型的底片及色彩分级。

english: Filter Intensity allows you to adjust how effective or intense the Photo Filter is. Higher values will make the filter appear to have stronger effects. Lower values will make the filter appear more subtle, or not at all when set to 0.
chinese: 滤镜强度可让你调整相片滤镜的效果强度。  较高的数值可让滤镜的效果更强烈。  较低的数值会让滤镜显得更加细微，设定为0则是无效果。

english: Vignette allows you to adjust the image's brightness at the edges in comparison to the centre, creating a darker border. Higher values will create a much darker edge to the image. Lower values will create a much more subtle difference at the edge, or none at all when set to 0.
chinese: 晕影可让你调整影像的角落与中央的亮度对比，营造出较暗的角落。  较高的数值会让影像的角落越暗。  较低的数值会让角落产生细微变化，设定为0则毫无变化。

english: Frame allows you to apply a border to the image, similar to vignette, but with a stronger and more solid borders. Higher values increase the size and strength of the frame. Lower values decrease the size of the frame, or remove it completely when set to 0.
chinese: 片幅可让你将边框套用至影像上，与晕影雷同，但为更加强烈实质的边框。  较高的数值会加大相框的大小及强度。  较低的数值会减少片幅的大小，设定为0则无片幅。

english: Contrast allows you to control the scale of difference between black and white in an image; higher contrast will have brighter highlights, bold colours, and darker shadows, while a low contrast will produce a narrower range of tones.
chinese: 对比可以让你控制影像黑白比例；对比越高亮点会更明亮、色彩更生动且阴影更暗，对比越低则会产生较简朴的色调。

english: Saturation allows you to adjust the amount of colour in an image. Higher saturation will make colours more bold and vibrant, whilst low saturation will remove the colour to a more greyscale image.
chinese: 饱和度可让你调整影像中的色彩数量。  饱和度越高会使色彩变得更加活力生动，饱和度越低则会移除色彩并偏向灰阶的影像。

english: Film Grain allows you to adjust the amount of grain added to the image, with higher settings resulting in more grain, and lower settings resulting in less or none.
chinese: 粒状影像可让你调整影像中要加入的纹理。  设定越高会使纹理越多，越低则越少，甚至是无。

english: Chromatic Aberration allows you to control an effect caused by the failing of the lens to focus all colours to the same convergence point. This creates a colour-channel shift around the edges. Higher values makes this effect stronger and more prominent. Lower values makes the effect more subtle, or non existent when set to 0.
chinese: 色差可让你控制因镜片无法将所有色光都聚焦在同一点上而造成的效果。  这造成了角落的色彩通道偏移。  较高的数值会使效果更强且更显赫。  较低的数值会使效果显得更细微，设定为0则无效果。

english: Speed Sensitivity enables the cameras Field of View to adjust as your speed increases and decreases, giving a greater sense of speed. If you wish to use Speed Sensitivity settings, set this option to YES and you will then be able to fine tune its settings to your preference. If you wish to disable Speed Sensitivity, then set this option to NO.
chinese: 速度灵敏度可让镜头视野范围，在加速或减速时进行调节，呈现更佳的速度感。  如果想要使用速度敏感度设定，将此选项设定为「是」即可依据你的喜好调节设定。  若要停用速度敏感度设定，将此选项设定为「否」即可。

english: This determines whether the Rolling Start is under player manual control. Setting this option to YES means that you will be in control of the car during the Rolling Start. Setting this option to NO means that the AI will be in control of the Rolling Start until the green light, at which point you take full control of the car for the race.
chinese: 决定动态起跑是否由玩家手动控制。  设定选项为「是」代表你会在动态起跑期间操控车辆，  设定选项为「否」代表AI会在显示绿灯之前，  在动态起跑期间操控车辆。  绿灯过后才能重拾对车辆的完全操控。

english: This determines whether the Rolling Start is forced to be under manual player control. Setting this option to YES means that all players will have control of their car during the Rolling Start. Setting this option to NO means that the AI will be in control of the Rolling Start until the green light, at which point players take full control of their car for the race.
chinese: 决定动态起跑是否由玩家手动控制。  设定选项为「是」代表所有玩家会在动态起跑期间操控他们的车辆，  设定选项为「否」代表AI会在显示绿灯之前，  在动态起跑期间操控车辆。  绿灯过后才能重拾对车辆的完全操控。

english: The difficulty level of the AI.    Note: Setting this to 80% or higher allows the AI to adjust their setup away from the default – to better suit the track you've selected.
chinese: AI的难度    注意:   设定为80%以上允许AI从预设  变更他们的设定–以便对应你选择的跑道

english: Minimum Shift Time allows you to adjust how quickly you can shift gears. Setting this value higher will help to prevent accidental gear shifts, and setting it lower will let you change gears as quickly as your vehicle allows.
chinese: 最短换档时间可以调整你换档的速度。  设定较高数值可预防失手换档，  而设定较低数值可以在车辆可行范围内进行快速换档。

english: Force Feedback replicates the forces that a driver experiences when driving a real vehicle, informing you as to how the vehicle reaction in response to your inputs.    There are 3 Force Feedback profiles (Flavours), each with their own preset settings:  - Immersive: Replicates the feel of road surfaces, kerbs, tyre slip, weight, and suspension movements felt through the steering wheel and as experienced in the real world.  - Informative: Designed to give more of a detailed feel of road surfaces, kerbs, tyre slip, weight, and suspension movements.  - Raw: Unfiltered Force Feedback, allowing you feel their full strength of the various forces felt by drivers.   - Custom (PC Only): Making adjustments to the Force Feedback settings in the ffb_custom.txt file (found in Documents/ProjectCARS2) allows you to use your configured settings in this Custom flavour.
chinese: 回馈力道会重现驾驶真实车辆时，车手所体验的力道，让你感受车辆对你的输入的反应。  回馈力道有3种档案 (偏好)，各有其预设的设定：  -身历其境：将真实世界的道路表面、路肩、胎滑、重量和悬挂系统动作体验，藉方向盘重现。  -信息化：给予更细腻道路表面、路肩、胎滑、重量和悬挂系统动作体验。  -原始：未经过滤的回馈力道，让你完整体验车手所感受到各式力道强度。   -自定义(仅限计算机版)：调节回馈力道中的ffb_custom.txt档案（文件/ProjectCARS2中可找到），可让你使用依个人偏好所设置的设定。

english: Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: Select the Car Classes you wish to include in your event. You can select up to a maximum of 10 Car Classes.The first class will be automatically determined by the class of your currently selected vehicle.
chinese: 选择在赛事中希望包含的车辆等级。  可选择最多4种车辆等级。  第一个车辆等级会自动设为你目前选择的车辆等级。

english: Selecting a Motorsport Preset allows you to pre-configure a number of settings based off your selected Motorsport.    The preset settings for Rallycross include:   Car Classes  - Rallycross.  - Rallycross Supercar Lites.    Tracks  - Rallycross tracks only.    Race  - 6 laps.  - Standing Start.    Opponent Settings  - 5 AI opponents.  - Opponents Field set to Same Class.    Rules & Regulations  - Drive Through Off.  - Pit Exit Penalties Off.    Note: If this Motorsport Preset is already active, selecting it again will disable the preset.
chinese: 选择预设赛事可让你根据所选的赛事提前设置多项设定。    场地拉力赛的预设设定包含：   车辆等级  -场地拉力赛。  -场地拉力赛超轻量房车。    赛道选择  -限场地拉力赛道。    赛事  -6圈。  -静态起跑。    对手设定  -5名AI对手。  -对手范围设为相同等级。    常规与规则  -关闭通过维修区处罚。  -关闭出维修区处罚。    注意:如果已经启用赛事预设， 重新选择会停用此预设。

english: This allows you to select the number of weather slots to configure for the session. The maximum number of weather slots you can configure is 4. Selecting “Real Weather” will disable the Weather Forecast selection, and instead use the current real-world weather at the location of the track in-game.
chinese: 你可以选择要设置在比赛中的天气空位数量。  你最多可以设置4个天气空位.。  选择「真实天气」会关闭天气预报选项，但相对地游戏中赛道会套用真实天气。

english: This allows you to configure the weather for a specific slot in the session. The first slot is the weather that the session will start with, before progressing to the other weather types (if enabled) configured after it. If only one slot is configured, the weather will remain fixed to that condition throughout the entirety of the session.     Note: If you select “Real Weather” in the Weather Slots option, you will not be able to configure any weather slots, as this Weather Forecast option will become disabled, to be replaced by the current real-world weather at that location.
chinese: 你可以为比赛的特定空位设置天气。  第一空位为比赛开始的天气，之后会进到其他天气类型 (如已开启)。  如果只有设置一个空位，整场比赛过程中，天气都会维持该条件。      注意: 如果你在真实天气空位选项选择「真实天气」，你将无法设置任何天气空位，并会关闭天气预报选项， 被真实世界天气取代。

english: Here’s where you decide which tyres to change during the pit stop.    Selecting:  All: Your mechanics will replace all four tyres  None: Your mechanics will replace none of your tyres  Front: Your mechanics will only replace the front tyres  Rear: Your mechanics will only replace the rear tyres  Recommended: Your mechanics will only replace the tyres that are heavily worn or damaged.
chinese: 你可在此设定停站时要更换的轮胎。    选择：  全部：技师会帮你更换全部四个轮胎  无：技师不会帮你更换任何轮胎  前：技师只会帮你更换前轮胎  后：技师只会帮你更换后轮胎  推荐：你的车辆只会更换严重磨损或是受损的轮胎

english: This will determine whether cars can become ghosted and non-collidable when they either:  - Become stationary  - Drive in the wrong direction around the circuit  Setting this option to YES will keep collisions on, and cars will not become ghosted in the above scenarios.
chinese: 这会决定符合以下条件时，车辆可以变成无法碰撞的幽灵车：  -静止时  -在赛车场反方向行驶时  将此选项设为「是」会保持碰撞开启，车辆将不会在以上条件变为幽灵车。

english: Stability Control (SC) reduces the chances of the vehicle sliding, particularly when cornering. If the beginning of a slide is detected, power is either cut, or small amounts of braking is applied to individual wheels to push the vehicle back to the desired direction, thereby regaining stability. Switching this option ON will allow you to enable or disable SC when out on track. Switching this option OFF will disable SC altogether. Authentic: The available driving assists will match the assists that come on the real-life car counterpart.    Note: Stability Control (SC) will automatically enable both ABS and TC when turned ON, as it requires both to function. Also, this SC setting may get overridden by game modes that have their own rules for assists, such as Time Trial, or Multiplayer lobbies and Online Championships where the host has forced the SC assist off.
chinese: 车身稳定控制(SC)会减少车辆滑行的机率，尤其是过弯时。  当侦测到开始滑行时，动力将会被切断，或在每个轮胎上套用微量的煞车，以车辆推回期望的方向，进而重拾稳定度。  将此选项切换至「开」时，可在赛道上启用或停用SC。  将此选项设为「关」时，会完全停用SC。  真实：驾驶辅助系统所提供的帮助，将与车辆于真实生活中的相对应。  注意：车身稳定控制(SC)设定为「开」时，由于功能使用需求，会自动启用ABS及TC。  此外，此SC设定有可能会被其他游戏模式本身的辅助规则所覆盖，例如计时赛或可将SC辅助强制关闭的多人大厅及在线锦标赛。

english: This applies extra volume to the LFE (Low Frequency Effect) channel in supported surround sound formats (5.1, 7.1, etc.). For connected devices that support the LFE channel, this will control the amount of deep bass and rumble, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
chinese: 调整支持的环绕音效格式（5.1、7.1等）的LFE（超低音音效）声道的音量。调整后在连接LFE声道的支持装置，可以在100（最高）到0（最低）的范围控制重低音和震动的数量。

english: This allows speech to be directed to the controller speaker (if available). Setting this option to YES will play speech from the speaker on your controller. Setting this option to NO will play speech from your standard audio ouput.
chinese: 可以从控制器喇叭听到声音（如果控制器有支持）。设定「是」的话会从控制器的喇叭播放声音。设定「否」的话会从标准音响输出播放声音。

english: This allows you to choose the type of graphical experience you prefer. You can choose from the following 3 options:  - Enhanced Resolution: This will set the resolution of your game to it's highest possible setting. This will also adjust the graphical settings, balancing image quality with stable framerates.  - Enhanced Visuals: This will boost the graphical fidelity of the game in order to improve overall image quality. Framerates, however, may suffer during heavy processing.   - Enhanced Framerate: This will slightly lower the overall image quality in order to achieve better framerates and add the potential for improved smoothness during heavy processing.
chinese: 你可以选择偏好的画质体验类型。你可以选择以下3种选项:  -强化分辨率:将会设定游戏能运行的最高分辨率。你可以在稳定影格率的前提下调整画质设定、与平衡图像质量。  -强化视觉效果:将会提升游戏逼真度改善游戏整体图像.。不过有可能会因为运算处理负荷加重而下降影格率。   -强化影格率:将会微幅降低图像质量达到较佳的影格率，以及改善运算处理负荷变更顺畅。

english: Menu Spring Strength allows you to determine the strength of the recentering force when entering and navigating menu screens. Setting this option to 0 will mean the wheel will not have any recentering force when in the game's menus. Setting this option to 100 will apply the strongest recentering force, ensuring your wheel returns to its centre when turned in the game's menus.    Note: This does not affect normal driving FFB.
chinese: 菜单弹性强度允许你在进入菜单画面时， 能够决定返回中心位置的强度。设定选项为0代表方向盘在菜单画面时并不会返回中心位置。设定选项为100代表会套用最强的力道，确保方向盘会在回到游戏菜单时回到中心位置。    注意:这项设定并不会影响正常驾驶FFB。

english: If you activate this option, the difference between the Maximum Grid Size that has been set, and the Maximum Number of Human Opponents, will be filled by AI opponents.
chinese: 如果你启动此设定，已设定的起跑格上限和真人对手上限之间的差异会由AI对手填满。

english: Tracking Speed will control how closely the camera is tracking the car. Rather than the camera remaining still, this will ensure that the camera tracks the car, and will therefore allow you to vary the type of motion blur you desire—from blurring only the background, to blurring only the car, or a combination of the two, to create the effect your desire.
chinese: 追踪速度会变更摄影机追逐车辆的速度。会让摄影机解除固定并追逐车辆，也可以更改动态模糊类型──只模糊背景、只模糊车辆、或是让两者皆变模糊，制作出你想要的效果。

english: UDP Frequency sets how frequently data gets sent to the external applications you are connecting to. Setting this to a lower value will send data packets more often, and increasing this to a higher value will send data packets at a slower rate decreasing network traffic.
chinese: 这会设定连接至外部应用的数据传送频率。数值设定越低，用户数据报协议的频率就会变更频繁，将数值调高则会以较慢的频率传送封包，并减少网络流量。
