english: Delete allows you to delete the Online Championship and all its info, thereby removing it from the main Online Championship screen.
chinese: 你可以删除在线锦标赛和所有相关信息， 并从锦标赛主画面移除。

english: Edit allows you to make adjustments to the Online Championship, including the Championship Standings.      Note: Not all the options that were available in the Create Online Championship are available for editing.
chinese: 编辑可以让你调整包含锦标赛排名的在线锦标赛。      注意：部分选项无法在建立的在线锦标赛中启用编辑。

english: Join Lobby will allow you to join the lobby for the next round once the admin has initiated the next scheduled round of the Online Championship.
chinese: 加入大厅可以让你在管理者开始在线锦标赛的下一个预定回合时加入。

english: Join Lobby will initiate the next scheduled round of the Online Championship. Participants will be automatically invited to join the lobby.
chinese: 加入大厅会开始在线锦标赛的下一个预定回合，参与者会自动被邀请加入大厅。

english: View Info allows you to view the schedule, results, and standings of the Online Championship.
chinese: 检视信息可以让你检视排程、结果、以及在线锦标赛的排名。

english: The Scheduled Round Date is the date when this round of the Online Championship is planned to take place.     The Scheduled Round Start Time is the time when this round of the Online Championship is planned to start.     Note: Both the Scheduled Round Date and Scheduled Round Start Time will inform all participants of when that round is due to take place. The launching of each round, however, must be done manually. Ensuring that both the Date and Time are accurate and kept up to date is therefore crucial in order that participants know when they’re due to compete.
chinese: 「预定回合日期」是在线锦标赛该回合预定举办的日期。     「预定的回合开始时间」是在线锦标赛该回合预定开始的时间。     注意：「预定回合日期」和「预定的回合开始时间」皆会向所有参与者显示该回合开始的日期时间。不过，需要手动执行各回合的开始。为了让参与者掌握比赛开始时间，请一定要确认更新至最新信息，和设定正确时间。

english: The Opposite Lock Assist will aid in controlling slides when the car begins to oversteer. Whilst it will automatically provide some steering input to counter the slide, player inputs will still be needed to properly catch or hold a slide. This assist is mainly intended for controllers and keyboards, but can also be used with a wheel, although it is recommended that wheel users keep this assist off.    Note: The Opposite Lock Assist is tied to, and scales with, the Speed Sensitivity option. A higher setting in the Speed Sensitivity option will offer a greater, more sensitive Opposite Lock Assist effect, whilst a lower Speed Sensitivity option will provide a smaller, weaker Opposite Lock Assist effect.
chinese: 反向锁定帮助会在车辆开始过度转向时协助控制滑行，虽然会自动提供些许转向来对应滑行，玩家仍需要正确操作并维持滑行。这项辅助主要用于控制器和键盘， 不过亦可用于方向盘， 虽然我们建议使用方向盘的玩家不启用该项辅助。    注意：反向锁定帮助和速度转向灵敏度选项息息相关。 调高转向灵敏度选项会提供更佳且更灵敏的反向锁定帮助效果， 调低转向灵敏度选项则会提供较低且减弱的反向锁定帮助效果。

english: This allows you to disable or select the type of Sun Flare effects in exterior driving cameras.
chinese: 你可以在外部驾驶镜头停用或选择光晕效果的类型。

english: This allows you to disable or select the type of Sun Flare effects in interior driving cameras.
chinese: 你可以在内部驾驶镜头停用或选择光晕效果的类型。

english: Increases or decrease the level of smoothing and filtering of bumps as the cockpit camera tracks the virtual horizon. Higher values filter more bumps and result in a slower movement towards the horizon when the car pitches/rolls.    With 'Use Legacy Head Movement' mode enabled a setting of 0 fixes cockpit cameras firmly to the car. At higher values the amount of camera movement relative to the car increases.    NOTE: This setting affects camera movement induced by the cars movement only. G-force effects are controlled separately below.
The number of track limit warnings that will be issued to a driver before a drive-through or time penalty is given.
Photos you’ve taken and replays you’ve saved can be reviewed in your Driver Network Highlights
chinese: 你所拍的相片和保存的回放，都可以在你的车手网路精彩瞬间查

english: When set to "MAX AVAILABLE" the number of opponents will be automatically set to the maximum supported value without duplicating liveries. For a race of identical vehicles with 10 available liveries the value would be 9.

This controls how aggressive the traction control system is.    Higher values allow less wheel slip before the system will cut throttle to prvent wheelspin. This can be beneficial in low grip situations such as a wet track, or when tyre wear must be managed closely.    Low values allow more slip, and are good for high grip situations: dry track, slick tyres, optimal weather.

This setting allows you to set the starting state of the track surface including if it is wet or already rubbered in.    If set to 'Default Progressing' this session will take the rubber state from the previous session (or the 'Medium' preset if it is the first session of the weekend). Any other setting will apply that preset at the session start regardless of previous session end states.    eg. To start a weekend with light rubber then progress each session based on track running set Practice='Light Rubber', Qualifying='Default Progressing', and Race='Default Progressing'    Wet presets are unavailable when using real weather as the starting state is determined by the real weather prior to the event.

When set to 'Units', suspension settings on the vehicle setup screen will be displayed as a range of steps from the minimum to maximum available setting.    When set to 'Rates' they will be displayed as their actual rates.    In both cases the total range and step between settings are equal.
When enabled a timed race session will end one full lap after the the race duration ends.
This setting determines if refuelling is allowed during pit stops.

When enabled the Limited Tyre Sets option determines the maximum number of new tyre sets players have available for the event as a whole. Each time a tyre set is used on track its last state is maintained and any future use of that tyre will start with the previous wear and compound applied.
the ICM Auto-Close option controls the length of time after the last user input that the In Car Management menu will automatically close

Dertermines whether the In Car Management menu maintains the current menu position or is reset when the menu closes.    None : The current page and menu selection will be maintained.    Default Option: The currently active page will be maintained but the default menu option will be selected.    Default Page: Both the page and menu option will be reset to default.    (Delayed): These options do the same as their non-delayed counterparts but the reset will take place 30 seconds after the menu closes.

The Steering Lock is the maximum number of degrees of rotation of the front wheels.     A lower Steering Lock value increases the amount of steering wheel movement needed per degree of front wheel rotation,  allowing for finer steering control. Increasing the Steering Lock value will give more responsive steering, decreasing the amount of input needed, and making the car more sensitive to steering input.    Care should be taken to ensure there is enough available lock to negotiate the tightest corner on the circuit at racing speed.

Control Assignment:    Click or activate the row of the assignment you wish to edit to start the binding process.    To bind a button, press and release the button when prompted.    To bind an axis such as a pedal or wheel, when prompted, move the axis through at least 50% of its range then return to the zero or centre position.
Adjusts the zoom level of the HUD Radar gadget.
Sets the minimum number of tyres which must be changed in order for a pits tops to count as a valid mandatory stop.
When enabled the game will pause when alt-tabbed from fullscreen in single player game modes.
Limits the number of visible vehicles. The selection of which vehicles to render is weighted towards those ahead of the player.
When enabled timed races will have one extra complete lap after the timer ends.
Sets the mode of the HUD track map.    The 'Static' mode has a fixed map showing the whole track.    The 'Dynamic' mode offers a zoomed map oriented to the players direction of travel.
The volume of wind related sound effects, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).
Manually adjust the number of opponents in each class.
Schedules a full course yellow to take place at a predetermined race distance.
Sets the race distance as a percentage of the current series preset time for this track
Scales the rate of AI mistakes
Adjusts the performance cost of opponent audio playback by limiting the maximum number of samples which can be played simultaneously.
chinese: Adjusts the performance cost of opponent audio playback by limiting the maximum number of samples which can be played simultaneously.

english: Scales AI performance in traction zones relative to the main AI Skill setting; Adjust if you find the AI to be too fast or slow out of corners.
Scales AI performance under braking relative to the main AI Skill setting; adjust if you find the AI to be going too fast into corners.
Adjusts the performance cost of opponent  and environment  audio playback by limiting the maximum number of samples which can be played simultaneously.

- Custom offers steering torque around steering axis with no road vibration, damping or friction or allows you to fully configured FFB settings within ffb_custom_settings.txt file located in Documents/Automobilista 2/    - Default adds damping, friction, limited vibrations with a small amount of chassis feedback    - Default+ adds some understeer drop-off, more chassis feedback for feeling the cars weight transfer

Scales the vertical vibration part of signal, vibration produced by tires on heavy slippage, drivetrain vibration / pulses; it also scales chassis effects (lateral acceleration, yaw, weight transfer) present in Default and Default+.

LFB amplifies "light forces“ close to zero/center, gradually rolling off amplification as force output increases. Use for low torque wheels to enhance small signals that may be missed and reduce the lightness around the center. DD wheels should set low or zeroed.

Adds resistance to help prevent oscillations and governs how quickly you can steer from left to right. Lower values allows you to steer quicker with less resistance whilst higher values makes steering slower with more resistance.
Resets all vehicles FFB gain adjusted within the quick setup menu back to 100%.
Scales AI performance in wet conditions relative to the main AI Skill setting; adjust if the AI is too fast or slow compared to its dry performance
Select your active controller preset from up to 5 personal saved controller slots. Presets named (eg. 'User Set 1') are default presets shipped with the game until you modify and save.
This option allows to edit the name of your active controller preset.
This option allows you to copy the settings from another preset into your active controller preset.
This option allows you to enable or disable 'Full Course Yellow' cautions for your race weekend event.
The volume of your engine sounds, ranging from 100 (highest) to 0 (lowest).

When Private Session is set to 'Solo', each driver will compete in isolation with no other vehicles on track as they would in a superpole or oval-style qualifying.     When set to 'Same Class' each class competes in isolation from vehicles of other classes.
Damage Scale determines the amount of damage your vehicle receives when making contact with a opponents vehicle or trackside object.

Random Failures determines whether your vehicle (including Ai) is prone to random failures during a session or not. There are 4 options to choose from:    - Off: By turning off this option, you will prevent random failures from being active during a session.  - x2, x3, x4, x5, x10: These options accelerate random failures by the multiplying number.  - Authentic: By setting this option, random failures will occur at a rate similar to real life.  - Sync To Race: By setting this option, the amount of random failures will occur at a rate that is believable to the race length set.
Enables or disables fading effect when switching between higher and lower detail models at distance on some trackside objects and foliage.
Forces all clients to disable collisions with dynamic trackside objects such as cones, tyres, and brake markers.
Enables/Disables collisions and physics effects on dynamic trackside objects such as cones, bollards, and brake markers. Setting may be overridden by MP server and TT rules.
Enables or disables on-screen confirmation messages for changes to onboard vehicle settings such as TC/ABS level, Brake Bias, ERS modes, etc
Allows drivers to use the vehicle reset control bind to return to the track
Enables the additional ICM page for in-car adjustment of hud options
When enabled the last used setup for the current vehicle will be autoloaded at the start of an event.

Parc Ferme: Once a vehicle leaves the pitlane for the first time in a qualifying session, its setup is locked from further changes with the exception of tyre compound and some limited options to allow balance changes.    Default Setup: Forces the use or default setups and limits changes to tyre compound, fuel levels, and a small selection of changes to aid tuning for different controllers. Changes can be made at any time.

Parallax Occlusion Mapping adds depth and lighting to flat objects without increasing model complexity    Low: Enables Parallax Occlusion Mapping  Medium: Increases the quality and enables hard self-shadowing  High: Further increases the quality and enables soft self-shadowing

The Lap Limit setting defines the maximum number of laps each driver may complete in this session including in/out laps.    With a Stint Limit enabled, the Lap Limit applies to each stint rather than the session as a whole.    Exceeding the Lap Limit at any time will result in disqualification from the session.

The Stint Limit sets the maximum number of times a driver may leave the pits to set laps on track before they are locked to the garage.    New stints can be started by passing through the pit lane or returning to the garage.    Exceeding the Stint Limit at any time will result in disqualification from the session.

This is where you can either select a car and track before jumping straight into a quick race, or set up a customized race weekend. If you’re setting up a customised race weekend, you can decide on the skill and number of Opponents, as well as set up alternative Race Settings, Session Settings, and Rules & Regulations. To speed up this process, you can also utilise a Motorsport Preset to auto-configure a number of settings that correspond to your selected preset, and then tweak your preferred race weekend from there.
chinese: 这里是在你直接加入快速比赛前可选择车辆及赛道，或设定自定义周末赛事的地方。  如果要设定自定义周末赛事，你可决定对手的数量和技术，并设定其他赛事设定、比赛设定、和常规与规则。  要加速此流程，你也可已使用赛是预设来自动设置一组与你选择的预设相对应的设定后，再开始调整成你喜欢的周末赛事。

english: Race Settings is where you configure all the options relating to the Main Race in your Custom Event. Everything from race length, the in-game date of the race, start time, time progression, weather settings, type of start, and mandatory pitstop, all of this is decided here.
chinese: 在赛事设定中，你可以设定与自定赛事中正赛相关的所有选项。从赛事长度、游戏内的日期、开始时间、时间进展、天气设定、起跑类型，到强制进站都在此决定。

english: Session Settings is where you can either enable or disable the Practice and/or Qualifying session for your Custom Event. This is also where you can configure the duration, in-game start time, time progression, and weather settings of both Practice and Qualifying sessions.
chinese: 你可以在比赛设定设置是否要在自定赛事中，启用或停用练习赛或排位赛。练习赛和排位赛的赛事长度、游戏内的开始时间、时间进展，以及天气设定，也从这里设定。

english: Opponent Settings is where you decide the AI’s skill level, as well as the size of the grid, the car classes the AI will be racing in, and – if you’re not including a Qualifying Session – in what position you’ll start the race.
chinese: 你可以在对手设定决定 AI 的技术等级、起跑格的数量、AI 的车辆等级，以及未安排排位赛时的比赛起跑位置。

english: Rules & Regulations is where you configure the leniency of penalties for the event, and which penalties you wish to have enabled or disabled.
chinese: 你可以在常规与规则设定赛事处罚的宽松度，以及要启用或停用的处罚。

english: You can save up to 4 Custom Event setups to your Favourites. Simply toggle the ones you want to keep and load them up to jump back into the race.
chinese: 你可以在我的最爱中保存高达 4 种自定赛事设定。只需简单切换至你所要保留的设定，读取后即可返回赛事。

english: Select from the list to quickly load Event Settings specific to that motorsport including race length, number of opponents, and rules & regulations. You can then further fine tune presets within your Race, Opponents, and Rules & Regulations settings.
chinese: 从清单中选择赛事设定以快速读取特定的赛事设定，包含赛事长度、对手数量，以及常规与规则。之后还可以进一步在你的赛事、对手、以及常规与规则中，针对默认进行微调。

english: Here’s where you choose which car you want to drive. Cars are listed by Manufacturer, but you can also choose to list them by Car Class with the ‘Group By’ option. Alternatively, you can view them alphabetically.
chinese: 在此你可以选择要驾驶的车辆。车辆会以制造商列出，但你也可以用「分类」选项以车辆等级列出。或者，你也可以按字母检视。

english: Here’s where you choose which track you want to drive. Tracks can be viewed either by location, with each layout for the selected track displayed separately, or alphabetically, with all track layouts displayed in a single list.
chinese: 在此你可以选择要竞赛的赛道。可以检视赛道场所，所选赛道都会个别显示，或按字母显示，所有赛道将会显示于单一列表上。

english: Welcome to Project CARS 2. You’re about to embark on the ultimate driver journey. This is Race Central where you’ll manage your racing career, create and enter both Singleplayer, and Multiplayer events, get involved with the Community, and edit your Game Settings.
chinese: 欢迎来到 Project CARS 2。你即将踏上终极车手的旅程。你可以在赛事中心管理你的赛车生涯，建立或进入单人及多人赛事，融入社群，以及编辑你的游戏设定。

english: The Pit Box Main Menu is where you prepare for the upcoming session. Take the time to edit your Car Setup, Pit Strategy, watch other competitors drive, make adjustments to your Game Options, fast forward the remaining time in the session, or just skip the current session altogether.
chinese: 你可在维修站主菜单为即将到来的比赛做准备。花点时间编辑你的车辆调校、进站策略、观赏竞争者竞赛、调整你的游戏选项、快转比赛的剩余时间，或直接跳过目前比赛。

english: This is where you can share and receive setups from friends and other drivers in the same lobby. To share a setup with another driver in the lobby, select any setup that you have saved for the car you are currently driving. You can also receive a setup for any car from another driver: just click on the received setup in the ‘Received’ tab, and Save it. When you next drive the car for which the setup is applicable, that setup will appear in your list of saved setups.
chinese: 在这里，你可以分享或接收好友或大厅中其他车手的设定。要与大厅内其他车手分享设定时，选择目前驾驶车辆已保存的设定。你也可以从另一位车手接收任意车辆的设定：只需在「接收」标签点击接收设定并保存即可。当驾驶可套用该设定的车辆时，该设定就会出现在你的保存设定清单中。

english: Your Career begins here. Enter your driver’s details including name, initials, and nationality.
chinese: 你的生涯在此开始。输入你的车手详细资讯，包含姓名、首字母及国家/地区。

english: Every Motorsport hero needs to start somewhere – where will you begin? This is where you’ll need to decide whether you want to begin at the very bottom, in Karts, and race your way up through the Tiers to the very pinnacle of Motorsports in Tier 1, or simply jump straight into your favourite Motorsport and begin from there. Progression to the next Tier is simple enough – finish in the Top 5 in the Driver’s Standings at the end of the Season. If you don’t, you’ll need to try again in a Motorsport within the same Tier.
chinese: 每位赛车英雄都有他的起点，你的在哪里？在这里你必须决定是否要从最底层的卡丁车，一路通过各阶级达到一级的顶端，或直接跳到你喜爱的赛事从那里开始。要晋级到下一阶级非常简单：以车手排行前 5 名结束赛季。如果没有，则需要再一次尝试相同阶级的赛事。

english: Now that you’ve chosen your Motorsport, it’s time to decide which Series you’ll start your Career in. The Series structure varies according to which Motorsport you chose: Some offer multiple starting points, others have a single one, while others will offer just a single Series by itself. Progression to the next Series remains the same – finish in the Top 5 of the Driver’s Standings.
chinese: 现在你已选择了你的赛事，是时候决定要在哪一个系列赛开始你的生涯。系列赛架构会依据你所选择的赛事而不同：有些会有多个起始点，有些只有一个，还有一些只有单向系列赛。要晋级到下一系列赛也相同：以车手排行前 5 名结束。

english: Now the fun really starts. If you’ve chosen a Series that allows you a choice of cars, here’s where you’ll need to make some decisions on which car you’ll race in your chosen Series. Having a tough time choosing? Take a look at the car performance stats. Also, pay close attention to the Car Class – if the Motorsport you chose has multiple classes, the Car Class you choose here will determine which Car Class you’ll be racing in.
chinese: 现在才是真正乐趣的开始。如果你选择的系列赛允许你选择车辆，在这里你就必须决定要在选择的系列赛中使用哪一辆车。无法做出抉择吗？看一下车辆的性能表现。还有，要注意车辆的等级，如果选择的赛事有多等级，这里选择的车辆将会决定你要在哪一个车辆等级赛车。

english: Now that you’ve chosen your car, it’s time to choose your livery. The livery you choose will also determine which team you’ll be racing for. If you need help deciding, take a look at the Car Showroom where you can see your car with its team livery. If you like what you see, confirm your selection. You’re almost there!
chinese: 现在你选好车子了，是选择涂装的时候了。选择的涂装会决定你将为哪一个车队赛车。如果需要帮忙决定，到车辆展示房看看，你可以看到你的车和车队涂装。如果你觉得满意的话，就确认吧。就快好了！

english: You've come a long way! The final step to launching your motorsport career is this, your first contract. If you’re happy with your selections, go ahead and sign. Once you do that, your ultimate driver journey is all set to begin.
chinese: 真是漫长的路！开始你的生涯的最后一步就是这个，你的第一份合约。如果对你的选择感到满意，就直接签下去吧。一旦这么做，你的终极车手之旅就准备好启程了。

english: Congratulations! Now that you’re all set, you can either hit the track for a 10 minute pre-season practice session (which you can leave at any time), or you can buckle-up and get your Career started for real. Will you rise to the very top of the ultimate driver journey? Good luck out there...
chinese: 恭喜！现在你都准备好了，你可以到赛道上来一场 10 分钟的季前练习赛 (可随时离开)，或上紧发条认真开始你的生涯。你会达到终极车手之旅的顶端吗？祝你场上好运…

english: This is your Driver Network Profile. Here you can view your Competitive Racing License details, edit your online profile information, and view all of your game stats, photos, and videos.
chinese: 这是你的车手网络个人资料。你可在此检视你的赛车竞争执照的细节，编辑你的在线个人资料的信息，以及观看你的所有游戏成绩、相片及影片。

english: The HUD Edit screen allows you to reposition and toggle the various elements and messages that are displayed on the HUD whilst driving. Layouts can also be created for different camera views, allowing you to customize the HUD to a style that best suits your individual needs.
chinese: 在信息显示编辑画面中，你可以重新排位及切换各种显示在驾驶时的信息显示要素和讯息。也可进行编排不同的摄影机视点，让你可以以最符合个人需求的风格自定信息显示。

english: This is the final overview of the round you’re about to enter. Here you can configure which sessions you want to participate in, as well as their length. Once you’re ready, hit Start, and get out on track.
chinese: 这是你即将进入的回合的最终概要。你可在此设定你要参加哪些比赛，还有比赛的长度。一旦你准备好了，点击开始然后上场吧。

english: The Career Dashboard is the main hub for managing your Career. Under the Home tab is everything related to the current core Series you are participating in. Here you’ll be able to head out on track for each round, view the event calendar, check emails from your team and others, view your Series Standings, and read news headlines from your prior races.
chinese: 生涯统计表是管理职涯的主要平台。在首页标签下方，显示所有与你目前参加的主要系列赛有关的内容。你可在此进入每一回合的赛道、检视赛事日历、检查来自队友或其他人的电子邮件、检视你的系列赛排行，以及读取前场比赛的新闻头条。

english: Invitational Events are awarded throughout your core Career progress. There are Invitational Events for varying Motorsport Disciplines, and they can be participated in and replayed any time, and as many times, as you want.
chinese: 在你的主要生涯进度中，你会受邀参加邀请赛事。邀请赛事有不同的赛事项目，可以随时随地参与和重玩，且不限次数。

english: Here you can view your Career’s progress. You can also see which trophies and accolades you have won, as well as what you have left to accomplish. This is also where you can set the difficulty levels for your opponents in your races.
chinese: 在此你可检视你的生涯进度。你也可以查看你赢得的奖杯和荣誉，以及尚未达成的成就。你也可以在此为赛事设定对手的难度等级。

english: The Photo Mode allows you take still images of the on-track action. Here you will find a wide variety of camera controls and functionality which will empower you to produce high-quality photos from near-enough any angle to show-off your own unique visual style. Any photos that you take using the Photo Mode will be saved and viewable in your Driver Network Profile.
chinese: 相片模式让你可以截取赛道上的静止画面。你可在此看到多种摄影机控制和功能，协助你从几乎任何角度，产出具备你独有风格的高质量相片。任何使用相片模式拍出的相片都会被保存，并可在你的车手网络个人资料中观看。

english: Earning affinity with specific manufacturers by driving their cars in your core Career will allow you to unlock Manufacturer Drives. Completing all the Manufacturer Drives for a manufacturer will reward you with access to an exclusive car from that manufacturer.
chinese: 在主要生涯中驾驶指定制造商车辆，并获取熟悉度，可解锁制造商赛车。为一个制造商完成所有制造商赛车，你将会获得奖励，得到该制造商专属车辆的权限。

english: Time-Trial is the decisive way to compete for the fastest lap against both friends and other drivers in order to see who is the quickest. Choose a car and a circuit, and try to claim the fastest lap and top spot on the leaderboards.
chinese: 测时赛是与好友及其他车手以最速单圈一决胜负的最佳方式。选择车辆及赛车场，尝试在排行榜上拿下最速单圈及第一名。

english: Community Events are similar to Time-Trial events. Where they differ is that Community Events enable settings such as a specific car or car class, track, weather setting, or they may even enforce the use of a Default Setup. Some events, such as Esports Community Events, may also require a Minimum Reputation Grade and Strength to enter. Check the details of currently Active, Upcoming, and Finished events for their details and results.
chinese: 社群赛事与测时赛相似。不同之处在于社群赛事可启用一些设定，如指定车辆、等级、赛道、天气，或强制使用默认值。有些赛事，例如 Esports 社群赛事，甚至会要求最低限度的名誉等级或强度才能进入。查看目前、即将开始和已结束的赛事来确认他们的细节与结果。

english: It’s race time! As you look around the pre-race menu, you’ll see a list of all the participants. You’re also able to view a detailed map of the track by selecting the map icon. If you need to, you can alter your Car Setup, as well as Pit Strategy before the race starts. Additionally, you can customise your HUD layout in Options to suit your personal style. Hit the Start button when you're ready to race.
chinese: 赛车时间到了！在查看预赛菜单时，会看到参加者名单。你也可以藉由点击地图图示来查看赛道的详细地图。  如果有必要，你也可以在比赛开始前变更你的车辆设定或进站策略。  此外，你也可以在选项中将HUD摆设自定义为符合你的风格。准备好赛车时就按下开始按键吧。

english: Welcome to your first rallycross race. In rallycross, all drivers must complete what is known as a 'Joker Lap'. The Joker Lap path involves a diversion off the main track, and is typically longer than a normal lap. The Joker Lap section is clearly marked with a gantry, and has to be completed once every race. Failing to do so will lead to a severe time penalty, as will taking the Joker Lap more than once in a single race. When you take your Joker Lap is up to you – just ensure you do it before the chequered flag.
chinese: 欢迎来到你的第一场场地拉力赛。在场地拉力赛，所有车手皆必须完成所谓的「小丑圈」。  小丑圈的路径牵涉到离开主赛道，且一般都比正常的一圈更长。小丑圈的段落会以一个高架进行标记，且每场比赛皆必须完成一次。  未能达成会导致严重的加时处罚，而在同一场比赛中进行超过一次的小丑圈也相同。  何时要进行小丑圈由你决定，但要确保在通过方格旗之前进行。

english: Practice is about getting to know your car, and getting to know the track. Ultimately, it’s about exploring the limits of both you and your car. Once you’re comfortable with both, use the session to make adjustments to the car's setup, and consider creating a pit strategy ready for the race. You can also try turning the assists such as traction and stability control off and on, and feel how they change your car's behaviour.
chinese: 练习是要让你熟悉你的车，还有熟悉赛道。  最终目的就是为了探索你与你的车的极限。  一旦你都习惯了，就利用比赛来调节你的车辆设定，并为赛事而准备好建立一个进站策略。  你也可以试着开关牵引控制和车身稳定控制的辅助，感受这些变化如何改变车子的习性。

english: Qualifying determines your placement on the starting grid for the race. The faster the time you set in qualifying, the higher up you’ll be on the race grid. This is often the session where your car will be tuned for maximum attack. The Setup and Strategy tab allows you to change the settings on your car, as well as to configure a pit stop strategy for the upcoming race. You can also view a summary of your current series’ Rules & Regulations. Take the car out for a few laps, then return to the pits and try tweaking your car setup to improve your lap times.
chinese: 排位赛会决定你在正式赛的起跑顺位。  在排位赛的圈速越快，起跑顺位就会越前。  通常这是将车辆调节为最大攻击的比赛。设定及策略分页可让你变更车辆的设定，也可以为即将进行的比赛拟定进站策略。  你也可以查看目前系列赛的常规与规则概要。先将车子带去试跑几圈，然后再回到维修站试着调整车子加快圈速。

english: The moment has finally arrived – your very first career race. Before the race starts, take a moment to make any final adjustments to your vehicle setup, change tyres, and finalise any pit strategies. When you’re ready, take a deep breath and get onto the track. Good luck out there!
chinese: 此刻终于来临了，你的第一场职业赛事。  赛事开始前，先花一点时间对你的车辆做一些最终调整，换好轮胎还有确定好进站策略。  当你准备好的时候，深呼一口气之后就上场吧。祝你好运!

english: Racing is about results, and this is where you can see how you did. All drivers are listed in order of their finishing positions. Along with that, you can see the points that each driver scored, as well as various other bits of info’ related to each driver and their race. If the series assigns team points, you’ll also see how the team scored here, too.
chinese: 赛车的一切都在于结果，而这里就是可以查看你的成果的地方。  所有车手都按照结束位置排序于列表上。你也可以看到每一位车手所获得的分数，还有需多其他与车手及他们的比赛相关情报。  如果系列赛有分配车队积分，你也可以在此查看车队的分数。

english: This table displays the driver and team standings in the current championship, and is based on the accumulated points scored in the races so far. Use this table to track how you and your team are doing in your pursuit of the championship crown. From here, you can either advance directly to the next round, or you can return to the Career Dashboard and continue the series at a later time.
chinese: 这个表显示着车手及车队在目前锦标赛的排名，并且是依据截至目前为止的赛事所加总的分数。  使用此表来随时留意你和你的车队距离所追求的锦标赛王冠还有多远。  在此，你可以直接晋级至下一回合，或返回职涯统计表并可在任何时间继续系列赛。

english: This race features a mandatory pit stop. This means you must make one single pit stop to change your tyres at any time between the start of the race and the end of the race. Failing to make a pit stop will lead to disqualification from the race results.
chinese: 此赛事包含强制进站。这代表在  比赛开始到结束之间，你必须要  进站一次并进行换胎。未能达成  进站会导致该场赛事取消资格。

english: The Pit Box Main Menu is where you prepare for the upcoming session. Take the time to edit your Car Setup, Pit Strategy, watch other competitors drive, make adjustments to your Game Options, or just skip the current session altogether.
chinese: 你可在维修站主菜单为即将到来的比赛做准备。花点时间编辑你的车辆调校、进站策略、观赏竞争者竞赛、调整你的游戏选项，或直接跳过目前比赛。

english: Every Motorsport hero needs to start somewhere – where will you begin? This is where you’ll need to decide whether you want to begin at the very bottom, in Karts, and race your way up through the Tiers to the very pinnacle of Motorsports in Tier 1, or simply jump straight into your favourite Motorsport and begin from there.
chinese: 每位赛车英雄都有他的起点，你的在哪里？在这里你必须决定是否要从最底层的卡丁车，一路通过各阶级达到一级的顶端。如果没有，则需要再一次尝试相同阶级的赛事。

english: Now that you’ve chosen your Motorsport, it’s time to decide which Series you’ll start your Career in. The Series structure varies according to which Motorsport you chose: Some offer multiple starting points, others have a single one, while others will offer just a single Series by itself.
chinese: 现在你已选择了你的赛事，是时候决定要在哪一个系列赛开始你的生涯。系列赛架构会依据你所选择的赛事而不同：有些会有多个起始点，有些只有一个，还有一些只有单向系列赛。

english: Here’s where you’ll need to make some decisions on which car you’ll race in your chosen Series. Having a tough time choosing? Take a look at the car performance stats. Also, pay close attention to the Car Class – if the Motorsport you chose has multiple classes, the Car Class you choose here will determine which Car Class you’ll be racing in.
chinese: 在这里你就必须决定要在选择的系列赛中使用哪一辆车。无法做出抉择吗？看一下车辆的性能表现。还有，要注意车辆的等级，如果选择的赛事有多等级，这里选择的车辆将会决定你要在哪一个车辆等级赛车。

english: Now that you’ve chosen your car, it’s time to choose your livery. The livery you choose will also determine which team you’ll be racing for.
chinese: 现在你选好车子了，是时候选择涂装了。选择的涂装会决定你将为哪一个车队赛车。

english: The final step to launching your motorsport career is this, your first contract. If you’re happy with your selections, go ahead and sign. Once you do that, your ultimate driver journey is all set to begin.
chinese: 开始你的生涯的最后一步就是这个，你的第一份合约。如果对你的选择感到满意，就直接签下去吧。一旦这么做，你的终极车手之旅就准备好启程了。

english: Congratulations! Now that you’re all set, you can either hit the track for a pre-season practice session (which you can leave at any time), or you can buckle-up and get your Career started for real.
chinese: 恭喜！现在你都准备好了，你可以到赛道上来一场季前练习赛 (可随时离开)，或上紧发条认真开始你的生涯。

english: Invitational Events are awarded throughout your Career progress. There are Invitational Events for varying Motorsport Disciplines, and they can be participated in and replayed any time, and as many times, as you want.
chinese: 在你的生涯进度中，你会受邀参加邀请赛事。邀请赛事有不同的赛事项目，可以随时随地参与和重玩，且不限次数。

english: Here you will find a wide variety of camera controls and functionality which will empower you to produce high-quality photos from near-enough any angle to show-off your own unique visual style. Any photos that you take using the Photo Mode will be saved and viewable in your Driver Network Profile.
chinese: 你可在此看到多种摄影机控制和功能，协助你从几乎任何角度，产出具备你独有风格的高质量相片。任何使用相片模式拍出的相片都会被保存，并可在你的车手网络个人资料中观看。

english: Earning affinity with specific manufacturers by driving their cars in your Career will allow you to unlock Manufacturer Drives.
chinese: 在生涯中驾驶指定制造商车辆，并获取熟悉度，可解锁制造商赛车。

english: This race features a mandatory pit stop. This means you must make one single pit stop at any time between the start of the race and the end of the race. Failing to make a pit stop will lead to disqualification from the race results.
chinese: 这场比赛要求强制进站。 这代表你从比赛开始到结束前必须进站一次，否则会在比赛结果中被取消资格。

english: Opponent Settings is where you decide the opponent's skill level, as well as the size of the grid, the car classes the opponent's will be racing in, and – if you’re not including a Qualifying Session – in what position you’ll start the race.
chinese: 你可以在对手设定决定对手的技术等级、起跑格的数量、对手的车辆等级，以及未安排排位赛时的比赛起跑位置。

english: The moment has finally arrived – your very first career race. Before the race starts, take a moment to make any final adjustments to your vehicle setup, change tyres, and finalise any pit strategies. When you’re ready, take a deep breath and get onto the track. And good luck out there!
chinese: 此刻终于来临了，你的第一场职业赛事。  赛事开始前，先花一点时间对你的车辆做一些最终调整，换好轮胎还有确定好进站策略。  当你准备好的时候，深呼一口气之后就上场吧。然后祝你好运！

english: Invitational Events are awarded throughout your Career progress. There are Invitational Events for various Motorsport Disciplines, and they can be participated in and replayed any time, and as many times, as you want.
chinese: 在你的生涯进度中，你会受邀参加邀请赛事。邀请赛事有各种赛事项目，可以随时随地参与和重玩，且不限次数。

english: The Career Dashboard is the main hub for managing your Career. Under the Home tab is everything related to the current core Series you are participating in. Here you’ll be able to head onto the track for each round, view the event calendar, check emails from your team and others, view your Series Standings, and read news headlines from your prior races.
chinese: 生涯统计表是管理生涯的主要平台。在首页标签下方，显示所有与你目前参加的主要系列赛有关的内容。你可在此进入每一回合的赛道、检视赛事日历、检查来自队友或其他人的电子邮件、检视你的系列赛排行，以及读取前场比赛的新闻头条。

english: Here’s where you’ll need to make some decisions on which car you’ll race in your chosen Series. Having a tough time choosing? Take a look at the performance stats. Also, pay close attention to the Car Class – if the Motorsport you chose has multiple classes, the Car Class you choose here will determine which Car Class you’ll be racing in.
chinese: 在这里你必须决定要在选择的系列赛中使用哪一辆车。无法做出抉择吗？看一下车辆的性能表现。还有，要注意车辆的等级，如果选择的赛事有多等级，这里选择的车辆将会决定你要在哪一个车辆等级赛车。

english: It’s race time! As you look around the pre-race menu, you’ll see a list of all the participants. You’re also able to view a detailed map of the track by selecting the map icon. If you need to, you can alter your Car Setup, as well as Pit Strategy before the race starts. Additionally, you can customise your Heads Up Display (HUD) layout in Options to suit your personal style. Hit the Start button.
chinese: 赛车时间到了！在查看预赛菜单时，会看到参加者名单。你也可以藉由点击地图图示来查看赛道的详细地图。  如果有必要，你也可以在比赛开始前变更你的车辆设定或进站策略。  此外，你也可以在选项中将信息显示（HUD）摆设自定义为符合你的风格。准备好赛车时就按下开始按键吧。

english: Keep up to date with latest news and info on Project CARS 2, by following us on Twitter: @ProjectCARSgame
chinese: 在Twitter上追踪我们，以获得Project CARS 2的最新消息与信息：@ProjectCARSgame

english: Keep up with all things Project CARS 2 and watch live-streaming of our Esports events by liking us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/projectcarsgame
chinese: 在我们的Facebook粉丝团按赞，以掌握Project CARS 2的最新消息，并观赏我们的 Esports 赛事直播：www.facebook.com/projectcarsgame

english: Check out exclusive behind-the-scenes pics and sneak peeks at www.instagram.com/projectcarsgame
chinese: 快来看看独家的幕后花絮及抢先看相片：www.instagram.com/projectcarsgame

english: Watch Driver Network Highlights and more of our favourite Project CARS 2 videos over at www.youtube.com/user/projectcarsgame
chinese: 来观赏车手网络头条，以及我们最爱的Project CARS 2影片：www.youtube.com/user/projectcarsgame

english: Check out the most amazing Project CARS 2 screenshots made by our community in the Driver Network gallery at www.flickr.com/photos/projectcarsgame
chinese: 快来看看我们的社群放在车手网络画廊的 Project CARS 2 惊人截图：www.flickr.com/photos/projectcarsgame

english: Visit the official Project CARS 2 website and never miss the latest news and events at www.projectcarsgame.com
chinese: 拜访Project CARS 2官方网页，别错过任何消息与活动：www.projectcarsgame.com

english: Join our Project CARS 2 community, get helpful driving tips and find fellow drivers to race against in the Official Project CARS 2 forums at http://forum.projectcarsgame.com
chinese: 到Project CARS 2官方论坛加入我们的Project CARS 2社群，获得有帮助的赛车提示及找到竞赛对手，立刻前往：http://forum.projectcarsgame.com

english: If you include a Qualifying or Practice session in your Online Custom Event, other players will be able to Join In Progress (JIP) at any time until the start of the race.
chinese: 如果你的在线自定赛事包含排位赛或练习赛，其他玩家将可于比赛开始前的任意时间中途加入 (JIP)。

english: You have control of a number of realism settings in Game Options, with the ability to alter driving assists, fuel usage, tyre wear, severity of flags and penalties, and on-screen guides.
chinese: 在游戏选项中，你可控制数样真实设定，可改变驾驶辅助系统、油耗、轮胎磨损、旗子和惩罚的宽松度，以及屏幕导引。

english: Choose your input method, gearing options, deadzones, sensitivities, button assignments, and wheel Force Feedback in Control Options.
chinese: 在控制选项选择你的输入方式、传动装置选项、死角、灵敏度、按钮配置，以及方向盘回馈力道。

english: Toggle individual aesthetic items such as lens flare, bloom, heat haze, and rain drops in Visual Options.
chinese: 在视觉选项中你可以切换每一个单独的设定例如太阳光晕、镜头光晕、全局泛光和雨滴特效。

english: Head to Camera Options where you can adjust the field-of-view settings, camera shake, Helmet View specifics, and more.
chinese: 你可以前往摄影机选项，调节视野范围设定、摄影机摇晃、头盔视角规格等。

english: The Car Showroom allows you to view your selected car and livery in a detailed garage environment, and take photos for your Driver Network Profile.
chinese: 你可以在车辆展示房中细节丰富的车库环境，检视所选择的车辆及涂装，并截取相片供你使用于车手网络个人资料。

english: Online Reputation monitors your online performance, analysing your success rate, races you’ve entered, penalties you’ve accrued, and the number of times you’ve been disqualified, all of which affect your Safety Grade and Reputation Strength.
chinese: 在线名誉会监控你的在线表现，分析你的成功率、进入的赛事、累积的处罚，以及取消资格的次数，一切都会影响你的安全等级和名誉强度。

english: Any photos you’ve taken and replays you’ve saved can be reviewed in your Driver Network Highlights.
chinese: 你可以在车手网络头条中回顾你所保存的任何相片及回放。

english: Check out the Driver Network Community Event schedule regularly over on Facebook, and projectcarsgame.com.
chinese: 定期在Facebook及 projectcarsgame.com 查看车手网络社群赛事排程。

english: Driver Network Time-Trial allows you to download friends’ ghosts as well as leaderboard entries to both compete against, and learn from.
chinese: 你可以在车手网络测时赛下载好友的幽灵及排行榜，让你与其竞赛并从中学习。

english: The Driver Network Leaderboards not only lists the cars used to achieve the lap times, but also the controllers used to set the times.
chinese: 车手网络排行榜不只是列出用于达成圈速的车辆，还包含用于创下纪录的控制器。

english: View progress towards Historic Goals in your Driver Network Profile and try to achieve Hall Of Fame status!
chinese: 在你的车手网络个人资料查看历史目标进度，并试着进入名人堂！

english: Earning Accolades will grant you access to other Career Motorsports and progression to the next tier up.
chinese: 获得荣誉可让你进入其他生涯赛事，并晋级至下一阶级。

english: Hit specific career milestones to get invitations to exclusive events.
chinese: 达成特定生涯里程碑，以获得进入独家赛事的邀请。

english: You got mail! Don’t forget to check your Career Inbox for messages from your team, scouts, and also invitations.
chinese: 你有一封新邮件！别忘了到你的生涯信箱查看来自你的车队、侦查的讯息，也别忘了查看邀请。

english: Review the results of previous rounds and other motorsports from the Results tab of your Career Dashboard.
chinese: 在你的生涯统计表结果标签，回顾前一回合及其他赛事的结果。

english: You can reposition HUD items from the Pause menu.
chinese: 你可以在暂停菜单调整信息显示项目的位置。

english: Photos can be taken not only on the track, but also in My Garage.
chinese: 你不只可在赛道上截图，也可在我的车库截图。

english: You can create multiple pit strategies for elements relating to tyres, damage, and fuel.
chinese: 你可以建立多个有关轮胎、损害、燃油等要素的进站策略。

english: Tuning setups can be saved to either individual locations or groups of similar locations, and can even be asymmetrical.
chinese: 调校设定可保存于单一场所，或相似场所的群组，并且不需要对称。

english: Got a question about how your car is handling? Troubleshoot common issues, and get help from your Race Engineer.
chinese: 对于你的车子状况有疑问吗？排除常见问题，并从你的赛车技师获得帮助。

english: You can monitor driver timings, edit your pit strategy, and watch a broadcast of the session, all from the pit garage.
chinese: 你可以在维修车库监控驾驶时间、编辑你的维修站策略，以及观赏比赛转播。

english: Manufacturer Affinity is the measure of the distance driven in cars from a specific manufacturer. Reaching a certain distance will unlock Manufacturer Drives for that manufacturer.
chinese: 制造商熟悉度是特定制造商车辆已行驶的距离。达成一定距离可解锁该制造商的制造商赛事。

english: Compare your Driver Network Profile against your friends and other Project CARS 2 drivers in the Driver Network Comparison.
chinese: 在车手网络对比中，比较你和好友，或你和其他Project CARS 2车手的车手网络个人资料。

english: Up for a challenge? Invite your friends round to try and complete a 24 hour race in real time (and why not stream it, too?).
chinese: 接受挑战吗？邀请你的好友在现实时间中完成一场 24 小时赛事 (何不顺便直播呢？)。

english: Some of your opponents are named after SMS employees! Check the credits, and then look out for them on-track.
chinese: 你的一些对手是以 SMS 员工命名！查看工作人员清单，并在赛道上找寻他们。

english: The Marek, and RWD vehicles were designed and created for the first Project CARS 2 game by community members from WMD.
chinese: Marek以及RWD车辆，是由 WMD 社群成员为第一款Project CARS 2游戏而设计的。

english: Stability Control and Traction Control are linked. Turning on SC forces TC to come on as well: to turn off TC, you first need to turn off SC.
chinese: 车身稳定控制与牵引控制环环相扣。开启 SC 也会让 TC 强制开启：要关闭 TC，你必须先关闭 SC。

english: Before the race starts, make sure you’ve got the car set up for the race, and that you’ve made final adjustments to your pit strategies.
chinese: 在赛事开始前，记得将车子调成适合赛事，还有对进站策略进行最终调整。

english: At the end of qualifying, you can still finish your qualifying hotlap to try and grab that top grid spot.
chinese: 在排位的最后，你还是可以完成你的排位暖胎圈，并试着争取前排起跑位置。

english: Online Championships are perfect for racing leagues or communities, tournaments, or competing against friends across a number of rounds of your choosing (maximum of 24).
chinese: 在线锦标赛最适合赛车联盟或社群、比赛，或与好友以你选择的回合数竞赛 (最多 24)。

english: Be careful when leaving the pits on cold tyres. Tyres can take up to a lap to warm up to operating temperature.
chinese: 装上冷胎离开维修区的时候要小心一点。轮胎有可能需要一圈的热身以达到运作温度。

english: Change the date, or season setting in Race Settings to enjoy your favourite track during your favourite time of the year; hot or cold, rain or sunshine, or just drive it on a cold, snowy winter day!
chinese: 在赛事设定变更日期或季节，好让你可以在一年当中最喜欢的时间享受你最喜爱的赛道，管它天气是热或冷，下雨还是放晴，也可以直接在冬雪纷飞中赛车！

english: Multi-Class racing is all about competing against cars and drivers in the same class as you. Although you may not be in first overall, points are allocated on a per-class basis.
chinese: 多等级赛车就是和与你相同等级的车辆及车手竞速。即使你不能当整体的第一，分数是按各等级分布。

english: You can pick up to 4 different classes of your choosing for a Multi-Class race in any Custom Event, Online Custom Event, or Online Championship where you’re the admin’.
chinese: 在你所管理的任何多等级赛车或在线锦标赛的自定赛事中，你可以选择高达 4 种不同等级。

english: Be mindful of your driving line in the wet. Standing water can cause the car to aquaplane, and with water pooling at the lower points of the track, the racing line may no longer be the best line through a corner.
chinese: 雨天中要注意你的驾驶线。水洼会造成车辆在水上滑行，而因为赛道低点的积水，驾驶线也有可能不再是弯道的最佳路线。

english: If you see a driver off-track, be mindful when passing that location after they’ve rejoined the track. They may have pulled dirt, gravel, and mud back onto the track which will reduce grip.
chinese: 看到车手偏离赛道时，在他们返回赛道后最好在通过该地点时多多留意。他们也许会将泥泞、碎石和泥巴带到赛道上，并使该地点抓地力减少。

english: When it stops raining, try and follow the same line as the other cars. This will help clear the water from puddles, and create a dry line quicker.
chinese: 雨停后，试着遵循与其他车辆相同的路线。这会帮助清除水坑的水，可更快制造一条干燥的路线。

english: Oval racing is tough. Racing inches apart at 200-plus mph is not only intense, but requires the driver to think about how other cars affect airflow over their own car.
chinese: 椭圆赛道很困难。要以超过时速 200 英里的速度赛车不只是程度激烈，更需要车手思考其他车辆如何影响自己车的气流。

english: IndyCars have 10 Push-To-Pass shots to use in the race. These can be used at any time, so use them wisely.
chinese: Indy赛车在一场赛事中有 10 次超车的机会。这可以在任何时间使用，所以明智地使用他们。

english: Pit Strategies are now saved on a per-car basis, allowing you to use the same pit strategy for one car across multiple tracks.
chinese: 进站策略是按车辆保存，让你的车可以在不同赛道使用相同进站策略。

english: You now have the ability to create multiple car setups for one car, allowing you to create a setup to cover almost any scenario.
chinese: 你现在可以为一辆车建立多个车辆设定，成为适用于几乎所有场景的设定。

english: Use the rallycross Motorsport Preset to create rallycross races in Custom Event, Online Custom Event, and Online Championships.
chinese: 使用场地拉力赛事的默认值，在自定赛事、在线自定赛事，以及在线锦标赛建立场地拉力赛事。

english: Enjoyed the Custom Event you just completed? Go into the the Favourites section in Custom Event and add it as a Favourite to save all its settings and session configurations which you can then load whenever you want.
chinese: 喜欢你刚刚完成的自定赛事吗？到自定赛事中的最爱区块将其加入最爱，保存其所有设定及比赛设置，并可在之后随时读取。

english: Practice and Qualifyings can be set to any length up to 24 Hours, in 5 minute increments.
chinese: 练习及排位赛可以 5 分钟为单位，最长设定到 24 小时。

english: Ready to up your game? Try turning up the AI Strength to 120 percent for more of a challenge.
chinese: 准备好面对更高挑战了吗？将 AI 强度提高至 120% 来增加挑战性。

english: AI Aggression and Strength can be configured independently of each other; using a combination of both means you can find the your own perfect balance of AI difficulty.
chinese: AI 攻击性与强度可个别设置，使用两者的组合，可让你找到适合你的 AI 难度的完美平衡。

english: The In-Car Management (ICM) menu allows you make real-time adjustments to the car, as well as your pit strategy, whilst driving out on track. Ensure you have it configured in the Button Assignments section of the Control Options.
chinese: 你可以透过车内管理(ICM)菜单，在赛道上实时调整车辆及维修站策略。确保你已设置在控制选项的按键配置区块中。

english: If you're looking for a cleaner and more challenging online experience, try turning up the Minimum Safety Grade, or Minimum Reputation Strength, to only allow safer and more successful drivers into your lobby. Note: This may potentially decrease the number of players who can enter your lobby.
chinese: 如果你在寻找无碰撞、更具挑战性的在线体验，试着调高最低安全等级，或最低名誉强度，好让你的大厅只允许更安全、更成功的车手。注意：这有可能会降低可进入你的大厅的玩家数量。

english: Want to challenge yourself online against Project CARS 2’ fastest online racers? Turn up the Minimum Reputation Strength to only allow the most successful online drivers into your lobby. Note: This may potentially decrease the number of players who will enter your lobby.
chinese: 想要在在线挑战 Project CARS 2 中最快的在线跑者吗？调高最低名誉强度，好让你的大厅只允许最成功的线上车手进入。注意：这有可能会降低可以进入你的大厅的玩家数量。

english: If you’re using a Virtual Reality headset, make sure to head to the VR Options to tailor them for the ultimate VR experience.
chinese: 如果你在使用虚拟现实头戴式显示器，记得前往 VR 选项将他们打造为终极的 VR 体验。

english: Want to start a new Career path without losing the progress of your current driver? Why not create multiple drivers for your Career?
chinese: 想要开始新的生涯但不想失去现有车手的进度吗？何不为你的生涯建立多个车手？

english: Share car setups with friends and other drivers via the Car Setup screen in either the Pre-Race, or In-Garage menus.
chinese: 在預賽或車庫內菜单中的車輛設定畫面，將車輛調校分享給好友和其他車手。

english: Some cars in-game have multiple versions, such as high and low downforce versions, or GT3. and special endurance versions of GT3 cars.
chinese: 游戏中部份车辆有多种版本，例如高和低下压力版本，或 GT3 车辆和其特殊耐力版。

english: Completing all Manufacturer Drive events for a specific manufacturer will unlock a car from that manufacturer. There are 14 in total.
chinese: 为特定制造商完成所有制造商赛车赛事，会解锁该制造商的一辆车。总共有 14 辆。

english: Make sure to read the Rules & Regulations to ensure you’re aware of any special rules in the motorsport you’re competing in, such as points systems, mandatory Pit stops, and start procedures.
chinese: 记得详阅你所参加的赛事的常规与规章，了解任何如积分系统、强制停站，以及起跑程序的特殊规则。

english: If your car has soft and hard slick tyres options, make sure to use them for the right conditions. Soft slicks provide good initial grip, but wear quicker, and are prone to overheating. Hard slicks will last longer and work better than soft slicks in hotter conditions.
chinese: 如果你的车辆有软质及硬质光头胎的选项，记得在正确的条件下使用他们。软质光头胎提供良好的起始抓地力，但磨损较快，且容易过热。相较于硬质光头胎，硬质光头胎热的条件下有较长的持久力。

english: If you want a more realistic pit experience, try turning the Manual Pit Lane option to “On” in order to have full control of the car when pitting.
chinese: 如果想要更多的真实维修区体验，试着将手动进站选项「开启」才能够在进站时完全掌控车辆。

english: To help identify your pit crew for a Manual Pit stop, you can enable the Visual pit cue in the Gameplay options.
chinese: 要在手动停站时辨识你的技师团队，你可以在游戏性选项启用维修站视觉提示。

english: If you’re struggling to beat a ghost time in TT, why not try their setup by saving it, and applying it to your car, or just view the ghost to learn the quickest lines.
chinese: 如果你无法赢过测时赛的幽灵，何不保存他们的设定并套用至你的车辆，或是观察幽灵学习他们的最快路线。

english: If you have set your Opponent AI Strength to 80% or higher, then the AI will adjust their setup to suit the track you are racing at.
chinese: 如果你将你的对手AI强度设定为80%以上，  AI将会调整设定以对应你比赛的跑道。

english: View progress towards Lifetime Goals in your Career Progress & Settings, and try to achieve Hall Of Fame status!
chinese: 在你的生涯进度＆设定查看  终身目标进度，并试着进入名人堂！

english: Any photos you've taken and replays you've saved can be viewed via the 'My Profile' tab on Race Central.
chinese: 你可以在赛事中心「个人资料」中，回顾你所保存的任何相片及回放。

english: Time-Trial allows you to download friends' ghosts as well as leaderboard entries to both compete against, and learn from. Click the ghost slot in the Time-Trial pre-race screen to view a ghost's lap.
chinese: 测时赛允许你下载好友的幽灵以及排行榜用来对决和学习。  在测时赛预赛画面点击并检视幽灵空位。

english: Share car setups with friends and other drivers via the Tuning Setup Share screen in either the Pre-Race, or In-Garage menus.
chinese: 在预赛或车库内菜单中的调校设定画面，将车辆调校分享给好友和其他车手。

english: Review the results of previous rounds from the Standings screen of your Career Dashboard.
chinese: 在你的生涯统计表排行画面，回顾前一回合的结果。

english: Photos can be taken not only on the track, but also in the Showroom.
chinese: 你不只可在赛道上截图，也可在展示房截图。

english: Aston Martin is hosting an event featuring the new Aston Martin DB11 road car racing around the tight confines of the Azure Circuit. This is your chance to test some of Aston Martin’s finest machinery.
chinese: Aston Martin要在刺激的 AZURE 赛车场，举办一场新Aston Martin DB11 路车赛。这是让你测试Aston Martin最优良车辆的机会。

english: There’s an upcoming GT4 race at Donington Park National. Aston Martin is offering you a race-seat in their Vantage GT4 car, against 15 other GT4 competitors. This is a great opportunity, so do your best to impress.
chinese: Donington Park国立赛道即将有一场GT4赛车。Aston Martin邀请你参加他们的Vantage GT4赛事，与其他15位GT4竞争者较劲。这是个绝佳的机会，尽全力表现吧。

english: Aston Martin was impressed by your last outing. They need a driver for a GT3 race around the streets of Long Beach in the Aston Martin V12 Vantage GT3 against 21 other GT3 cars.
chinese: Aston Martin对你上次的表现印象深刻。他们需要一位车手参加举办于Long Beach的Aston Martin V12老爷车GT3车赛，与另外21辆GT3车辆对抗。

english: The Red Bull Ring is hosting a multi-class race featuring GTE and GT3 cars. Aston Martin was thrilled by your previous performances, and are now offering you a seat in the Aston Martin V8 Vantage GTE. Winning this event will unlock the Aston Martin DB11.
chinese: Red Bull Ring要举办一场GTE及GT3车辆的多等级赛车。Aston Martin对于你上次的表现感到非常兴奋，现在他们在Aston Martin V8 Vantage GTE为你准备了一个车席。这场赛事获胜的话将解锁Aston Martin DB11。

english: There’s an offer open to drive the Audi A1 Quattro at an event at the Hockenheim Short circuit. Audi has noticed you racing its machinery, and they want you in that seat.
chinese: Hockenheim短程赛道上举办的Audi A1 Quattro赛事还有一个空缺。Audi注意到了你驾驶他们的车辆赛车，所以要将空缺给你。

english: There’s an upcoming historic GTO event at Laguna Seca, and Audi thinks you’d be a perfect fit to tame the Audi 90 IMSA GTO.
chinese: Laguna Seca即将有一场老式GTO赛事，Audi认为你是驾驭Audi 90 IMSA GTO的最佳人选。

english: Audi has a race seat available in a multi-class race featuring GT3 and GT4 opponents. The track is the Nürburgring Short layout, and Audi want you to drive their R8 LMS GT3 car. Hearing rumours that doing well in this event could mean an opportunity to drive Audi’s modern LMP1 masterpiece, so don’t mess it up!
chinese: Audi在多等级GT3及GT4对手赛有一个空缺。赛道是Nürburgring短程赛道，Audi要你驾驶他们的R8 LMS GT3。听说在这场赛事成绩好的话，会有机会驾驶Audi的现代LMP1杰作，别搞砸了！

english: Here it is! Audi is inviting you to drive their R18 E-Tron LMP1 car in a Le Mans-style multi-class race, including other LMP1, LMP2, and GTE competitors, at the famous Spa-Francorchamps circuit. Victory in this event will unlock the Audi A1 Quattro.
chinese: 来了！Audi邀请你在Le Mans多等级赛事驾驶他们的R18 E-Tron LMP1，于知名的Spa-Francorchamps赛道，与其他LMP1、LMP2及GTE竞赛。这场赛事胜利即可解锁Audi A1 Quattro。

english: Bentley want to put you head-to-head against one of their drivers in identical Bentley Continental GT3s at California Highway Stage 1. This is your chance to really impress.
chinese: Bentley想让你在California Highway第1赛段，  与他们的一名车手驾驶他们的Bentley  Continental GT3竞速。  这是你表现的机会。

english: Silverstone is hosting a GT3 race on its International layout, and Bentley is inquiring whether you’re keen to race their Continental GT3 car.
chinese: Silverstone将在他们的国际赛道举办GT3赛事，而Bentley询问你是否要以他们的Continental GT3参赛。

english: The Sakitto Circuit is hosting an historic LMP900 race with 16 cars in total, and Bentley is offering you a seat in one of their Bentley Speed 8s after your impressive run at Silverstone.
chinese: Sakitto赛车场要举办一场共16辆车的老式LMP900赛事，看到你在Silverstone赛道的惊人表现后，Bentley为你准备了一个Bentley Speed 8的车席。

english: Bentley is offering up one final event at the Circuit of The Americas, again in the Bentley Speed 8, this time in a multi-class race with other LMP900s along with GT1 cars. Winning this event will unlock the Bentley Speed 8.
chinese: Bentley邀请你参加在Circuit of the Americas的最后一场赛事，一样是Bentley Speed 8，但这次是与LMP900 及 GT1的多等级赛事。这场赛事获胜的话将解锁Bentley Speed 8。

english: BMW has a GT4 event coming up at the Motorsport Arena Oschersleben. There’s an offer for you to pilot a BMW M3 GT4 race car.
chinese: BMW在Oschersleben赛车场即将有一场GT4赛事。你有一个驾驶BMW M3 GT4的邀请。

english: BMW has an historic touring car race at Brno, and they want to know whether you’re up to racing one of their most epic race cars, the Group A BMW M3 E30.
chinese: BMW即将在Brno举办老式房车赛，他们想知道你是否愿意以他们最经典的赛车A组BMW M3 E30参赛。

english: There is a BMW 320TC waiting for you at Donington Park National Circuit for a race against 21 other competitors. BMW was thrilled with how you drove their historic touring car, and they’re really keen to see you in action in a modern one.
chinese: Donington Park国立赛道有一辆BMW 320TC正在等着你去驾驶，并和21个对手竞赛。BMW对于你如何驾驭他们的老式房车感到非常满意，而他们现在等不及要看到你在现代版的表现。

english: There’s a fabulous offer from BWW to race the new BMW M6 GT3 in a GT3-class race around the Dubai Autodrome. Finishing first will unlock the BMW M1.
chinese: BMW有一个超棒的邀请，要你在Dubai Autodrome以新的BMW M6 GT3参加GT3等级赛事。以第一名完成即可解锁BMW M1。

english: The Corvette C7 Z06 is a great supercar to enjoy the twisty mountain roads of the California Highway. Corvette is hosting a race there, and they want you behind the wheel. Interested?
chinese: Corvette C7 Z06是一辆可以尽情享受California Highway崎岖山路的超跑。Corvette要在那举办一场比赛，而他们想要由你担任驾驶。有兴趣吗？

english: Cadillac is offering up their ATS-VR to compete in a GT3 race against 19 other cars around the Daytona Road Course.
chinese: Cadillac邀请你以他们的ATS-VR在Daytona公路赛道的GT3赛事，与其他19辆车竞赛。

english: Chevrolet was impressed at how you handled the C7 Z06. They have another event at the Circuit of The Americas, a multi-class race against other GTEs as well as LMP2 and LMP1 cars. They want you in the Corvette C7R GTE.
chinese: Chevrolet对你驾驭C7 Z06的方式印象非常深刻。他们在Circuit of the Americas有另一场赛事，是一场对抗GTE、LMP2及LMP1的多等级赛事。他们要你去开Chevrolet C7R GTE。

english: Chevrolet is really buzzing over your performance in the Corvette C7R GTE, and they’re offering something truly special: racing wheel-to-wheel in a Dallara DW 12 H around the Indianapolis Road Course. If you win, the Chevrolet Corvette C7 Z06 will be unlocked.
chinese: Chevrolet对你在Chevrolet C7R GTE的表现感到满心欢喜，而他们现在有一项非常特别的邀请：以Dallara DW 12H在Indianapolis公路赛道进行赛车。赢了的话， 即可解锁Chevrolet Corvette C7 Z06。

english: Ferrari is hosting an historic race along the Scottish mountain roads of Bannochbrae. They’re bringing six exotic 288 GTOs, and one of them has your name on it.
chinese: Ferrari将在苏格兰高地的Bannochbrae举办老式赛车。他们将准备六辆绝世288 GTO，而其中一辆是你的。

english: Ferrari is staging an event at Imola. You impressed them in the 288 GTO, and they want you to go up against 11 other drivers in a single-make series racing the incredibly rare Ferrari F40 LM.
chinese: Ferrari要在Imola举办一场赛事。你已经用288 GTO已经让他们见识到你的本领，他们现在要你以他们异常稀有的Ferrari F40 LM，在一场单一系列赛与其他11位车手对抗。

english: Monza is hosting a GT3 race featuring 28 cars. Ferrari is entering one of their 488 GT3 racers, and they’ve invited you to drive it to victory.
chinese: Monza要举办一场28辆车的GT3赛事。Ferrari有登录一辆488 GT3，而他们邀请你将它开向胜利。

english: Ferrari’s addition to the Holy Trinity is waiting for you at Portimão, where Ferrari is hosting a race with 9 other Ferrari LaFerraris. If you win this event, you will unlock the Ferrari 288 GTO.
chinese: Ferrari附加的 Holy Trinity 正在波尔蒂芒等着你，Ferrari将在那举办包含其他 9 辆 Ferrari LaFerrari 的赛事。如果你赢得这场赛事，你将会解锁 Ferrari 288 GTO。

english: Ford is hosting a race at Sonoma Raceway with their new Ford GT road car around. Beat 15 other competitors, and Ford will offer you race opportunities at other events.
chinese: Ford要在Sonoma Raceway为他们新的Ford GT路车举办赛事。击败15位竞争者，才有机会让Ford邀请你参加其他赛事。

english: There’s a rallycross event coming up at the Lydden Hill Rallycross Circuit, and Ford has a race seat available for the event in their Ford Focus GRC. They want you in it.
chinese: Lydden Hill场地拉力赛场即将举办场地拉力赛事，Ford的Focus GRC还有驾驶空缺。他们想要你担任驾驶。

english: Ford has invited you to an iconic Australian Motorsport event: a race in the Ford Falcon FG V8 Supercar on the infamous Bathurst circuit.
chinese: Ford邀请你参加一场指标性的澳洲赛事：以Ford Falcon FV V8超跑挑战恶名昭彰的Bathurst赛道。

english: Ford is offering a taste of Le Mans with their new Ford GT GTLM car, racing against other GTE cars in a multi-class race around Circuit des 24 Heures du Mans. Win, and you will unlock the Ford Mustang Fastback 66.
chinese: Ford要在Le Mans尝试他们的新车Ford GT、GTLM，在Circuit des 24 Heures du Mans赛道的多等级赛事与其他GTE竞赛。赢了你就能解锁Ford Mustang Fastback 66。

english: Ginetta Cars has a race seat on offer in their G55 GT4. It’s entered at an event at Cadwell Park GP circuit in a GT4 class race.
chinese: Ginetta Cars的G55 GT4有一个空的赛车席。他登录了一个位于Cadwell Park GP赛道的GT4赛事。

english: Ginetta Cars was impressed by your outing in their G55 GT4. They’ve now entered you for a GT3 race in their Ginetta G55 GT3 at the Snetterton 300 circuit.
chinese: Ginetta Cars对于你在他们G55 GT4的表现印象深刻。他们现在将你登录在他们的Ginetta G55 GT3下，参加Snetterton 300赛道的GT3赛事。

english: Ginetta Cars has entered their LMP3 version of the G57 into an LMP3-only race around Jin Ding in China. The race seat is empty, waiting for you.
chinese: Ginetta Cars已经将他们 LMP3 版本的 G57，登绿到中国金顶附近的 LMP3 限定赛事。赛车席还是空的，在等着你。

english: The last event Ginetta Cars is offering is in their trackday version of the G57. They feel Sugo will be a great place to test the aero’ and cornering performance of the car. Winning this event will unlock the Ginetta G57.
chinese: Ginetta Cars邀请的最后一项赛事，  是他们赛道日版本的G57。  他们认为SUGO会是测试车子空气动力和  过弯性能的绝佳地点。这场赛事获胜的话  将解锁Ginetta G57。

english: Daytona is hosting a rallycross event on their rallycross track, and Honda is keen to get you behind the wheel of their Civic GRC. Get out there and impress them!
chinese: Daytona要在他们的场地拉力赛道举办一场场地拉力赛，而Honda希望你可以驾驶他们的Civic GRC。去让他们知道你的厉害吧！

english: Honda was impressed by your rallycross skills and want you in the new Acura NSX road car. The race is against 15 other NSX road cars around the Watkins Glen Circuit.
chinese: Honda对你的场地拉力技术非常满意，并且想要你驾驶他们的新Acura NSX路车。赛事在Watkins Glen赛道举行，和另外15辆NSX路车竞速。

english: One of the newest GT3 race cars is the Acura NSX GT3. There’s a race seat available in one, competing in a GT3 race around Road America.
chinese: Acura NSX GT3是最新的GT3赛车之一。Road America赛道的GT3赛事有一个空缺的赛车席。

english: Honda is in need of a driver for an upcoming event at Texas Motor Speedway. It’s an oval race, in their Dallara DW 12 H. If you win this, you will unlock the 2017 Acura NSX.
chinese: Honda急需一名车手参加即将举办于Texas Motor Speedway的赛事。这是一场椭圆跑道，使用他们的Dallara DW 12H。赢了这场即可解锁2017 Acura NSX。

english: Mike Pero Motorsport (Ruapuna) Park is hosting a Lamborghini-only event on their Club circuit. Lamborghini has asked whether you’re available to take one of their Lamborghini Sesto Elementos up against 15 other competitors.
chinese: Mike Pero Motorsport (Ruapuna Park) 要在他们的俱乐部赛车场，举办一场Lamborghini限定赛事。Lamborghini询问你是否能够驾驶他们的Lamborghini Sesto Elementos，与其他15名竞争者竞速。

english: Lamborghini was really pleased with the way you handled the Sesto Elemento. They’ve invited you to get a taste of their single-make Super Trofeo Series where you’ll be up against 23 others in the Lamborghini Huracan Super Trofeo around the Autodromo Algarve in Portimão.
chinese: Lamborghini对你掌控Sesto Elementos的方式感到非常满意。他们邀请你去尝试他们的单一Super Trofeo系列赛，你将驾驶Lamborghini Huracan Super Trofeo，在Protimao的Algarve赛道与23人竞速。

english: Lamborghini is entering a GT3 race at Catalunya against 23 other GT3 cars. They’re offering you a race seat for the event in their Huracan GT3 car.
chinese: Lamborghini在Catalunya登录了一场对抗23辆GT3的GT3赛事。他们邀请你驾驶他们的Huracan GT3参加赛事。

english: Lamborghini is hosting an event at Sportsland SUGO using their Diablo GTR. They want you in one of the seats. Finish first, and you will unlock the Lamborghini Sesto Elemento.
chinese: Lamborghini要用他们的Diablo GTR在Sportsland SUGO举办一场赛事。他们要你在担任其中一辆车的驾驶。赢得第一，你就可以解锁Lamborghini Sesto Elemento。

english: Zolder is hosting a race featuring a number of McLaren 570S road cars. There’s a spare seat available for you, which could open the path to more McLaren events.
chinese: Zolder要举办一场对抗大量McLaren 570S路车的赛事。有留一个空位给你，这也许是通往更多McLaren赛事的路径。

english: McLaren is entering one of their legendary F1 GTRs into an historic GT1 race at Spa-Francorchamps. They have one car waiting for you.
chinese: McLaren要在Spa-Francorchamps，使用他们的传奇F1 GTR参加老式GT1赛事。他们有一辆车在等着你。

english: McLaren is offering the chance for a handpicked group of drivers to explore the limits of their latest performance road car, the McLaren 720S. It’s taking place at the Silverstone International Circuit, and they want you there.
chinese: McLaren精挑细选，选中你为车手一员，一探他们的最新性能路车McLaren 720S的界限。赛事将会在Silverstone国际赛道举办，而他们要你出席。

english: The McLaren P1, one of the three supercars that make up the Holy Trinity, has become even better with the McLaren P1 GTR. How much better? You can find out if you head down to the Red Bull Ring GP Circuit because McLaren have one waiting for you. Win, and you will unlock the McLaren P1 GTR.
chinese: Holy Trinity的其中一辆超跑McLaren P1，已经进化为更好的McLaren P1 GTR。有多好？你到了Red Bull Ring GP赛道就知道了，因为McLaren有一辆车在等着你。赢了，你就能解锁McLaren P1 GTR。

english: DirtFish is hosting a rallycross event on their Pro Rallycross Course, and Mercedes-Benz has offered you a chance to drive for them at the event, in their 600hp Mercedes A45 RX car.
chinese: DirtFish要在他们的职业场地拉力赛道举办场地拉力赛事，而Mercedes-Benz给了你一个机会使用他们的600马力Mercedes-Benz A45 RX，在那场赛事为他们赛车。

english: Mercedes-Benz has an event scheduled at Watkins Glen. You’re among an exclusive group of drivers invited to race the new Mercedes AMG GT R.
chinese: Mercedes-Benz在Watkins Glen安排了一场赛事。你是受邀与新的Mercedes-Benz AMG GT R竞赛的独家车手之一。

english: Mercedes-Benz want you to take on the Green Hell and 31 other GT3 opponents in their Mercedes SLS GT3 in a race around the Nordschleife Circuit.
chinese: Mercedes-Benz要你参加他们位于Nordschleife赛道的SLS GT3赛事，和其他31名对手在Green Hell竞速。

english: Mercedes-Benz is inviting drivers to come slip and slide their way between the icy snowbanks of Sampala in a AMG C63 Coupes. Winning this event will unlock the Mercedes AMG GT R.
chinese: Mercedes-Benz邀请车手们，  到Sampala雪地赛道驾驶AMG C63竞速。  赢得此赛事可解锁Mercedes AMG GT R。

english: Nissan is offering a select group of drivers a chance to race the Nissan GT-R Nismo around the tight and technical circuit at Sportsland SUGO. They’re offering you a seat at the event.
chinese: Nissan给予一群车手独家机会，在既紧密又充满技术性的Sportsland SUGO，驾驶Nissan GT-R Nismo。他们在赛事为你保留一席。

english: Nissan is entering an historic touring car race over in the US, at the Texas Motor Speedway. They’ll be racing around the Road Course layout in Nissan Fairlady Z GTSs.
chinese: Nissan要参加美国Texas Motor Speedway的老式房车赛事。他们将以Nissan Fairlady Z GTS赛车。

english: You impressed everyone at the Texas Motor Speedway. There’s an historic Group C event taking place at Fuji Speedway where Nissan has entered their epic R89C race car. They’re offering you a race seat and you’ll be up against a field of 28 Group C monsters.
chinese: 你在Texas Motor Speedway让大家刮目相看了。Fuji Speedway有一场老式C组赛事，而Nissan已经登录了他们的经典R89C。他们想要提供你一席，而你将对抗28位C组怪物。

english: Nissan want you to conquer “The Mountain” in the Nissan GT-R GT3 against other GT3 cars racing up and down the grueling Bathurst Circuit. Claiming victory for this event will unlock the Nissan Fairlady Z GTS.
chinese: Nissan要你乘坐Nissan GT-R GT3在充满敌意的Bathurst赛道，与其他GT3上下奔驰，并征服「那座山」。这场赛事胜利即可解锁Nissan Fairlady Z GTS。

english: Porsche is offering the chance to experience their entry in the Holy Trinity of sportscars, the Porsche 918 Spyder, at an event along the picturesque mountain road of Azure Coast.
chinese: Porsche提供了一个可以体验一辆登录在Holy Trinity的跑车，Porsche 918 Spyder，赛事位于风景如画的Azure Coast。

english: Porsche is taking part in an historic Group 5 race with their Porsche 935 77 around the Historic Hockenheim circuit, and have a spare race seat available for you.
chinese: Porsche将会以Porsche 935 77，参加位于老式Hockenheim赛道的老式5组赛事，他们为你保留了席位。

english: You really impressed everyone at Hockenheim in the 935 77. There’s an event at Autodromo Algarve in Portimão consisting of a field of GT4 cars where Porsche has entered their Cayman GT4, and they’ve offered you the race seat.

english: We can still claim a decent position in the Drivers Championship. Keep the results coming and we'll grab it!
chinese: 我们还是可以在车手锦标赛夺下一个好的位置。继续保持结果让我们拿下它吧！

english: Don't give up on the drivers championship. Let's aim for a decent position. Keep those results coming in and we'll grab something.
chinese: 别放弃车手锦标赛。我们把目标定在好的位置上吧。继续保持那些结果让我们拿下什么吧！

english: Good positions in the Drivers Championship are still up for grabs! Make sure you get the best result you can!
chinese: 还是有机会拿下车手锦标赛的好顺位。确保拿出你最好的结果。

english: Positions in the Drivers Championship are still up for grabs! Make sure you get the best result you can!
chinese: 还是有机会拿下车手锦标赛的好顺位。确保拿出你最好的结果。

english: Even though we've missed out on the top spot, we can still get a decent position in the drivers championship. Let's make a big push.
chinese: 虽然我们错失了优胜，但我们还是可以在车手锦标赛拿到不错的顺位。我们加把劲努力吧。

english: OK, we've missed out on the top spot, but we can still get a decent position in the championship. Let's make a big push.
chinese: 好，我们错失了优胜，但我们还是可以在锦标赛拿到不错的顺位。我们加把劲努力吧。

english: We've missed out on the top spot, but we can still get a decent position in the championship. Let's push this all the way to the end.
chinese: 我们错失了优胜，但我们还是可以在锦标赛拿到不错的顺位。我们一路努力到最后吧。

english: Just keep bringing in those points. We can still grab a decent spot in the drivers championship.
chinese: 只要继续取得分数。我们还是可以在车手锦标赛拿下一个不错顺位。

english: Don't give up yet. It's not over 'til it's over. We can still finish well in the drivers championship.
chinese: 还不要放弃。在结束前都还没结束。我们还是可以在车手锦标赛取得佳绩。

english: It's really important we don't give up just yet. Keep pushing and we can still get a decent result in the drivers championship.
chinese: 最重要的是永不放弃。继续努力，我们还是可以在车手锦标赛拿下好结果。

english: You've made the team and the sponsors proud. Well done this season.
chinese: 你让车队及赞助商感到骄傲。这一季做得不错。

english: Fantastic. You've really made the team and the sponsors proud. Well done this year.
chinese: 太棒了。你真的让车队及赞助商感到骄傲。今年做得不错。

english: You've made the team and the sponsors proud. Well done this year. You should be in for a raise.
chinese: 你让车队及赞助商感到骄傲。今年做得不错。你应该获得加薪。

english: This season is one for the books. Great job champ.
chinese: 这一季应要在书上加注一笔。干得好冠军！

english: Fantastic result. You really earned it this season.
chinese: 出色的结果。这一季的是你应得的。

english: You really deserved that result. Fantastic job this season.
chinese: 这真的是你应得的结果。这一季做得太棒了。

english: All season you showed these guys you've got what it takes. The team wants to celebrate, so bring it back in one piece!
chinese: 整个赛季你都让这些家伙见识到你是怎么做到的。车队想要庆祝一下，记得平安归来！

english: I've seen some great driving in my time, and that was near the top. Congratulations champ.
chinese: 我的人生见识过不少很棒的驾驶，而那已经接近巅峰了。恭喜你，冠军。

english: That's how we do it. Nice driving champ. You're a legend!
chinese: 我们就是这样做的。开得好，冠军。你是传说！

What’s the issue with the Downforce on the car?
chinese: 车子的下压力发生什么问题？

english: I keep spinning out in fast corners.
chinese: 我在急转弯的时候一直打滑。

english: The car doesn’t turn into corners.
Go back to the Engineer menu.
Go back to the Downforce menu.

OK, if it feels as if you’re losing grip at the rear through fast turns, that could mean that the rear wing angle is too low and not generating enough rear Downforce, which is causing oversteer. We can increase rear Downforce for you. You can also look at the Suspension, as that could provide alternative solutions to this problem.
chinese: 好，看起来你在快弯时车尾会失去抓地力，这有可能是因为尾翼角度太低而产生的后方下压力不足，所以造成过度转向。我们可以帮你增加后方下压力。你也可以看看悬挂系统，那有可能为这个问题提供其他解决方案。

english: OK, if you feel as if the car isn’t turning into corners, in all likelihood you’re suffering from understeer. We can increase the front wing, or splitter angle, which will give you more front Downforce and “bite”.
chinese: 好，如果你觉得车子在弯道转不过去，你应该是转向不足。可以增加前翼或分离角，那会让你有更多前方下压力和「咬力」。

english: I can’t hit my top speed.
What’s the issue with the gearing?
chinese: 传动装置现在发生什么问题？

english: Go back to the Gearing menu.
So, you are hitting or getting very near to the rev limiter in the highest gear on the longest straight.
chinese: 所以，你在最长的直线有达到或接近转速限制的最高速。

english: So, you are not hitting or getting very near to the rev limiter in the highest gear on the longest straight.
chinese: 所以，你在最长的直线没有达到或接近转速限制的最高速。

english: OK, so you feel as if your acceleration is too slow. I’d suggest we lower the Final Drive Ratio to give you better acceleration: this will help you reach top speed quicker.
chinese: 好，所以你觉得你的加速太慢。我会建议我们调低最终传动比，好让你有更好的加速：这会帮助你更快达到最高速。

english: The car is turning too much in corners.
It feels like after just a few laps, the tyres are gone and not working.
chinese: 感觉过了几圈，轮胎就没了并开始失灵。

english: What’s the issue with the handling of the car?
chinese: 车子的操控发生什么问题？

english: OK, that sounds like understeer. Where in the corner is it not turning as much as you’d like? At the point of turning in? Or going through the corner? Or coming out through the exit?

OK, so the car is oversteering when turning into a corner. There are two things we can do to help. First, we can stiffen the front Anti-Roll Bar to reduce body roll when turning into the turn. english: Would you like to move the Brake Bias forward toward the front of the car, or back toward the rear? chinese: 调硬前弹簧系数会是个选择，但很遗憾地你已经到达极限了。

chinese: 将前弹簧系数从 [INITIAL]N/mm 调硬到 [FINAL]N/mm。

chinese: 将后弹簧系数从 [INITIAL]N/mm 调硬到 [FINAL]N/mm。

chinese: 调硬后弹簧系数可能会有帮助，但很遗憾地你已经到达极限了。

chinese: 调硬前弹簧系数可能会有帮助，但很遗憾地你已经到达极限了。

english: We can look at increasing the Brake Pressure, which will make them more powerful.
chinese: 我们可以增加煞车压力，这会让他们更加有力。

english: Increase the Brake Pressure from [INITIAL]% to [FINAL]%.
chinese: 将煞车压力从 [INITIAL]% 增加至 [FINAL]%。

chinese: 增加煞车压力让他们更有力，这会有帮助，但很遗憾地你已经到达极限了。

chinese: 将煞车分配器移往车子前面，使煞车平衡从 [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] 调整至 [FINAL1]/[FINAL2]。

english: Move the Brake Bias rearwards from current balance [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] front to rear to [FINAL1]/[FINAL2].
chinese: 将煞车分配器移往车子后面，使煞车平衡从 [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] 调整至 [FINAL1]/[FINAL2]。

chinese: 将煞车压力从 [INITIAL]% 减少至 [FINAL]%

english: We can lower the Brake Pressure which will make the brakes a little weaker and decrease the chance of locking the brakes.
chinese: 我们可以减少煞车压力，让煞车减弱并减少煞车死锁的机率。

english: Lower the Brake Pressure would help here, Unfortunately you are already on the lowest possible setting.
chinese: 降低煞车压力会有帮助，但很遗憾地你已经到达最低了。

english: They are locking easily. Decrease the Brake Pressure from [INITIAL]% to [FINAL]%.
chinese: 它们很容易死锁。将煞车压力从 [INITIAL]% 减少至 [FINAL]%。

english: If so, we can decrease the Brake Pressure: this will make the brakes a little less powerful, but will give you finer control under braking, and will also reduce the chance of the tyres locking-up.
chinese: 如果是这样，我们会减少煞车压力，那会让煞车减弱，

english: Decreasing the Brake Pressure would help with brakes locking easily, but unfortunately you are on the lowest possible setting.
chinese: 减少煞车压力可轻易解决煞车死锁，但很遗憾地你的设定已经是最低了。

english: Move the Brake Bias rearwards  from [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] to [FINAL1]/[FINAL2].
chinese: 它们并不是真的很容易死锁，只是比我想的容易一些，所以将煞车分配器由 [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] 至 [FINAL1]/[FINAL2] 向后调整。

english: Or alternatively, we can move the Brake Bias towards the rear a little so the front brakes work a little less. This should ease the likelihood of the front brakes from locking.
chinese: 如果煞车不容易锁住，我们可以将煞车分配器向后调一点，

english: Moving the Brake Bias towards the rear a little could ease the likelihood of the front brakes from locking. Unfortunately you are already on the limit.
chinese: 将煞车分配器向后调一点，可以减少前煞死锁发生。很遗憾地，你已经到达极限了。

english: Move the Brake Bias forwards from its balance of [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] front to rear to [FINAL1]/[FINAL2] front to rear.
chinese: 移动煞车分配器，使煞车平衡从 [INITIAL1]/[INITIAL2] 调整至 [FINAL1]/[FINAL2]。

english: Moving the Brake Bias forwards a bit might help.
chinese: 将煞车分配器向前调整会有一些帮助。

english: Moving the Brake Bias forwards a bit would help here, unfortunately you are already on the limit.
chinese: 将煞车分配器向前调整会有一些帮助，很遗憾地你已经到达极限了。

english: Stiffen the Front Spring Rates if it feels as if the front tyres aren’t working.
chinese: 如果觉得前轮不管用时，调硬前弹簧系数。

english: Stiffen the Rear Spring Rates if it feels as if the rear tyres aren’t working.
chinese: 如果觉得后轮不管用时，调硬后弹簧系数。

english: Stiffen both Front and Rear Spring Rates if none of the tyres feel as if they’re working.
chinese: 如果觉得前后轮都不管用时，调硬前后弹簧系数。

english: Lower the Final Drive Ratio from [INITIAL] to [FINAL].
chinese: 将最终传动比从 [INITIAL] 调低到 [FINAL]。

english: Reduce the Front Downforce from [INITIAL] to [FINAL].
chinese: 将前方下压力从 [INITIAL] 减少到 [FINAL]。

english: Lowering Front Downforce is not possible, since you are on the limit.
chinese: 由于你已经到达极限，不可能再降低前方下压力。

english: Reduce the Rear Downforce from [INITIAL] to [FINAL].
chinese: 将后方下压力从 [INITIAL] 减少到 [FINAL]。
